 Features: 
 Flash partition images and AK3 kernel zips
 Backup and Restore kernel partitions
 Mount, Map, and Resize vendor_dlkm
 Save dmesg, logcat, and ramoops

fdroid:com.nic.roam.name: Roam: GPS Speedometer
fdroid:com.nic.roam.summary: A GPS speedometer that treats your OLED with respect. No ads, no tracking.
fdroid:com.nic.roam.description:
Roam shows one thing: your current GPS speed, in big digits on a pure black screen, with nothing else fighting for your attention.
It exists because leaving a navigation app open for hours just to watch your speed is rough on OLED screens. A bright, static interface slowly burns itself into the panel. Roam is designed from the ground up to leave no trace on yours.
How it protects your screen:
* The readout moves. Every few minutes (1 to 10, your choice) the speed display glides to a new position, so no area of the panel carries the load for long.
* Pure black background. On OLED, black pixels are switched off, so only the digits are lit.
* Colour drift. The digit colour slowly shifts hue over time, so no single subpixel is driven hard at one fixed colour for hours.
* Outline digits. An optional hollow digit style that lights a fraction of the pixels.
* Brightness control. Dim the display from inside the app without touching your system settings.
The rest:
* Current speed in km/h or mph, plus a session max.
* The screen stays awake while the app is open.
* No ads, no tracking, no network access at all. The only permission is location, used for GPS speed.
* Tiny: the app is well under 100 KB.
Roam is free and open source (AGPL-3.0). Source code and privacy details are linked below.

fdroid:de.attarsherz.auvae.name: Auvae — growing close
fdroid:de.attarsherz.auvae.summary: 257 questions that bring people genuinely close. No account, no ads.
fdroid:de.attarsherz.auvae.description:
Becoming authentically close — that is what this is about.
Auvae is a game with no points, no winners and no hurry. It asks a question — and then it is your turn.
You begin by choosing your language and how many people are playing. From there the app moves around the circle: each person gets their own colour filling the whole screen, and a question drawn from a pool of 257. Whoever sees the colour is up. A tap passes it on. There are no other rules.
The questions range from light to deep. "What is your favourite food?" sits beside "What is the hardest thing you have ever said to someone you love?" Some invite a story, others ask you to finish a sentence. They come from a collection gathered over years for evenings of real conversation.
Closeness does not come from time spent together, but from what is allowed to be said. Auvae makes the saying easier — because the question does not have to come from you.
LOOKING BACK
An answer sometimes travels further than the question reached. A thin chevron at the edge of the screen quietly leafs back through every question of the round — each in the colour of the person who had it. One tap and you are back in the game.
THREE LANGUAGES
German, English and Spanish — all 257 questions and the entire interface. You can switch at any time, even mid-game: the same question simply appears in the new language. Useful at tables where not everyone shares a mother tongue.
FOR CHILDREN
There is a switch on the very first screen: "For children". It doesn't change the tone of the app, only the questions — in three age levels. From 3 years, very short questions meant to be read aloud. From 4 to 9, wishes, imagination and telling, where an answer may hide behind an animal. From 10 to 14, questions and, between them, small stories that stop at one point and invite you to carry on — with no correct continuation; what matters is what goes on inside somebody.
Every level keeps its own progress; the adult catalogue stays untouched. In the children's mode the thinking time switches off, and for the younger levels the text grows larger. Each name can carry a symbol — a fox, a star, a strawberry: children who cannot read yet recognise themselves by it. A star next to a name keeps it, so it comes back to the front of every game.
TO YOUR OWN TASTE
• Four palettes — Midnight, Jewels, Earth and the pale Morning Light
• Light and dark appearance, or automatic
• Three text sizes
• Names for everyone playing, instead of "Person 1"
• Time to think, from one to five minutes, or none at all
• Random order, so the same person need not always begin
• No repeats: each question appears once until all 257 have been asked
• Pass on by tapping, or with the button
• A gentle vibration when the turn changes
• The screen stays awake while you play
Settings are reachable from every screen, including the very first.
NOTHING ASKED IN RETURN
Auvae collects nothing. There is no account, no sign-up, no advertising, no purchases, no analytics. Your settings and names stay on your device and never leave it.
Auvae needs no internet — not on first launch, and never after. Every question is contained in the app. It does not even ask for permission to go online; the only permission it requests is the one for the gentle vibration when the turn is passed on.
WHERE IT COMES FROM
Auvae is the successor to "Quality Communication", a small project that has carried these same questions for years. The questions remain; everything else was built anew.

fdroid:net.homodian.yggproxy.name: Ygg Proxy
fdroid:net.homodian.yggproxy.summary: SOCKS5/HTTP proxies into the Yggdrasil mesh — no VPN, no root
fdroid:net.homodian.yggproxy.description:
Ygg Proxy runs an embedded Yggdrasil node on your device and offers SOCKS5 and HTTP (CONNECT) proxies instead of a VPN tunnel — no TUN interface, no VPN slot, no root needed.
How it works: apps that support SOCKS5/HTTP proxies (browsers, download managers, messengers, other devices on your LAN) opt in themselves; everything else on the phone is completely untouched.
Features:
• SOCKS5 + HTTP CONNECT proxy, bound to 127.0.0.1 or all interfaces (gateway mode for other devices, e.g. old iPhones on iOS 7/9/12)
• <publickey>.pk.ygg name resolution built-in, optional in-mesh DNS server
• Optional username/password authentication (recommended on public networks)
• Port forwarding both ways (expose local services to the mesh / map mesh services to local ports)
• LAN multicast peer discovery, manual peer lists
• Foreground service with persistent node identity (stable IPv6 address)
Yggdrasil core: v0.5.14 (LGPLv3 with linking exception); proxy/netstack derived from yggstack primitives (gVisor TCP/IP in userspace).

apple-itunes:6751086438.name: Sondo - AI Music Video & AI MV
apple-itunes:6751086438.description:
One song, one mood, your own AI music video.
Some things are hard to say out loud, and some moments deserve more than a spot in your camera roll.
Give a song to Sondo, add a photo or write down the story you want to tell, and the AI understands the rhythm, emotion, and lyrics in the music to generate the visuals, arrange the story, and finish the editing for you. In minutes, you can turn how you feel right now into a complete music video.
No film crew, no editing skills, and no aligning the music frame by frame. All you have to do is tell Sondo what you want to express.
Let the music tell your story
It could be longing for someone, a relationship that has ended, an unforgettable trip, or simply an emotion that suddenly surfaced today.
Sondo unfolds the story along with the music's emotion: when the melody grows quiet, the visuals slow down; when the chorus hits, the emotion is released along with the shots; and when the lyrics reach a key moment, the story responds on screen.
Your music is no longer just sound—it now has characters, emotion, and a story.
Make photos the star of your music video
Choose a photo of yourself, a friend, family, or your pet, and let the people in the photo step into the world of music.
With no filming required, you can turn an ordinary photo into a music video with movement, emotion, and a cinematic feel.
Create what you truly want to express
Here, you can:
Make a complete music video for your own original song so more people can hear and see your work;
Use a song to capture birthdays, trips, anniversaries, and important moments;
Turn your wedding memories into a love story you can replay anytime;
Make a music video that belongs only to you and someone you miss;
Express how you feel through creative visuals you can share;
Make a friend, family member, or pet the star of a music video;
Follow trending music to quickly make short videos with rhythm and a story.
More than music videos
AI music creation: Write a sentence, a story, or a few lines of lyrics, and the AI can generate an original song of your own. It supports many music styles including pop, rap, rock, and jazz, and you can go straight on to generate a music video.
Diverse visual expression: You can describe the mood you want, such as warm, lonely, passionate, romantic, or nostalgic. Based on your emotion, the AI chooses more fitting visuals and shots, rather than simply applying a single visual style.
Music can capture your experiences, and it can also express the things you never said out loud.
Let your music be not only heard, but also seen.

apple-macos:1531657269.name: MarginNote 5: AI Notes·MindMap
apple-macos:1531657269.developer: Beijing Yunsi Software Technology Co., Ltd
apple-macos:1531657269.description:
MarginNote is a PDF tool for in-depth reading and study. Keep PDF highlights linked to mind-map cards, then add those cards to review. MarginNote 5 introduces task-based templates for reading, question practice, and vocabulary. MarginNote has evolved since 2013. The upgrade from MarginNote 4 is free. Your study sets, notes, and purchases remain intact.
MARGINNOTE 5: ONE TASK, ONE SETUP
• Templates — a template sets the bottom tools, menus, pens, and excerpt colors. The "Standard" template has four modes: Excerpt, Handwrite, Organize, and Recall. Each mode groups tools for that task.
• Template Gallery — install official templates in one tap. Some templates include examples to help you get started:
– Card Practice: write answers by hand on question cards, check your answers, and focus your next review on questions you haven't mastered yet. AI can split a whole workbook into cards.
– Reading Vocabulary: collect words while reading English; an offline dictionary provides base forms, pronunciation, and definitions, and finished cards join review when automatic review is enabled.
• Make it yours — the corresponding controls are highlighted as you edit. Find features and settings with Feature Search, and export or share your templates.
• Traditional Interface — open the template menu and choose "Traditional Interface" (except on iPhone Duo).
SYNC YOU CAN SEE
The home screen shows where sync stands. The Sync Center lists notes and original documents separately and tells you when a document is still downloading. Manual sync reports results and offers a protective snapshot. Applying cloud changes also protects local study data.
THE CARD AT THE CENTER
• Organize excerpts by chapter; for books without a table of contents, AI can build one.
• Title Links — notes on concepts you've studied resurface as you read new documents.
• Extend — open writing space anywhere on a PDF: inline, in the margin, or folded away.
AI AS AN ASSISTANT, NOT A SUBSTITUTE
AI Breakdown · Question Extraction · AI TOC · AI OCR card templates · translation · chat. Save any answer as a card, or turn its outline into mind-map branches. Online AI sends task text or images to the service provider used for the request.
REVIEW: THINK FIRST, THEN LOOK
Use Recall mode to hide and reveal answers in the mind map. Add cards to a review deck for FSRS spaced repetition. Write directly on card snapshots while you review. On iOS/iPadOS/macOS 26+, when Apple Intelligence is enabled and its model is available on a supported device and in a supported region, on-device recall hints work offline without MarginNote credits.
THE FULL WORKFLOW
PDF, EPUB, Office-to-PDF import (online), video and audio · Zotero, cloud drives and external folders · side-by-side documents · handwriting layers and mind-map backgrounds · mind-map PDF export (structure or card flow) · read aloud · fast OCR
WHO IT IS FOR
Anyone who rereads material and needs to remember it: medical and law students, exam takers, researchers, language learners, serious readers.
ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
iPhone, iPad and Mac with one Apple Account; iCloud syncs study sets, notes and review progress. Native Apple Pencil handwriting on iPad. Also adapted for iPhone Duo.
ABOUT PURCHASES
Free to download. Some features require Pro (one-time unlock) or Max (subscription or one-time unlock). MarginNote Agent requires Max and uses MarginNote credits. Some online AI uses MarginNote credits; external AI is billed by its provider. A Max subscription includes 500 credits/month while active.
Questions: service@marginnote.com

Privacy Policy: https://dist.marginnote.cn/MarginNote_Privacy_Policy.pdf

apple-macos:447755419.name: SongBook+
apple-macos:447755419.description:
SongBook+ is the digital songbook for musicians who want their repertoire firmly under control, especially live on stage. Lyrics and sheet music are on screen instead of in a binder, each song keeps its own backing track, and with a MIDI-capable keyboard, SongBook+ recalls the matching registration as you open the song. No changing settings by hand, no searching between songs.
SongBook+ works with your own material: lyrics, sheet music, backing tracks, videos, and MIDI files in common formats such as PDF, ChordPro, and MP3. No songs, lyrics, sheet music, backing tracks, or other files are included. Import your files via the Files app, Finder, Wi-Fi, or “Open in”, guided by an illustrated online manual.
For solo performers with a keyboard, singers with backing tracks, cover bands, hobby musicians, and anyone with a large repertoire. For practice, rehearsals, lessons, the studio, and the stage. On iPad, iPhone, and Mac, on the App Store since 2011, continuously expanded with new features and updated for new iOS versions and devices.
Use up to 15 of your own songs for free and set them up for your next gig. When your repertoire grows, unlock the full version in the app, either as a subscription or as a purchase with five years of updates. After those five years, your installed version keeps working; newer versions require a new purchase. The sponsoring subscriptions in the list of in-app purchases are a voluntary way to support development, not needed for the full version. To try out the features, load sample songs directly in the app.
Keyboard and MIDI, matched to every song:
• Recall keyboard registrations when you open a song
• Send MIDI commands when opening, starting, stopping, or closing a song
• Trigger MIDI commands with assignable buttons in the document
• Play MIDI files through external sound modules
• MIDI monitor, macros, routing, and THRU
On stage, without searching:
• Find any song in seconds, even on the fly: search, filters, tags, sorting
• As many playlists as you like, for example one setlist per gig
• Live playlist: add songs for the next set during a break, played songs can disappear automatically
• Preselect the next song while the current one plays
• Turn full pages or scroll smoothly, also automatically
• Control SongBook+ by foot pedal or MIDI, your hands stay on the instrument
• Night mode with inverted colors for dark stages
• Visual and/or audible metronome
• Portrait or landscape orientation
Backing tracks, click, and video, every track where it belongs:
• Play MP3, WAV, AIFF, and M4A
• Up to 5 stereo audio files in sync
• Mixer with volume, EQ for audio files, global and per song
• Click and backing track on separate outputs (external hardware required)
• Global balance, pan, channel assignment to external outputs
• Loop audio, MIDI, and video files
• Play jingles
• Fade out songs: audio, video, and MIDI
• Play your own karaoke videos directly on the iPad
• External monitor or projector, rotatable image, also for song videos
With the band, everyone on the same song:
• Connect multiple iPads wirelessly and open songs in sync
• Sync the live playlist with your band's devices, everyone sees the same set
• Only the song number is sent, so each musician keeps their own view and notes
• Separate books, for example one per band or project
Prepare and practice, set up once, open anytime:
• Display PDF, TXT, images, LRC, and ChordPro
• Scan lyrics and sheet music to PDF with the camera
• Import lyrics from MIDI and MP3 files
• Add notes, chords, symbols, highlights, and handwriting
• Record the song position with your finger and play it back karaoke-style
After the gig:
• Music log for reporting to ASCAP, BMI, PRS, and others
• Back up, restore, export, and share data
See how other musicians use SongBook+ with their keyboards and sound modules in the customer videos on songbookplus.com.
Terms of Use (EULA) and Privacy Policy: https://www.songbookplus.com/privacy-terms-conditions

fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.name: geany-plugins-addons
fedora-packages:geany-plugins/geany-plug.description: This plugins consists of various small addons too small to justify their own plugin, but are useful to have. The following functionality is implemented: * Document list: This addon places a new item in the toolbar and when clicked offers a menu listing all open files plus the 'Close All' and 'Close Other Documents' menu items. This can be useful to quickly access open files and switch to them. * Open and Copy URI: Adds 'Open URI' and 'Copy URI' menu items to the editor menu when the word under the cursor looks like a URI. 'Open URI' uses the browser command configured in Geany to open it. * Tasks: The tasks plugin goes through a file being edited and picks out lines with configurable keywords (e.g. "TODO" or "FIXME") in them. It collects the text after those words and puts them in a new "Tasks" tab in the message window. Clicking on a task in that tab takes you to the line in the file where the task was defined. * Systray: Adds a status icon to the notification area (systray) and provides a simple popup menu with some basic actions. It can also be used to quickly show and hide the Geany main window. * Bookmark list: Add a list of defined bookmarks (line markers) to the sidebar. This list contains all bookmarks defined in the current file for faster overview and access. * Mark Word: When double-clicking a word, all occurrences of this word are searched and then highlighted (similar to Geany's 'Mark All' Find option). * Strip trailing blank lines: This addon removes excessive trailing blank lines from the document when it is saved. If you have 'Ensure new line at file end' option checked in Preferences, one trailing newline will be left. * XML tagging: XML tagging allows to easy tag a selected text, by checking for a selection, offering a little dialog for inserting a tag and replacing a selection.

firefox-addons:782496.name: Connective signing extension
firefox-addons:782496.summary: Connective Signing Extension enables secure signing and identification features for Nitro Software applications through its native component
firefox-addons:782496.description:
Connective Signing Extension enables secure signing and identification features for Nitro Software applications through its native component.
 Why does this extension need access to your browsing activity? 
When you use the extension, it reads the URL of the active browser tab. The URL, together with a security token, is sent to our backend solely to verify that the signing or identification request originates from an authorized website before the requested operation is performed.
This information is used only for this security validation. It is not used to track your browsing activity, create browsing profiles, or collect analytics. The URL is not stored, logged, or retained after the validation is complete.

firefox-addons:2622134.name: Virtual Hosts
firefox-addons:2622134.summary: Apply virtual hosts and overwrite the Hosts header for development purposes.
firefox-addons:2622134.description:
Access virtual hosts of a server without the need of host redirection or DNS.
== ATTENTION ==
This addon may not do what you think it does! Make sure you read and understand the functionality before submitting a 1-star review because you think it does something which it's not supposed to do, thank you!
THIS ADDON IS FOR TESTING VHOSTS!
THIS DOES NOT REPLICATE THE SYSTEMS HOST FILE DNS RESOLVING!!!
"Virtual Hosts" does not mean a "virtual hosts file" but refers to http "Virtual hosting"!!!
== ABOUT ==
Overwrite the "Host" HTTP header to request a specific virtual host from a remote webserver. IT DOES NOT RESOLVE DNS TO IP!!!!
Often enough while waiting for DNS propagation or standing up a replacement site, developers edit the hosts file on their system to achieve the same effect. This extension facilitates the a similar effect without the hassle or when lacking permissions.
When detecting outgoing HTTP(S) requests from your Firefox browser to the VHost IP we rewrite the Host header to the VHost Domain. Any requests to sites other than the VHost IP are ignored, so browsing other sites won't be impacted.
== HOW TO USE ==
- Enable -
Click the VHost icon in the top right to open the settings panel.
Make sure Globally Enabled is checked.
- Adding vhosts -
Press Add new Virtual Host and enter the original Host in the IP field (either an IP address if accessing a website by IP or the domain name of the target website) and the new Host in the Host field.
When a domain is present and Enabled is checked for the host all websites matching the IP will be requested with the entered domain.
- Disable -
Untick the [ ] Globally Enabled checkbox or the individual Enabled checkboxes for each host.
== Source ==
I released the source code on GitHub: https://github.com/Longoon12000/Virtual-Hosts 
== THANK YOU ==
For using this extension.

firefox-addons:3121090.name: Password vault
firefox-addons:3121090.summary: Autofill logins and passkeys, save new ones and generate strong passwords. End-to-end encrypted: not even LazyConMan can read it.
firefox-addons:3121090.description:
The LazyConMan Password vault extension fills your saved logins into websites, offers to save new ones, and generates strong passwords, right from your browser.
Your vault is end-to-end encrypted. Everything is encrypted on your device with your master password and a Secret Key that only you hold, before it is synced. LazyConMan cannot read your logins, and neither can your organization.
 Fill logins with one click or Ctrl+Shift+L (Cmd+Shift+L on Mac). Only on the exact site the login belongs to, never on lookalike domains.
 See your saved logins for a site right in its sign-in form, and how many there are on the toolbar icon.
 After filling a login with two-step sign-in, its one-time code is ready to paste or fill, with a timer showing how long it stays valid.
 Connect to your vault in two clicks, with no code to copy, and unlock with the same passkey you use for the web vault.
 Save or update a login when you sign in to a site.
 Generate strong passwords and passphrases.
 Copy passwords and one-time codes; the clipboard is cleared after 30 seconds.
 Save website passkeys in your vault and sign in with them in any browser you pair.
 Suggests a strong password when you sign up or change a password, and offers to save it.
 Locks itself after a period of inactivity.
 Works offline from an encrypted copy on your device.
Requires a LazyConMan account with a password vault seat. Pair the extension from the vault's Settings → Devices.

bluejetty:00077389:ios.description:
Thinking of going vegan? Simple Vegan makes the transition as easy as possible.
FEATURES
• Beginner guides help you through the process of becoming and staying a vegan
• Browse 500+ simple & easy-to-cook vegan recipes
• Make shopping lists automatically with ingredients from your chosen recipes
• Daily meals recommendations ensure you never eat the same thing twice (unless you want to)
• Track the positive impact your switch to vegan has had on the environment
BEGINNER GUIDES
Learn why going vegan is good & what to eat once you've transitioned. Find tips & tricks for changing your eating habits and living a healthy vegan lifestyle.
300+ TASTY VEGAN RECIPES
Browse tons of step-by-step recipes by category. Find delicious new vegan dishes you can make from the comfort of your own home.
AUTOMATIC SHOPPING LISTS
Choose the recipes you want to make and have all the needed ingredients automatically added to a shopping list.
MEAL RECOMMENDATIONS
Keep things fresh with a new vegan meal recommended every day.
Let Simple Vegan make your vegan transition as smooth as possible - download now for free!
 -------------------
APP USAGE INFO & PREMIUM MEMBERSHIP DETAILS
You can buy the Premium Version (Simple Vegan Premium) via in-app purchases within the app. Simple Vegan is significantly cheaper than comparable Nutrition apps.
Simple Vegan Premium provides access to all contents and can be purchased for 1 month, 6 months or yearly. If you opt for the subscription, you pay the fixed price for your country which is displayed in the app. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of the period. You can turn off the auto-renewal at any time up until 24-hours before the end of the subscription period in your Account Settings in iTunes after purchase. It is not possible to refund a subscription or cancel a subscription during the current period. When you cancel the auto-renewal, access to the Pro features will not expire immediately, you will have access until the end of the current payment period. After the free trial, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase.
Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period at the current price for the billing period selected. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication
Privacy Policy: https://simpleveganapp.com/privacypolicy-en/
Terms & Conditions: https://simpleveganapp.com/terms-conditions/
Disclaimer: https://simpleveganapp.com/disclaimer/

bluejetty:00026593:ios.description:
Get all your news in one place on an eye-opening platform that shows you the bias, reliability and ownership of every source you read. Cut through the noise and escape media echo chambers with Ground News.
Ground News is the largest news aggregator in the world with over 50K news sources and 60K articles added daily. But we aren’t a typical news aggregator, throwing hundreds of headlines at you that barely skim the surface. Ground frees people from algorithmic restraints, illuminates blindspots and makes media bias explicit with our one-of-a-kind media analysis features.
AVOID MANIPULATIVE ALGORITHMS
SPOT MEDIA BIAS
DISCOVER BLINDSPOTS
CHECK THE RELIABILITY OF SOURCES
SEE WHO OWNS THE NEWS YOU CONSUME
Read daily breaking stories from sources around the world, in real time. Like a modern day newspaper, we show you diverse stories instead of algorithm-driven content that can limit your worldview. News coverage is rarely unbiased, so we give you as much context as possible so you can come to your own conclusions. Compare coverage on partisan topics like politics, and elections.
Enjoy our free features, or subscribe for in-depth analysis that will transform the way you look at news.
About Your Ground News Subscription: 
Subscriptions renew monthly and can be managed through your App Store account
Payment will be charged to your App Store Account on confirmation of purchase
Renewal is automatic unless turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
Subscriptions can also be managed through Ground News by going to your Account Settings after purchase

bluejetty:00187335:ios.description:
Easily track packages with the PostNL app
Track and send your packages with the PostNL app. In the app, you always have a complete overview of everything on its way to you.
Sending a package is also easy via the app. Looking for a PostNL point? You can easily find these in the app as well.
Curious about which mail is on its way to you? Activate My Mail so you also have a complete overview of all your mail (note: only available in the Netherlands).
This way, you always have us at hand!
Always up-to-date
If you enable notifications, we ensure that you are always informed of the latest status of your package.
Also, install the PostNL widget on your home screen to always stay up-to-date.
Sending something?
Have the QR code from your account scanned and receive a shipping confirmation by email.
Easily create a label via the app and have it printed at a PostNL point.
Need a stamp? Buy a digital stamp and write it on the letter, convenient!
Download the app and let us know what you think!

bluejetty:00120983:ios.description:
WELCOME TO THE MOST RELAXING COLOR-MATCHING ADVENTURE!
Bunny Pop is a colorful, fun & highly addictive bubble shooter game that’ll keep you playing for hours! Challenging without being frustrating, this bubble shooter game is great to pass the time!
Fire your bubble shooter to save the cute baby bunnies! Aim, match and smash the bubbles to help them collect carrots or escape from the Big Bad Wolf. Each bubble will bring a bunny closer to their happily ever after!
Try Bunny Pop - the best free bubble shooter game!
HOW TO PLAY
Aim carefully and tap where you want your bubble shooter to go!
Match 3 or more same-colored bubbles to make them disappear!
Use special boosters & exciting items to help you pass trickier levels.
Pop all the bubbles with fewer shots to score higher.
SPECIAL FEATURES
TONS OF UNIQUE & EXCITING LEVELS!
EASY AND FUN PLAY! Simple to learn and fun to master!
EXCITING EVENTS! Earn daily rewards to help you!
CONNECT TO FACEBOOK! Share the fun with your friends!
NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM! Play offline!
STUNNING GRAPHICS!
NOTES
• Bunny Pop contains a variety of advertisements.
• Bunny Pop is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items like AD FREE and coins.
• Bunny Pop is available on smartphone or tablet.
Email
• contactus@bitmango.com
Privacy Policy

bluejetty:00185690:ios.description:
Copy Replace Face lets you copy a face from one of your photos onto another. Simple.
Copy the whole face, or just parts of it like the eyes or nose. Layer faces on top of each other to make fun, creative photos.
Popular uses:
Fix photos where someone blinked, using a better shot of the same person
Try out new hairstyles
Make fun collages
Blend faces together
Put your face in a "face in the hole" style photo
Face bomb: give everyone in a group photo the same face
Classic face swaps with friends and family
Features:
● Simple manual editor: position, scale and blend faces by hand
● Copy the whole face or individual features
● Multiple blending masks for a natural result
● Save faces to reuse on other photos
● Sample photos included so you can try the app straight away
● Share your creations with friends
Copy Replace Face is for light-hearted fun. Please only use photos of people who are happy to be included. Explicit content is automatically blocked.

bluejetty:00062486:ios.name: Jumping Games for Kids
bluejetty:00062486:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00062486:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
WHALE FRIEND
Use your jumping skills and time your landings to collect butterflies in this massively addicting endless-jumper that will have you saying, “just one more round!” It’s up to the friend to feed the picky whale who doesn’t eat fish. 
Collect and upgrade power-ups while jumping on clouds. 
Don’t forget to level up your character for bigger bonuses and score multipliers!
Whale Friend features:
* Easy to learn gameplay 
* Four funky, upgradeable power-ups 
* Complete 27 in-game missions, level up and unlock 35 unique achievements 
* Perfect the art of cloud-jumping to earn massive bonuses 
* Customize friend, the Whale, and the house you live in! 
* Collect the 20 rare butterflies and get your score multiplier sky high
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00073794:ios.summary:
With Fog of World, you relive those destinations and the path that lead you there. Map it; draw each stride out for you to see. Look at the work of art you’ve created - just by traveling. By knowing you cannot be contained.
Join Us. Embrac
bluejetty:00073794:ios.description:
With Fog of World, you relive those destinations and the path that lead you there. Map it; draw each stride out for you to see. Look at the work of art you’ve created - just by traveling. By knowing you cannot be contained.
Join Us. Embrace a unique way of experiencing your adventures! Explore, visit and memorize your travels on the world map. Unfog the world and make your life more brilliant today!
● VISUALIZE & MEMORIZE EVERYWHERE YOU’VE BEEN
Fog of World is a real-life, travel and exploring game where you need to remove the fog on the map by exploring the world. It's a fantastic way to visualize everywhere you have been in your entire life or to discover places around you!
● EXQUISITE MAPPING 
Beautiful world maps are available at a glance. Explore the places near your location, find the spot to go and hit record. Your trip is then recorded, mapped and kept on your cloud storage forever. Start the travel explore the game, while memorizing the places you visit in a neat way. Grow your level and increase your visit percentages for every continent. Have fun exploring the world!
● CRITICALLY ACCLAIMED
• Featured by Apple as App of the Day in 137 countries
• This Fog of World App Might Be the Funniest App I’ve Seen in a Long Time - GIZMODO
• We don't remember the last time we've run into an app that is as interesting as Fog of World - Business Insider
• Fog of World turns moving through your city and your world into a game of exploration - AppStorm
• Original worldwide location tracking game that will make you want to explore every street in your city and far wider - LITTLE APP REVIEW
• Fog of World uses the fog of war from video games to gamify traveling - The Awesomer
• Was holding the 1st position for top stories on Hacker News!
● FEATURES
• Records your tracks and maps travel (even when the app running in the background).
• Shows everywhere you have been on the map at the same time with its advanced trip and travel mapping.
• Analyses your statistics around the world, around every continent, and around every country and territory.
• Lots of badges to motivate you to explore more around the world.
• Support for multiple databases and securing data with snapshots for various tracking purposes.
• Support for Importing tracks through GPX or KML files.
• Support for syncing your data with iCloud, Dropbox and OneDrive.
• Super high-accuracy offline reverse geocoding database that provides the most accurate statistics.
• Support for Siri shortcuts and personalized Siri phrases.
● PRIVACY POLICY
In short, we do not collect any of your exploration data. Your data will be uploaded when you sync them with your cloud storages, but only you have access to them. We don't.
● Why Fog of World?
• Fog of World is the first app that brings the fog of war idea into the real world map back in 2012 and provides free updates since then.
• Fog of World remains the best app to render the fog overlay and is the only app that shows you high-resolution tracks. Don't believe it? Download the copycat apps and compare the results with Fog of World screenshots.
• There is no user account of Fog of World. All of your data are saved in your device. You have 100% privacy.
• The database is designed to use as little storage as possible while providing high performance.
• Fog of World is the only app that truly works around the world since China uses the GCJ-02 coordinate system due to political reasons. Other copycats either work correctly in China or the rest of the world, but not both.
Map your trips, memorize and start your world adventure with Fog of World. It’s like having world atlas and yourself to explore and conquer it.
Download the ultimate explore game and places I've been travel tracker now!
Like us on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/OllixIO/
Follow us on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/OllixIO
Note:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00132039:ios.name: Roborock
bluejetty:00132039:ios.summary:
Roborock App is a dedicated application designed to control Roborock’s smart hardware devices. 
It supports network-enabled products in Roborock’s robotic vacuum cleaners, wet and dry vacuum cleaners, and molecular sieve-based washer dryers
bluejetty:00132039:ios.description:
Roborock App is a dedicated application designed to control Roborock’s smart hardware devices. 
It supports network-enabled products in Roborock’s robotic vacuum cleaners, wet and dry vacuum cleaners, and molecular sieve-based washer dryers.
You can remotely control smart devices and check their status and cleaning progress through this app anytime, anywhere.
Easily unlock more advanced features through the Roborock app.
【Roborock Robotic Vacuum Cleaner】
· Check the cleaning map and path anywhere and anytime you want, and control the cleaning progress in real-time. 
· Choose from various personalized cleaning methods, including room cleaning, zone cleaning, scheduled cleaning, and spot cleaning routines.
· Set up frequently used cleaning tasks as routines for one-tap starts. 
· Choose multiple cleaning preferences, including Vacuum, Mop, Vac & Mop, SmartPlan (applicable to certain models only), and Customize mode. 
· Set up a personalized cleaning plan by adjusting suction power, water flow, cleaning frequency, and route (applicable to certain models only).
· Enables you to edit a map based on your home and set names for thresholds, carpets, floor types, furniture, and rooms. 
· Set up invisible walls and no-go zones and your robot will not cross or enter them during cleaning.
· Enjoy a variety of fun features, including remote viewing, obstacle photos, pet snapshots, cruise mode, pet search, and custom tones (applicable to select models only).
【Roborock Robotic Lawn Mower】
 · Visually edit maps, easily set No-Go Zones and Passages, and support precise multi-area management. 
 · Customize mowing preferences, efficiency, and direction for each area, and set schedules for automatic start and stop.
 · Features intelligent obstacle avoidance, automatic return to charge when it rains, and a Wildlife-Friendly mode for comprehensive protection.
 【Roborock Wet and Dry Vacuum Cleaner】
· Adjust water flow, suction power, roller speed, and detergent level (applicable to select models only) based on the floor and dirt level.
· Smart scheduled self-cleaning and drying: automatically initiates self-cleaning and drying based on historical operation records.
【Roborock Washer Dryer】
· Check the washing progress and operating status anywhere and anytime you want.
· Choose from over 20 smart washing and drying programs to meet the professional needs of various fabrics and clothing, ensuring optimal washing performance.
· Set one program as the App Program for quick access on the control panel.
【Permissions】
To provide certain services, you need to enable the relevant permissions on your mobile device. We will only need the relevant permissions and access your personal information (if relevant) when you use the relevant functions. For the optional permissions, you can refuse or withdraw these permissions at any time, for which you may not be able to use the corresponding services, but this will not affect other functions of the App. The current permissions that the app may need are as follows: 
· Location (Optional)
Accesses location information to connect to WiFi, find nearby devices ready for connection, and retrieve details about the current WiFi connection.
· Camera (Optional)
Enables the camera to scan QR codes for easier WiFi connection.
· Photos (Optional)
Allows access to photos for uploading profile pictures and attaching images when providing feedback. If your device supports features like downloading obstacle images, taking screenshots, or recording during remote viewing, photos and videos can be stored.
· Microphone (Optional)
Used for sound transmission on devices that support remote viewing.
· WLAN (Optional)
Facilitates connection to WiFi networks emitted by smart devices for communication and connectivity.
· Bluetooth (Optional)
Enables connection to Bluetooth signals from smart devices for communication and device connecting.
· Notifications (Optional)
Allows the app to send you device and system notifications.

bluejetty:00176547:ios.description:
You organize your tasks. Then everything falls apart. NoteCircle is built for when nothing sticks—and trusted by over 1 million users worldwide, with App Store features across the US, Europe, and Asia.
Why most to-do apps don’t stick
You start motivated, but after a few days everything falls apart again. Tasks get buried, routines break, and important things slip through the cracks. NoteCircle solves this by giving you structure without clutter.
One clear system for your day and week
NoteCircle brings tasks, routines, events, and checklists into one clean planner, so nothing is hidden in separate apps or screens. With a calm weekly view, you always know what needs attention today and what can wait.
Especially helpful when focus is a challenge
Many users say NoteCircle works especially well for people who struggle with focus, consistency, or feeling overwhelmed. Reviews often mention that it helps ADHD-style brains stay on track by keeping everything visible and structured in one place.
Plan faster when motivation is low
When typing feels like friction, NoteCircle removes it. Add tasks using voice input, or turn photos of notes and handwritten lists into editable tasks automatically. Capture ideas quickly and organize them later.
Build routines that actually last
Create weekly recurring routines that fit your real life, not a perfect schedule. NoteCircle helps you stay consistent without pressure, making habits easier to maintain over time.
See progress, not just tasks
Review your completed tasks, routines, and events in a clear monthly overview. Visual insights help you understand your patterns and improve productivity over time.
Never miss what matters
Manage birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and important events alongside your tasks. Sync Apple Calendar and Google Calendar to keep all your schedules in one place.
Clean and intuitive design
Designed to reduce distraction with a calm, paper-like interface. Optimized for both iPhone and iPad so planning feels natural anytime, anywhere.
Pricing
NoteCircle is free to download and use. Upgrade to NoteCircle Premium to unlock advanced features and get the most out of your planning.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime from your App Store account settings. Refunds are not available for any unused portion of a billed period.

bluejetty:00089174:ios.description:
** THIS APP WILL NOT FUNCTION WITHOUT HARDWARE. This is the companion app for 2022 & earlier Tempur-Pedic® Sleeptracker-AI® Smart Bases. ONE OF THESE DEVICES IS REQUIRED TO USE THIS APP. **
POWERED BY SLEEPTRACKER-AI®: BETTER SLEEP
Learn about your sleep - and improve your sleep - with nothing to wear or charge!
This is the companion app for the Tempur-Pedic® Sleeptracker-AI® Monitor which makes your bed a smart bed. The Sleeptracker-AI® system is the first cloud-based, non-invasive IoT sleep optimization solution powered by artificial intelligence (AI) and integrated into the smart home.
The app provides detailed daily sleep graphs and sleep metrics derived from accurately and continuously monitoring the sleeper’s respiration rate, heart rate, and movements throughout the night. Easy-to-understand sleep graphs visually distinguish between periods when you were in REM sleep, light sleep, deep sleep, or awake. The AI Sleep Coach delivers personalized tips and insights to help you improve your sleep every night.
AI SLEEP COACH
The AI Sleep Coach, powered by the Sleeptracker-AI® Artificial Intelligence Engine, provides effective, easy-to-implement, personal sleep tips based on a comprehensive analysis of individual sleep patterns.
RESPIRATION AND HEART RATE MONITORING
The Sleeptracker-AI® system monitors both respiration and heart rate accurately through the night for deeper sleep analysis, with your data displayed as easy to read charts in the app.
SLEEP CYCLE ALARM
Optionally select white noise that gently fades away after you've fallen asleep, then set a sleep cycle alarm that will help you Wake Up at the Optimal Time™ in your sleep cycle so you wake up refreshed and more energized.
AUTOMATIC SLEEP MONITORING
If you choose to record your sleep automatically, there’s nothing to do and nothing to wear. Optionally receive a notification in the morning when your sleep results are available and a daily email with your sleep summary and AI Coach insights.
APPLE HEALTH
Share your Sleeptracker-AI® sleep data to the Apple Health app.
The Sleeptracker-AI® system reports the following sleep-related statistics each night:
- REM sleep, light sleep, deep sleep, awake time
- Time at which you fell asleep and woke up
- Number of times awoken during the night
- Continuous respiration rate
- Continuous heart rate
- Sleep quality metric (scale of 0-100)
- Sleep efficiency (time spent in bed vs. total time asleep)
- Time it took you to fall asleep

Us
bluejetty:00177798:ios.description:
Qibla Finder application will help you to find the Kaaba direction quick and accurately whereever you are in the world.
If you change your location for a vacation or for a business trip, you can easily find Qibla with our application.
Using the application is really easy,
Make your device parallel to the ground and turn your device until arrow becomes green. When the arrow becomes green, your device's top side will be pointing Qibla.
To find Qibla direction, we use GPS and Compass in your device. Our application fist determines your position and direction. These values are then used in trigonmetric calculations to find the direction of Kaaba accurately.
Note : To find Qibla direction accurately, you need to give appropriate permissions to the application as the application asks at first use. And also application needs active Internet connection.
To avoid wrong results and to get most accurate results, please be sure not to use your phone near metalic or magnetic objects during measurement.
Please let us know if you have any question, suggestion or bug to report from apple@hakancakiroglu.com

bluejetty:00174721:ios.description:
Daily Connect makes it easier than ever to run your childcare center, whether you're a small family/home daycare or a large childcare organization with several locations. Join thousands of childcare centers around the world using Daily Connect to send real-time updates to parents, streamline operations, and save time and money. 
Record more than 30 different types of activities, automatically send daily update emails to parents, and ensure your childcare center remains compliant with local regulations. 
Over 90,000 childcare professionals around the world use Daily Connect to power their childcare center. Here’s what they have to say:
“We post every moment and as much information as we can and parents absolutely love it!”
“We searched several app options for our chain of 14 childcare centers and Daily Connect was the best solution from functionality to cost to customer service”
“Daily Connect has been a wonderful way for us to get rid of daily tracking papers. Our parents are more engaged, and it makes schoolwide messaging a breeze!”
CHILDCARE CENTERS: Build closer relationships with parents, track every detail across multiple classrooms, and automate routine compliance tasks. Get started with a free 14 day trial. 
PARENTS: Get updates on what your kids are up to every day, with photos, videos, mealtimes, and more. Secure drop-off and pick-up, plus digital portfolios of your child’s work.
Daily Connect is the easiest way to run your childcare center. Here are some of our most popular features:
Parent-Teacher Communication Tools
 - Post photos, videos, activities, meals, incident reports, and more 
 - Parents receive instant notifications and a daily email summary
 - Easily send newsletters and surveys to all parents, and highlight upcoming events on a shared calendar
Learning & Assessment Tools
 - Track each child’s progress digitally, saving time and money
 - Over 50 built-in State & National Learning Frameworks
 - Create a Digital Portfolio for each child and share work with parents
Contactless Sign In & Attendance Tracking
 - Parents securely sign in their child with a QR Code or unique PIN
 - Administrators can view which children are in which classroom in real-time
 - Attendance Reports are automatically saved to the cloud to ensure compliance
Childcare Center Management
 - Parent Billing: Automatically Invoice Parents & Collect Payment
 - Share important documents like Parent Handbooks & Authorization Forms
 - Mandated licensing documentation is automatically created and emailed to administrators
 - collect digital signatures, create your own health screening questions at sign-in, and check temperature
… And much more! Daily Connect is the affordable, easy way to run your childcare center.
The Daily Connect platform is secure, and is easy to use for parents, teachers, and childcare center directors. Everything is accessible via our mobile app, or from any computer with our web application. Wave goodbye to your paper daily sheet and go digital with Daily Connect!
You’ll provide better care, build closer bonds with parents, and stand out from other childcare providers in your area. Free yourself from time-consuming administrative tasks and start spending more time growing your business. 
Got questions? Our customer support team is here to help. We’ll provide everything you need to get started, including a guided tour of the app, a live demo, and help setting up your childcare center. Reach out to us at support@dailyconnect.com
Terms: https://www.dailyconnect.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.dailyconnect.com/privacy

bluejetty:00145254:ios.description:
At Digit Insurance, we aim to make insurance simple. 
Now, you can manage check premium, buy/renew your policy, access policy documents, and make claims in an instant right here on our app. And the best part? No paperwork required! 
Why choose Digit Insurance?
Value for Money - We try our best to give you the best possible and most affordable premiums because we know that there’s a lot at stake. 
Digital Everything - We’re tech savvy and we understand that time is precious. Both for you and us. That’s why, all our processes are tech enabled, quick and paperless. So, sit back and relax. 
Super-Fast Claims - Anytime and every time you’re in any sort of trouble, we’ll be there for you. With our 24x7 Support and quick, technology enabled claim processes, all your claims will be settled as soon as possible! 
Simplicity, Above All - No complex products. No jargons. No hidden clauses, terms and conditions. Our policy documents are so simple that even 15 years old can understand them. This is because we feel that people can benefit the most from insurance, only if they understand it! 
What makes Digit Insurance app so Awesome?
Check Premiums Instantly Online - Enter details and get instant quotes. Customize the coverages as per your requirement and get premium instantly. 
Buy Insurance Quickly and Easily - Get all our insurance products online, in a jiffy. No long proposal forms or lengthy inspections and, you can get your policy in an instant. You can also access the policy document anytime within the App. 
An Entirely Paperless Experience - All our processes are digital, right from buying insurance to making claims. No need to go through tons of papers and documents! 
An Instant Renewal Process - Access and renew your existing insurance policies almost instant – they are just one click away. 
24x7 Help and Customer Support - Get seamless support from our customer care services, available 24/7, even on National Holidays. 
Super-fast Claims - Easily access, edit, and raise an insurance claim on the app, and all your claims will be settled as soon as possible! 
Smartphone Enabled Self-inspection - For quick and easy claims, you can just take pictures of your damaged property with your phone and share it with us; and we’ll take it from there!

bluejetty:00014297:ios.name: Ikeono - Messaging & Reviews
bluejetty:00014297:ios.summary: Ikeono is an all-in-one communication tool designed for independent retailers, integrating essential business communication channels and text messaging into a single platform. The business phone number you already use is text-enabled to br
bluejetty:00014297:ios.description:
Ikeono is an all-in-one communication tool designed for independent retailers, integrating essential business communication channels and text messaging into a single platform. The business phone number you already use is text-enabled to bring the power of text messaging to your business – yes, we can text-enable landlines! Ikeono empowers over +2,000 businesses across the U.S. and Canada. 
All-In-One Inbox
 − Manage text messaging, web chat and Facebook Messenger all in one place.
 − Create auto-responses to never leave customers hanging when they contact you outside of your business hours.
 − Accomplish tasks faster and more easily with text messaging—a communication channel that strengthens the relationship between your business and customers.
More Reviews, More Customers
 − Connect your Google Business Profile to Ikeono to manage, track, and reply to reviews. 
 − Make it easy for potential customers to find you by increasing your review volume via text message-based review requests.
 − Schedulereviews to be sent at the optimal time, whether after a sale or service interaction, giving customers ample time to reflect on their product or experience.
Get Paid via Text Message
 − Every text conversations becomes an opportunity for a sale with text-to-pay.
 − Ikeono Payments is powered by Stripe providing a secure and PCI compliant method of capturing payments and deposits via a payment link.
 − Accept all major credit cards (Visa, Discover, Mastercard, and American Express) and provide Buy Now, Pay Later (Klarna, Affirm, and Afterpay) options to your customers.
Feedback Loop With Net Promoter Scores (NPS)
 − Use the convenience of text messaging to gather feedback from customers about their experience through NPS, and measure customer satisfaction and loyalty.e
 − With text message-based NPS, you can be proactive about checking in on customers and address any issues before they escalate to public complaints or reviews.
 − Use the power of customer data to fine-tune your business processes, and spot inefficiencies. 
A New Way of Doing Web Chat
 − Web chat to text message makes it easier for businesses to introduce a new communication channel by giving you the flexibility to easily reach customers via text message.
 − Turn conversations into customers with a tool that lets you reach customers even when they leave your website, giving you the freedom to answer at your convenience.
 − Works with most content management systems and eCommerce websites including Lightspeed, Shopify, Squarespace, Wordpress, and Workstand (previously Smartetailing).
Combine the Power of Your POS With Text Messaging
 − Ikeono brings a deep level of integration with Lightspeed R-Series, Lightspeed X-Series, and Lightspeed Golf.
 − Start using text receipts, send text messages for special order notifications, provide real-time updates with work order status automations, and much more.
 − Bike retailers can also leverage Ikeono's integration with Ascend RMS to maximize the benefits of text messaging with their expanding customer base.

Customize the graphs and configure Usage to function as you require. Select color, graph type, and refresh rate, among other preferences.

bluejetty:00016862:ios.name: Night Camera: Low light photos
bluejetty:00016862:ios.summary: Thanks to the manual setting options for light exposure up to 1 second *, separate residual light- and ISO enhancement, Night Camera is perfect for taking pictures in a dark, insufficiently lit environment. Even during daylight, your pictur
bluejetty:00016862:ios.description:
Thanks to the manual setting options for light exposure up to 1 second *, separate residual light- and ISO enhancement, Night Camera is perfect for taking pictures in a dark, insufficiently lit environment. Even during daylight, your pictures are clearer, with less interference, due to the extended exposure times.
Regardless whether you take night-, scenery- or other photographs, the picture quality you are able to achieve with Night Camera will surprise you.
You can easy tap to focus and tap to exposure at the same time. After selecting the desired setting, you can easily lock it to prevent changes despite movement.
Only here you can get luminance, luminosity and RGB histograms in real time to recognize over- and underexposure in time.
The self-timer, which is imperative for nighttime shots, enables you to take un-blurred pictures.
With the aid of the volume buttons you can take pictures with volume up (+) and fade the HUD-elements in- and out with volume down (-).
Of course you can also block the white balance separately and edit it if necessary.
Standard image formats (4:3, 3:2, 1:1, 16:9 and 3:1) can be edited live. The full-screen mode is activated for narrow image formats, enabling maximum display use. This feature can also be deactivated.
The histogram adapts to all image formats.
The up to 10x digital live zoom can be edited in the settings to enable a greater precision level during targeted zooming.
Various real-time color filters complete this app.
The most important functions:
- Shutter speed control
- Up to 1 second * exposure time
- Manual ISO setting
- Manual focus
- Residual light enhancement
- Real-time luminance histogram
- Real-time luminosity histogram
- Real-time RGB histogram
- Self-timer
- Volume Up (+) Photo Capture
- Volume Down (-) HUD Hide
- 10x digital live zoom
- Tap to focus
- Tap to exposure
- White balance-lock
- Manual white balance
- Manual exposure adjustment
- Aspect ratios: 4:3, 3:2, 1:1, 16:9 and 3:1
- Full-screen mode
- Eco mode
- Diverse color filters in real-time
- Take HD photos
- Landscape and portrait mode
- Supports front and back camera
- Supports LED-continuous light
- Supports EXIF-data
*) only on supported devices 
Impress your friends, by catching a couple red-handed or by showing your impressive night time pictures. 
A good camera and a powerful processor are required, to get the maximum picture quality. 
---------------------------- 
All the screenshots listed were taken with an iPhone and iPad and are genuine! 
Please note that this app does not provide true night vision functionality. The iPhone, iPad and iPod touch have no infrared amplifier, as a result no pictures can be taken in total darkness; a minimal level of light is still required, which can be ascertained by the camera's sensors. The preview will also be delayed in exposure mode. In addition the camera must be held stable for exposure time. 
----------------------------

bluejetty:00120366:ios.name: Multiplication Math For Kids
bluejetty:00120366:ios.summary:
Free educational flash cards, multiplication games, math puzzles, and learning games for kids. Everything your child needs to start their early education is here in a fun, colorful, and free kids game!
The best way to learn multiplication
bluejetty:00120366:ios.description:
Free educational flash cards, multiplication games, math puzzles, and learning games for kids. Everything your child needs to start their early education is here in a fun, colorful, and free kids game!
The best way to learn multiplication tables and gain mathematics knowledge is by using flashcards. Kids quickly pick up new knowledge by following exercises like these, especially when we teach them through a combination of colorful games, fun puzzles, and brain training practice quizzes! Children of all ages can enjoy this free educational app, including preschoolers, kindergarteners, and kids in 1st, 2nd, or 3rd grade!
Multiplication Kids is entirely FREE to play. It includes the following learning and flash card games:
1. Always Adding - Teaching multiplication is difficult, but this game makes it simpler! Always Adding illustrates to kids that multiplying is the same as adding over and over again.
2. See & Multiply - Visual representations of multiplication games with colorful pictures and a fun drag-and-drop interface.
3. Flower Times Table - Children see the structure of multiplied numbers in a simple flower arrangement. A creative way to understand multiplication tables!
4. Chinese Stick Method - An ancient method of multiplication that uses stick counting to learn. Great for older kids, and even adults!
5. Multiplication Practice - Helpful flash card drills to help children memorize and complete math problems. Includes beginner and advanced modes for more challenge.
6. Quiz Mode - Beginner, Intermediate, and Advanced quizzes that are fun to complete while showing children how much they have learned!
7. Times Tables - A great way to help teach kids classic multiplication tables. Learn by doing multiplication in sequence to quickly master your times table.
Multiplication Kids is a fun, colorful, and completely free educational app designed to help kids learn counting, simple math skills, and work on training in multiplication tables using flashcards and other fun mini-games. The app is built to help teach young brains everything they need to know about mathematics, all through the use of colorful games, memory puzzles, and drag-and-match comparison quizzes.
The games in Multiplication Kids focus on guiding children through early mathematics skills utilizing a series of trusted exercises. Six main modes of teaching include everything kids need to start learning math and multiplication skills on their own or with their parents' help.
Most of these puzzle bundles are suitable as learning aids for all ages of children, starting as young as toddlers and preschoolers. A few of the more advanced modes teach skills better suited for first, second, and third graders, though they're still useful to help young brains get a head start on learning to multiply!
Multiplication Kids is the perfect introduction to multiplication and mathematics. Its creative and colorful design draws children in and makes them want to keep solving puzzles, and its focus on smart mini-games ensures they always step away with increased knowledge. Children usually start learning to multiply in 1st, 2nd, or 3rd grade, but there's no reason they can't start sooner!
Multiplication Kids makes learning fun, and best of all, it's entirely FREE. There are no ads, no in-app purchases, and no paywalls, just safe educational goodness for your entire family.
Note to Parents:
We created Multiplication Kids as a passion project, hoping to provide the best possible learning experience for children of all ages. We're parents ourselves, so we know exactly what we wanted to see in an educational game!
We released the app for free with no in-app purchases or third party ads. Our goal is to provide a safe and accessible learning resource for as many families as possible. By downloading and sharing, you're contributing to better education for children around the world.
Thanks for all you do for your kids!
- Best wishes from the parents at RV AppStudios

bluejetty:00095575:ios.summary:

Welcome to our fun and educational app, designed to help children build early learning skills through play. With a variety of interactive activities, your child can explor
bluejetty:00095575:ios.description:
Want your kids to learn while having fun?
We’ve got just the thing!
Welcome to our fun and educational app, designed to help children build early learning skills through play. With a variety of interactive activities, your child can explore games they enjoy, practice important academic skills, and build a foundation for future learning. No third-party advertising.
Main Features:
- Kindergarten learning games
- Fun themed collectibles
- Progress tracking for parents
Mathematical Fun
These math games for kids help children recognize and write numbers, compare values, color by numbers, and count objects. With number comparison, addition, and subtraction activities, your child can practice essential early math skills in one app.
Logical Challenges
Kids can enjoy engaging logic games that sharpen their thinking. They will identify the correct objects, shapes, and colors, compare items to answer questions, draw, play drag-and-drop games, feed animals, and complete sorting activities.
From Letters to Words
These reading and spelling games for kids ages 3 and up help little ones recognize letters and form words using visual hints. With alphabet games and vocabulary practice, children can get ready for school in a fun and playful way.
Parents’ Dashboard
You can easily track your child’s progress, achievements, and favorite games in one place. Have more than one child? Create a profile for each child so everyone can enjoy preschool games on the same device.
Something New Every Day
Kids can discover a fresh selection of games every day. They can earn stars for daily tasks and use them to open surprise gifts. These gifts include fun stickers that kids can collect in their album or place on a special board.
Our app makes learning the alphabet, math, logic, and reading fun through engaging activities: from pizza-making games, matching games, and jigsaw puzzles to ABC tracing, phonics, and many other educational games for children ages 3 and up. bluejetty:00015003:ios.description:
As a musician one of the most helpful tools you can have is the ability to slow-down, loop or auto-transpose the notes for a piece of music you are trying to learn.
AudioStretch is the world’s first audio and video transcription tool. 
Now you can manipulate the pitch, speed and transcribe your tunes from both audio and video files; or by using your phone’s camera you can capture video directly into AudioStretch and transcribe it!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
Import audio or video files
Capture video with your phone camera for transcription
Change the speed of files without changing the pitch
Listen to the individual notes as you drag the waveform
Play audio and video at zero speed
Transpose any music
Loop difficult to learn sections
With AudioStretch you get all of this in an incredibly responsive and easy-to-use app. Ideal for transcription, learning songs by ear, crazy sonic experimentation, or just listening to your music library in a new way.
Note: This is the LITE edition of AudioStretch, which has a few feature limitations. To get all the features, without the limitations, consider buying the Full version.
LIMITATIONS OF LITE VERSION:
• Max song duration 3 minutes (full version 3 hours)
• Speed range from -1.5x to 1.5x (full version -10x to +10x)
• Pitch shift +/- 3 semitones (full version +/- 36 semitones)
DETAILED FEATURES: 
• Load songs from your Music Library
• Document Picker import/export option supports iCloud, OneDrive, and more
• Open Dropbox files and email attachments via "Open In"
• LiveScrub™ : listen as you drag/hold the waveform
• Instant freeze to zero speed by double-tapping on speed display
• Keyboard/spectrum feature for transcription
• Super-fine speed/pitch adjustment via drag left-right on speed/pitch display
• Flexible looping feature
• No ads or in-app purchases
If you run into any problems with AudioStretch or AudioStretch Lite, please contact support@audiostretch.com

bluejetty:00072739:ios.description:
SUPER NINJA ENTERTAINMENT SYNTH. SUPER FUN! 
Chiptune and 16-Bit video game synth. 
Uses real synthesis and samples from actual video game chips. **
Leads, Sound FX, Inspiration, and FUN – you're gonna find it in this app! 
NOW, YOU’RE PLAYING WITH SYNTH POWER!
This app uses "real" synthesis, combined with samples for the ultimate creative control and authentic sound.
“AUDIOKIT HAVE STRUCK GOLD, PROVIDING SOME OF THE THE MOST AUTHENTIC RETRO SYNTH SOUNDS YOU’LL EVER HEAR!”
-- The GarageBand Guide, 5 star YouTube review
++ Over 400+ Presets to inspire you, including 240+ "Starter" sounds to make your own sound! ++
Exclusive Free Presets by Analog Matthew, Cokomairena, DMT Cymatics, Electronisounds, GarageBand Guide, Gavinski, Mark Hupkens, Moby Pixel, and more! 
FEATURES:
• 2,500+ Samples packed into 240+ Multi-sampled PCM instruments!
• Standalone app & iOS AUv3 Plugin
• Over 350+ presets to inspire you
• Fun free-running step sequencer
• 16-bit Synth, Drum, and Sound FX sounds included
• Over 1 GB of sounds compressed to under 120 Mb
• Audio recording, record your sounds then export wav files! No other apps needed
• Use with MIDI keyboard or iOS MIDI host
• Ableton Link
MORE FEATURES:
• Use as an AUv3 (AudioUnit Plugin) in iOS DAWs such as Logic, GarageBand, Cubasis, AUM, more
• Step Sequencer with “Magic Gate”, variable divisions, multiple oscillator & layer destinations
• Traditional Synth Engine (including Pulse Width Modulation - PWM the heart of chiptune sounds)
• On board RECORDING – easily record your melodies, and sounds and export!
• LFO: Multiple waveforms + Re-trigger + 2 Destinations
• Full ADSR (Attack, Decay, Sustain, Release for each layer)
++ Exclusive sounds made for this app... You can't get these sounds anywhere else! It's your secret sauce.
+ iPhone & iPad versions included for one low price
More Info:
www.audiokitpro.com/snesynth
** No video games themselves were sampled. The synthesis from vintage hardware sound chips was sampled. Plus, this app uses a "real" on board synth engine. We respect their pioneering work in sound design and have attempted to pay homage. We hope you enjoy the sounds and are able to be inspired! :)

bluejetty:00040928:ios.description:
Followers Reports is a tool for Instagram that provides in-depth analysis of your followers and posts with follower insight, post engagement, and discovery of Ghost followers.
Insights Tracker will give trend analysis about posts and followers on a weekly, monthly and yearly basis, as well as knowing which of your followers are not following you and which visitors are showing admiration for you.
------------------------------Follower Reports Features-----------------------------
►See who is not following you back
►See who has followed or unfollowed you
►See who has "unfollowed" you
►Followed a story
►Check your story viewer
►Check your friends in the vicinity
►Discover your ghost followers
►Know which followers you haven't followed back yet
►Identify users who have deleted their likes or comments
►Check out the most influential photos and videos
►View your Instagram Stories
------------------------------Why Followers Reports ? -----------------------------
► Who Admires You 
- Find out who’s interested in you.
► Unfollowers Insights & Tracker
- Find out which followers have lost interest in me
- Find out the followers who are blocking me.
- Find out who unfollowed you from mutual following.
► Bulk Management
- Find out followers who you don't follow them, and batch follow them back.
- Easily clean out ghost followers or those users that don't follow you back.
► Best Followers and Ghost Followers
- Find out the loyal followers who have the most likes and comments on you.
- Find out the ghost followers who have not liked or commented on you.
► Missed Connections
- Find out user liked you and comment to you but not following.
- Find out the followers you are not following back.
► Engagement Analysis of Your Posts 
- Statistics show you which past posts have had the most likes and the most comments performed.
- Statistics show you which posts have gotten the most likes/comments in the last 7/30 days.
Follower Reports contains the following subscription options:
- Yearly Subscription ($23.99 / Year ) 
- Monthly Subscription ($5.99 / Month)
- Weekly Subscription ($2.99 / Week)
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings at iTunes Store after purchase.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
Disclaimer: Follower Reports is not affiliated to Instagram or any third parties.
Terms of Use: https://fans.heysups.info/static/page/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://fans.heysups.info/static/page/private.html
Please send your questions and feedback to support@deepseafree.com.

bluejetty:00066398:ios.summary:
Going Balls: The Ultimate Speed and Balance Challenge! 
Are you ready for a high-speed runner game that tests your reflexes and mastery of physics? Download Going Balls today and experience the most thrilling arcade adventure on mobile! Jo
bluejetty:00066398:ios.description:
Going Balls: The Ultimate Speed and Balance Challenge! 
Are you ready for a high-speed runner game that tests your reflexes and mastery of physics? Download Going Balls today and experience the most thrilling arcade adventure on mobile! Join millions of players worldwide in this addictive hyper-casual hit.
What is Going Balls? 
Going Balls is an exhilarating, fast-paced ball game where your main goal is to control a rolling ball and guide it safely to the finish line on increasingly difficult tracks. It’s the perfect blend of a precision puzzle game and a heart-pounding speed challenge.
How to Play:
Swipe your screen to control the speed and direction of your ball. Master the art of balance as you navigate narrow paths, dodge unexpected obstacles (challenge!), and collect coins to unlock new balls and environments. 
The simple controls hide a deep, skill-based arcade experience!
Key Features: The Ultimate Rolling Adventure! 
* Dozens of Challenging Levels: Race through diverse worlds, from sky-high platforms to treacherous industrial zones. Each level offers a unique challenge that will keep you coming back for more!
* Realistic Physics Engine: Feel the thrill of true physics-based gameplay. Every roll, jump, and acceleration feels incredibly smooth and responsive. Balance is key to surviving!
* Customize Your Ball: Collect thousands of coins and unlock a massive collection of cool, colorful, and unique balls. Personalize your runner experience! 
* Intuitive One-Finger Control: The ultimate pick-up-and-play hyper-casual design. Simple to learn, but incredibly hard to master - perfect for quick bursts of fun or long endless sessions.
* Tons of Obstacles: Avoid swinging hammers, tricky ramps, massive wrecking balls, and unexpected gaps. Your speed and precision are your only allies!
Why You'll Love Going Balls! 
Going Balls is more than just a runner - it's an immensely satisfying experience. The rush of barely making a jump, the joy of collecting a huge stack of coins, and the feeling of accomplishment after conquering a nearly impossible challenge makes this game highly addictive.
We’ve optimized the gameplay for pure fun!
* Instant Thrills: Short, intense levels make it ideal for quick breaks.
Skill Progression: You can feel yourself getting better at speed and balance with every attempt.
* High Replayability: The pursuit of the perfect, flawless run is endless!
Download Now - Totally FREE! 
Ready to roll? Get the full arcade experience without spending a dime! 
Going Balls is totally free to download and play. Experience the ultimate physics-based challenge today!
Download Going Balls and start your speed adventure now!
