bluejetty:00160431:ios.description:
Status: TOP SECRET!
INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Activate the particle generator and create Hydrogen atoms, the atoms will begin to produce energy.
2. Combine two Hydrogen atoms and get a Helium atom, this will give you much more energy.
3. Merge identical atoms and move forward along the table of chemical elements, extracting more and more energy. You can get a lot of useful information by double tapping on atoms.
4. Accumulate energy and use it to improve the laboratory and access new technologies.
5. Complete tasks and increase your scientific status, this will open access to experiments with antimatter and neutrinos.
6. Develop your laboratory and gain access to working with a nuclear reactor and hadron collider.
7. Form and train your own team of brilliant scientists to develop technology.
What is inside?
Offline – full functionality and performance of the application without access to the Internet. Play anywhere anytime!
Idle - play only at a time convenient for you, and while you are busy, ATOM Inc. Idle will take over the gameplay. Just don’t forget to upgrade the “OFFLINE” function, then your progress will be even more noticeable!
Simulator of a scientific complex - choose your own strategy for the development of the complex: increase energy by pumping the reactor or extract antimatter by developing a collider, or maybe it’s better to put more effort into expanding the staff of scientists and their training. Your game is your development plan, your decisions, you are in charge here!
Merge – there will be many, many mergers. Combine two Hydrogen atoms and get Helium, two Helium will give Lithium, and so on until the very last element discovered by science - Oganesson. Each combination means an increase in energy production. Merge manually or use automatic merging. And if you double tap on an atom, you will get real interesting facts about it! About each of them!!!
Clicker – speed up the process of generating atoms using clicks. As a gift for such activity, you will have access to experiments with the production of antimatter, and this is a very useful resource!!!
Tycoon - you have a huge scientific complex at your disposal, develop it, organize the expansion of research tools, choose a development strategy, open new divisions and departments.
Incremental - the core of the game logic is the growth of various indicators: energy production, antimatter production, neutrino accumulation, growth of knowledge, number of open atoms, etc. This game will be a pleasant find for connoisseurs of Idle and NGU

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Activate the particle generator and create Hydrogen atoms, the atoms will begin to produce energy.

5. Complete tasks and increase your scientific status, this will open access to experiments with antimatter and neutrinos.
6. Develop your laboratory and gain access to working with a nuclear reactor and hadron collider.
7. Form and train your own team of brilliant scientists to develop technology.


What is inside?
Offline – full functionality and performance of the application without access to the Internet. Play anywhere anytime!

Idle - play only at a time convenient for you, and while you are busy, ATOM Inc. Idle will take over the gameplay. Just don’t forget to upgrade the “OFFLINE” function, then your progress will be even more noticeable!

Simulator of a scientific complex - choose your own strategy for the development of the complex: increase energy by pumping the reactor or extract antimatter by developing a collider, or maybe it’s better to put more effort into expanding the staff of scientists and their training. Your game is your development plan, your decisions, you are in charge here!

Merge – there will be many, many mergers. Combine two Hydrogen atoms and get Helium, two Helium will give Lithium, and so on until the very last element discovered by science - Oganesson. Each combination means an increase in energy production. Merge manually or use automatic merging. And if you double tap on an atom, you will get real interesting facts about it! About each of them!!!

Clicker – speed up the process of generating atoms using clicks. As a gift for such activity, you will have access to experiments with the production of antimatter, and this is a very useful resource!!!

Tycoon - you have a huge scientific complex at your disposal, develop it, organize the expansion of research tools, choose a development strategy, open new divisions and departments.

Incremental - the core of the game logic is the growth of various indicators: energy production, antimatter production, neutrino accumulation, growth of knowledge, number of open atoms, etc. This game will be a pleasant find for connoisseurs of Idle and NGU

bluejetty:00160118:ios.description:
Verti Administradora
Tanto pelo site da Verti quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a Verti, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,

bluejetty:00022473:ios.name: Analogue - BW Darkroom
bluejetty:00022473:ios.summary:
Do you miss your old darkroom or ever wanted to try one yourself?
Analogue is the first app where you truly go analog. 
By developing your photos as one did in a real darkroom, you will learn to see and understand what makes a great photo.
bluejetty:00022473:ios.description:
Do you miss your old darkroom or ever wanted to try one yourself?
Analogue is the first app where you truly go analog. 
By developing your photos as one did in a real darkroom, you will learn to see and understand what makes a great photo. 
DARKROOM
For the first time you will develop the negative in a real darkroom.
In a fun and intuitive way you will pick the strip that has the best time and contrast.
And just like a real darkroom, you can make parts of the image brighter and darker by blocking or adding more light to the image.
You will be presented in a very easy way with lots of tutorials on how to use the tools.
The images will only be in black and white (but you may tone them). 
DARKROOM FEATURES
+ Develop either your images from your camera-roll or taken by the Large-Format camera
+ Only Black & White
+ Stripes - As in a real darkroom you'll have to find the best strip. It will be challenging, fun and very powerful
+ Crop / Rotate - Both crop and rotate the image in the same tool
+ Dodge - Make a selected part of the image brighter.
+ Burn - Make a selected part of the image darker
+ Blur - Enhance the background with some beautiful blurriness.
+ Tone - Tone the images with various strength. The toners that can be used are Selenium, Cyanotype and Sepia.
+ Layers - You can add as many effects as you want. Each effect will be treated as a layer that can be edited, deleted and changed its visibility.
+ Zoom - You can zoom the image ten times. This will make it really easy to make the detailed work.
+ Metal - Analogue uses Metal, the drawing is fast and very fluid.
CAMERA
By shooting with a large-format camera where the image is upside-down you will actually get more control over the image.
The camera is only manual and back in the old days you could not even zoom with the camera, you had to walk.
You will be forced to slow down the process and by doing so, your photographs will be so much better.
At first it may feel a bit odd to look at the upside-down image and it can even be a bit challanging to know if you should move the camera to the left or right when framing the image.
Sometimes you will even laugh at yourself, but the more you use it, the less you will even have to think about it.
MORE CAMERA-MODELS
Analogue has now added two more camera-models.
+ Medium-format which will produce a square image and just as the large-format camera it is manual.
+ Pinhole camera which is a real basic camera where you pretty much only shoot at what you see. Nothing to set up with, nor zoom.
CAMERA FEATURES
+ Manual - Just as in a real old analog camera, it is only manual
+ Shutter / ISO - You will set these individually
+ Focus - With a beautiful crafted loupe, you will get full control over the sharpness
+ Tilt / Shift - Just as a large-format camera you will be able to straight up any lines
+ 4x5" - The negative's size will be in the 4x5-ratio as the most popular large-format camera does
DIGITAL NEGATIVE
For the first time, you can produce real digital negatives for your darkroom.
Analogue will make it possible to print the images in 35-mm, 6x4.5, 6x6, 4x5" or 8x10" sizes.
EXAMPLES
Download free examples and view them in the darkroom to understand how to fully use the darkroom to its best.
SHARE
You can naturally share both the negatives and prints.
You can optimize the resolution to lots of social media's sites like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter
Tag your photos with #analogueapp on instagram
See what type of beautiful images that can be made at
https://www.instagram.com/miiamapps/
SUPPORT
We are eager to hear from you. We just love to hear both good stuff and bad stuff.
And it's much likely that your opinion will be added into the next update.
Please don't hesitate to contact us at:
support@miiam.net

bluejetty:00071249:ios.name: Sea Battle Warship Fleet
bluejetty:00071249:ios.summary: Take command and prepare for an exciting naval strategy experience in this Sea Battle Warship Fleet Game. Plan your attacks, hide your vessels, locate enemy positions, and use smart strategy to become a skilled commander. Designed for fans
bluejetty:00071249:ios.description:
Take command and prepare for an exciting naval strategy experience in this Sea Battle Warship Fleet Game. Plan your attacks, hide your vessels, locate enemy positions, and use smart strategy to become a skilled commander. Designed for fans of tactical games, board games, and military challenges, the game combines simple rules with competitive gameplay.
Prepare your Warship. Organize your fleet. Search the sea. Plan your war and prove your tactical skills.
Classic Naval Strategy:
Place your fleet carefully before combat. Make every move count. Study enemy attacks, and use your strategy to discover hidden positions.
Prepare for a sea battle where every ship matters. A well-planned war can change the outcome. Position each ship carefully and think ahead before making your next move.
Online and Offline Gameplay:
Choose online gameplay to compete against other commanders and test your tactics against real opponents. Send your commander into a sea battle and see how effectively you can manage your fleet.
Prefer playing without an internet connection? Choose offline gameplay to practice positioning and improve your strategy. Use each ship placement to develop better tactical decisions.
You can also enjoy a 2 player match with a friend. Challenge someone directly, place your vessels, and discover who can make better tactical decisions.
Play With Friends:
Invite a friend and start a 2 player challenge. Each commander controls a warships and searches carefully for hidden targets.
A 2 player match is easy to understand but difficult to master. Watch opponent moves, remember previous attacks, and adjust your strategy throughout the game. Guide your commander through another war and protect every ship.
Command Your Warship:
Prepare your Warship and enter the sea. Every vessel has a role, and every position can influence the result. Think before attacking and avoid revealing too much information about your formation.
Use your naval knowledge to plan an effective formation. Identify patterns and gradually narrow down possible locations. Your Warship must remain protected while you search for the opposing fleet.
The goal is straightforward: locate opposing vessels and destroy them before your own positions are discovered. Every ship can become an important part of your tactical plan during a sea battle.
Tactical Naval Combat:
Warship delivers a focused naval experience for players who enjoy tactical challenges and use every fleet battle to sharpen your decisions.
.
A strong war formation can make it harder for opponents to discover their positions. Use your Warship knowledge, improve your strategy, and make smarter decisions with every War.
A successful sea battle depends on patience, observation, and tactical planning. Study the enemy, protect your ship positions, and look for opportunities to weaken the opposing fleet.
Multiple Ways to Play:

bluejetty:00129134:ios.description:
Escape from the castle, full of tricks and mysterious puzzles. This escape room game will challenge your ability to solve puzzles!
The Terrible Villain grabbed the Princess and set traps on the way to her rescue. A brave knight can save the princess hidden in the tower of the castle! Forward to adventure! Wander the mysterious corridors of the castle, solve puzzles, and avoid traps to find the faraway tower. There'll be hundreds and hundreds of doors, spikes, platforms to jump on, and all this in order to find the treasured key. Take a close look at the room and read the clues (or riddles?) to figure out how to escape the room.
- 120 unique levels, packed with escape puzzles
- unusual ways to escape the room
- hundreds of doors you'll have to open in your way to saving the princess
- excellent combination of logic games and relaxing 2d platformer games
- light humor will make you smile :)
You won't want to stop solving puzzles! Explore the castle that holds more tricks and secrets than it appears on the surface, and enjoy this fun puzzle game!

Canceling trial or subscription
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use sticker packs marked as Premium.

Join the adventure and become the master you were destined to be. Download Archery Pro today and unleash the archer within!

Plan the perfect wedding that My Town has ever had! Invite guests and create a big party! My Town Wedding planner game is a fantastic game for girls! Decorate a cake, choose a bride dress and arrange a wedding party with DJ and decorations!
My Town Wedding game offers 6 different locations! Play a game with no rules, and make sure you explore all dollhouse rooms. Meet and play with all characters! My Town dollhouse games can be so fun!
WEDDING DAY ARRIVES – SHE SAID „YES“!
Your to-do list is complete? Make sure that all wedding tasks are done! Visit a dress-up store and choose a perfect dress for a bride or a tuxedo for a groom. There are many wedding dress designs that you can choose from. Play dress-up games all day and enjoy customizing all characters.
MY TOWN WEDDING GAME FEATURES:
• Organize the perfect wedding
• 6+ different locations: Gift & Flower shop, Rooftop and more
• Find a perfect bride dress or a suit for a grom
• 14+ characters: bride & groom, family and guests
• Decorate the Wedding Salon
• Invite DJ and create a big PARTY!
• Visit a Rooftop on the 100th floor
• Create stories and have fun for hours
• Decorate Cake – pick favorite flavors
• Customize characters as much as you like
• Plan a Wedding Day and invite all guests!
PLAN A PERFECT WEDDING
Wedding bells are ringing! Make sure that the wedding salon is decorated for a big ceremony! Choose from 6 cute wedding day venues. Invite friends and create extraordinary stories by playing with all characters. Will the bride say YES? Visit the My Town Wedding game and find out!
DECORATE THE CAKE AS YOU LIKE
Make sure that DJ is on time and that the wedding salon is decorated nicely! Choose a favorite flavor for the wedding cake. You can add cool decorations to the Cake or change the colors. You will need only your creativity and imagination.
Visit a florist and pick amazing flowers for your bride. With beautiful flowers and her fabulous dress, she will shine when entering the ceremony. Play as a guest and buy gifts in the nearest gift shop. Our game offers many possibilities! It's on you to have fun!

bluejetty:00141787:ios.description:
Ollie for Meals is your family's AI meal planner, from the team behind Ollie AI, the most powerful personal assistant for families. With this app, you will get personalized meals for your family. For the full family assistant, visit ollie.ai. 
Ollie for Meals offers:
Healthy Eating, Without the Mental Load
Feeding a family every day can feel like a full-time job. Ollie makes it effortless. With just a few taps, Ollie creates personalized meal plans, healthy recipes, and grocery lists — all tailored to your family’s tastes, routines, and health goals. Save time, save money, and get back the headspace you deserve.
Meal Plans Made for Families
 • Weekly plans designed around your schedule and family preferences
 • Breakfast, lunch, dinner — even snacks — all in one place
 • Adjust anything instantly, or let Ollie handle the planning for you
Healthy Recipes, Personalized Nutrition
 • Ollie learns your family’s needs and makes healthy eating automatic — and delicious
 • Recipes written just for you using AI — not pulled from a generic database
 • Perfect for picky eaters, dietary needs, and busy weeknights
Smart Grocery Lists, Less Stress
 • Organized lists auto-generated from your meal plan
 • Tap once to order from Instacart or Amazon Fresh
 • Waste less food, spend less money, and skip the last-minute stress
Use What You Already Have
 • Snap a photo of your fridge or pantry
 • Get instant ideas for healthy meals you can cook right now
 • Reduce food waste while saving time and money
Learns With Your Family
The more you cook with Ollie, the better it gets. Every rating, tweak, or request helps Ollie fine-tune meals that fit your family’s unique lifestyle.
Dinner, Solved
And breakfast, lunch, and snacks too. Ollie takes the planning off your plate — so you can enjoy the eating, spend more time with your family, and keep everyone healthier and happier.
— 
Subscription Terms and Pricing:
The Ollie app offers a free trial that converts into an auto-renewing subscription, which gives you full access to the entire experience and app features for your trial and as long as you maintain an active subscription. A form of payment is required to start a free trial. Payment will be charged to your Apple account once your trial expires and will auto-renew at the applicable price and frequency (e.g. monthly, annually) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings > Manage Membership after making a purchase.
This app and its pricing are separate from the Ollie AI personal assistant for families. For more information on the personal assistant, visit ollie.ai.
Terms of Service: https://ollie.ai/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: https://ollie.ai/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00060709:ios.summary:
readAwrite by meb (รี้ดอะไร้ต์) แอปพลิเคชันอ่านเขียนนิยายออนไลน์สุดยิ่งใหญ่ในจักรวาล สนุกครบทุกอารมณ์ อ่านง่ายสบายตา นิยายฟรีมีเพียบ อัปตอนใหม่ทุกวัน
readAwrite คือ แหล่งกบดานสุดฟินของนักเขียนและนักอ่านหลากแนว ทั้งนิยายรัก นิยายจีนโบราณ นิ
bluejetty:00060709:ios.description:
readAwrite by meb (รี้ดอะไร้ต์) แอปพลิเคชันอ่านเขียนนิยายออนไลน์สุดยิ่งใหญ่ในจักรวาล สนุกครบทุกอารมณ์ อ่านง่ายสบายตา นิยายฟรีมีเพียบ อัปตอนใหม่ทุกวัน
readAwrite คือ แหล่งกบดานสุดฟินของนักเขียนและนักอ่านหลากแนว ทั้งนิยายรัก นิยายจีนโบราณ นิยายวาย นิยายยูริ และการ์ตูน & โดจินชิ 
แถมยังเอาใจนักเขียนและนักอ่านนิยายแชท ด้วย readAchat (รี้ดอะแชท) นิยายแชทน้องใหม่ ไฟแรงเว่อร์ แต่งนิยายผ่านแอปฯ และในคอมฯ ได้ทุกที่ทุกเวลา เลือกหมวดหมู่ได้ตามสไตล์ที่คุณชอบ 
ฟีเจอร์สุดฮ็อตจาก readAwrite
- มีระบบ Auto search เสิร์ชพยางค์น้อย อ่านสอยได้ทันที
- มีโดเนทไอเทมเจ้าแรกในวงการ ที่คุณนักอ่านสามารถให้ชานมไข่มุก พิซซ่า ซาชิมิ ฯลฯ กับนักเขียนได้
- ให้ Tip นักเขียนคนโปรด เสมือนเข้าโหมดให้กำลังใจแก่นักเขียน
- สติกเกอร์ พี่รี๊ดน้องไร้ต์ พี่ meb พี่ฮิปโป และอื่นๆ อีกมากมาย ให้คอมเมนต์กันระรัว
- ปรับจอสีให้เลือกสรรได้ถึง 4 แบบ ทั้งแบบปกติ ซีเปีย โหมดกลางคืน และโหมดมืด
- จะฟ้อนต์ใหญ่ ฟ้อนต์เล็ก ชิดริมขวา ริมซ้าย หรือตรงกลางก็ทำได้ตามใจสะดวก
- แปะลิ้งก์เพื่อขาย Paper Version ทำได้ตามความพอใจโลด
- มีระบบ Pre-order ใช้งานฟรี เป็นสื่อกลางระหว่างคุณนักเขียนกับแฟน (นักอ่าน)
- คะแนน The 1 เปลี่ยนเป็น meb coin ได้ด้วยนะเออ … เลิศจริงๆ
ผู้พัฒนาแอปพลิเคชันสุดเมพของเรา ไม่ใช่ใครที่ไหน เป็นพี่ meb ร้านอีบุ๊กอันดับ 1 แห่งสยามประเทศนี่เอง รอช้าอยู่ไย โหลดมาใช้งานกันเล้ยยย!

bluejetty:00155551:ios.description:
Cerca is the dating app that matches you with friends of friends – live in New York, LA, and cities across the US, UK, and Canada. Find us in the New York Times, Business Insider, and TechCrunch.
How It Works:
1. Every profile shows your mutual friends in common
2. Anonymously like anyone - they wont know it was you unless you match
3. Discreetly appear in their feed
4. Search and like your crush
5. Matchmake for your single friends
How is Cerca different?
Anonymity: Likes on Cerca are anonymous, eliminating the fear of rejection. Matches are only revealed when it's mutual, creating a sense of curiosity and excitement without the pressure.
Enhanced Safety: Cerca uses mutual connections to provide an additional layer of trust and accountability. Feel confident knowing that your matches are within your extended social network. Cerca naturally discourages inappropriate behavior, promoting respect and thoughtful interactions.
Quality Over Quantity: Cerca intentionally limits daily profiles to prioritize genuine connections over endless swipes. Every like has meaning, emphasizing intimacy and authenticity.
In today’s world, meaningful relationships often form closer to home. Cerca taps into this reality, helping you safely explore potential romances that may already exist in your circle.
Welcome to dating reimagined. Welcome to Cerca.
This app uses Apple's standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00168764:ios.description:
Welcome to Hulah - the dating app that empowers women to take control of their dating lives and date only better guys. On Hulah, any woman (in a relationship or single) can join and become a ringleader and endorse guys for other single women to date. Guys may also pass a background check to get instant access. This provides real-world accountability for men on the platform, making it a safer space for women to connect and date.
Here’s how it works: As a single woman going through men, you’ll only see the best of the best guys because guys on Hulah have IRL references on their profile that you can also message at anytime. It keeps things real—nobody wants their friend getting a weird DM because they acted like a clown. And don't worry guys, the ladies have references too! Hulah is the home to better guys and the greatest women.
As seen in Forbes, AskMen, Bustle, and more.
So if you're looking for a dating app that's not only fun but also safe, empowering, and filled with Better Guys, Hulah is the perfect choice. Download it now and join the community where Better Guys and great women can come together.
The app is free to use. You can, however, elevate your experience by upgrading to our Premium plans.
—————————————————
If you choose to purchase a Hulah Premium Membership, payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going into Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase Hulah Pro, you can simply use Hulah for free.

bluejetty:00186137:ios.name: National Driver Training
bluejetty:00186137:ios.summary: NDT Offers Drivers Ed for teens and adults from the convenience of their mobile device. Curriculum includes online testing & industry exclusive in-car driving guide. Our driver's ed programs for Teens and Adults is available for use in Texa
bluejetty:00186137:ios.description:
NDT Offers Drivers Ed for teens and adults from the convenience of their mobile device. Curriculum includes online testing & industry exclusive in-car driving guide. Our driver's ed programs for Teens and Adults is available for use in Texas, Colorado, New Mexico and Virginia with more States on the way. It is designed to walk you through the drivers education process conveniently from your mobile device. We have more than two decades of experience training first time drivers the skills of safe driving. Additionally, we have assisted many states with their legislation regarding driver license laws. With our technology we are able to provide the best content-based driving program for Texas, Colorado, New Mexico and Virginia residents. With our new app, new drivers can now take drivers education wherever they go with all progress being tracked regardless of the device that is used.
 Features:
 -> Free DPS / DMV practice permit test, unlimited DMV practice test attempts, so you can feel confident of your driving skills.
 -> Take your Texas DPS test online or in app - Not at the DPS! (Texas Residents Only)
 FULL DRIVERS ED COURSE for Teens or Adults
 -> Our curriculum is broken down in clear, short segments with videos to help new drivers absorb the knowledge and prepare for a lifetime of safe driving.
 -> Audio read-along available
 -> Review previous class material offline, from the convenience of your home and on any device.
 -> National Driver Training is the first state approved online program offering driver training solutions to meet the needs of teens, adults and corporations. For 20 years we have been teaching all areas of driver education and training.
 AFFORDABLE DRIVER EDUCATION
-> Parent-Taught Online Drivers Ed for Teens (TX State Certified Course 102) 
-> Adult Drivers Ed Certified Course
- > Adult First 6-hour Course
 DRIVING CLASSES ANYTIME
-> Your progress syncs automatically across all of your devices. You can start your drivers ed course on your smartphone, and finish it on your parent's smartphone, we don't judge.
 Awesome Customer Support
-> Call, text, Facebook Message or email us. We are here to help you along the way, from getting your drivers permit all the way to acing your license test.
-> Our US customer support speaks both English and Spanish.
 Obtain your permit and ace your drivers test, you will have your drivers license in no time. Can't find your program on the app? Check out our other National Driver Training programs, which includes our Defensive Driver Certified Courses on the web.
 Current Driver Education courses available in the app:
Texas Parent Taught Drivers Ed (PTDE); Adult First Time Drivers Ed (Age 18+); Colorado Teen Drivers Ed Includes the State Driver Awareness 4-Hour Course; Virginia Drivers Ed for Teen. No need to search "Driving school near me" when you can now take drivers ed from the comfort of your home, with the new Online Driver Ed app from National Driver Training.
Virginia Approved Online Course, New Mexico Approved Correspondence Drivers Ed Course; Colorado Driver Awareness Approved Course; Texas TDLR State Provider #102; Texas TDLR State Provider #2693Drivers Ed may be called Drivers Education, Permit practice, DriversEd, Driver Education, Student Driving, Texas Drivers Ed, Driver Defensive Training or Driving Lessons.

bluejetty:00033963:ios.description:
iHanoi là ứng dụng giúp người dân, doanh nghiệp có thể tương tác trực tuyến với các cấp cơ quan chính quyền tại Hà Nội. Với mục tiêu lấy người dân, doanh nghiệp làm trung tâm, ứng dụng cung cấp thông tin toàn diện, tạo kênh kết nối nhằm thu hẹp khoảng cách giữa chính quyền với người dân, doanh nghiệp. 
Các tính năng nổi bật của ứng dụng:
•⁠ ⁠Phản ánh hiện trường: Gửi phản ánh từ nhiều lĩnh vực tới chính quyền. Từ đó giúp chính quyền nắm bắt được những vấn đề của người dân và giải quyết, giúp cải thiện chất lượng cuộc sống của người dân trên Thành phố ngày một tốt hơn.
•⁠ ⁠Phản ánh thủ tục hành chính: Gửi phản ánh các vấn đề liên quan tới thủ tục hành chính, dịch vụ công.
•⁠ ⁠Doanh nghiệp, tổ chức kiến nghị: Doanh nghiệp/tổ chức có thể gửi các kiến nghị về những khó khăn, vướng mắc trong quá trình thực hiện hoạt động đầu tư, sản xuất kinh doanh trên địa bàn Thành phố để được trả lời, giải quyết kịp thời.
•⁠ ⁠Tiếp dân trực tuyến: Người dân có thể tạo & gửi phiếu đăng ký tiếp dân trực tuyến thay vì đến cơ quan chính quyền để đăng ký.
•⁠ ⁠Thông tin cảnh báo: Cập nhật các thông báo, thông tin mới nhất, chính thống từ chính quyền.

bluejetty:00023682:ios.name: Johnny Trigger
bluejetty:00023682:ios.summary:
► Johnny Trigger – International Man of Mayhem!
Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends. Do you have what it takes to bring down
bluejetty:00023682:ios.description:
► Johnny Trigger – International Man of Mayhem!
Stylish, deadly and smooth as a billiard ball, Johnny Trigger is a man on a mission in this non-stop platform shooter game where the action never ends. Do you have what it takes to bring down the underground world of the mafia? “Less talk, more bullets” – that’s Johnny’s motto as he runs, jumps, spins, slides and keeps on shooting till every bad guy’s bitten the dust.
► Trigger warning – Johnny’s on his way! 
• Thousands of levels of murderous mayhem to fight through, each demanding a unique tactical solution and speedy trigger fingers! Johnny never stops moving, so when the bad guys line up in your sights, you’ve got just once chance to get shooting.
• Be careful not to hit hostages, though. After all you’re the hero of this game, not some crazed killer! Should you accidentally end the life of an innocent civilian, it’s back to square one.
• Hit those hard-to-reach scumbags with the power of physics! Trick shots, ricochets, explosions and gravity are all part of Johnny’s crime-fighting arsenal…
• ...along with guns galore! Cause serious havoc with 57 unique weapons to collect – 11 pistols, 12 SMGs, 9 automatic rifles, 10 superguns and 4 Ultimate guns with fearsome capabilities guaranteed to give the bad guys a nasty shock. For the completist, there’s also 5 base guns, 3 bundle guns and 3 VIP guns. Basically, a shedload of guns to collect, cherish and slaughter gangsters with.
• On the subject of sheds, collect keys to unlock Johnny’s 10 awesome base rooms and get hammering to turn them into luxurious hideaways. Turns out our action hero’s quite the handyman in his free time.
• Sweet graphics and a banging soundtrack – Johnny’s world would be a great place to chill if it weren’t for all those pesky gangsters lurking round every corner. Just think how nice it’ll be once you’ve massacred every last one of them!
• More than 20 different stylish skins to help Johnny go undercover in the murky underworld of organized crime, and then blast the living hell out of it!
• Boss battles demand all of Johnny’s wits and sharp shooting as you take down the lords of the underworld in a leaping, spinning storm of bullets.
► Looking for action? Here’s Johnny!
Subscription Terms:
VIP MEMBERSHIP Access offers a weekly subscription, you will have a 3-days FREE trial period, after this period you will be charged $5.99/week. 
After buying this subscription, you will unlock following features: exclusive VIP guns, no ads, 100 gems and 10 hammers every day. 
This is an Auto-renewable subscription. The payment is charged to your account after confirmation. The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hours before the period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal as well.
End of trial and subscription renewal:
• The payment is charged to your account after a confirmation of purchase.
• The subscription is renewed unless you turn it off 24 hour before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period at the cost of the weekly subscription.
• The user may manage the subscription and auto-renewal have to be turned off by going to the user’s account settings after purchase in the Store.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Canceling a trial or a subscription:
• If you want to cancel a subscription during its free trial, you have to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/HT207865 for more information
If there is questions contact us info@saygames.by
Privacy Policy : https://saygames.by/privacy-policy/johnnytrigger

bluejetty:00169189:ios.name: Skul: The Hero Slayer
bluejetty:00169189:ios.summary:
Skul is a fast-paced action rogue-lite where losing your head is encouraged. 
Featuring 100 playable characters each with their own unique abilities and a ton of items that can create wild synergies, the battles are as electrifying as they
bluejetty:00169189:ios.description:
Skul is a fast-paced action rogue-lite where losing your head is encouraged. 
Featuring 100 playable characters each with their own unique abilities and a ton of items that can create wild synergies, the battles are as electrifying as they are challenging.
The Demon King's Castle in Ruins
The human race attacking the Demon King's castle is nothing new and has happened countless times before.
What makes this time different though, is that the Adventurers decided to join forces with the Imperial Army and the 'Hero of Caerleon' to lead a full onslaught in hopes of wiping out the Demons once and for all. 
They attacked the Demon stronghold with overwhelming numbers and succeeded in its total destruction. All of the demons in the castle were taken prisoner except for one lone skeleton named 'Skul'.
Dark Mirror Mode
Once you're through with the main story, test your skills and limits in the new challenging 'Dark Mirror' mode!
FEATURES
-You’re the last hope of the entire demon race! Play as Skul, a tiny skeleton on a path to slay the pompous heroes and save the demon king from the corrupt army of Carleon. 
-Losing your head never felt so right: try on new skulls to borrow the powers and dashing outfits of their previous owners and create synergies with unique items to defeat your enemies.
-What is dead may never die: you will not rest until you have faced all the challenges of this action-packed rogue-lite platformer.
-Let your hollow eyes feast upon vibrant, cartoony pixel-art 2D animations as you help all sorts of demonic creatures return to their original state.
-From the Mummies of Egypt to the Minotaur of Greece or even an official Dead Cells crossover… Will you spot all the fun easter eggs scattered across the game?
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 15 Optimization (including Pro Max)

Take Charge of Your Heart Health – Discover a Better You with Wellthly
Whether you’re aiming to maintain a healthy heart or actively managing specific health issues, Wellthly is your essential companion. With real-time heart rate monitoring, personalized health insights, and nutrition recommendations, Wellthly helps you achieve your heart health goals. Start today—because every heartbeat counts.
Monitor Your Heart in Real-Time：
Your heart’s health isn’t just a number—it’s every beat that adds up. Wellthly gives you real-time insights into your heart rate, heart age, and HRV (Heart Rate Variability), so you can truly understand your heart's condition. With each measurement, you'll get a "health index" that makes tracking your heart's status simple and clear.
Step-by-Step Progress for Better Health：
At Wellthly, every healthy action you take is tracked and celebrated. From morning runs to dietary changes, every goal can be easily monitored. Set personalized targets, and you'll see your progress daily—making each step toward heart health a rewarding journey.
Personalized Metrics Analysis：
Wellthly analyzes your health data based on your age, gender, and other relevant factors. Get customized guidance on your ideal heart health parameters and see how you compare to age-specific benchmarks.
Eat Well for Your Heart：
Discover heart-healthy, blood pressure-friendly, and weight-loss-oriented meal suggestions. Whether you're managing hypertension or just looking for nutritious meals to support a healthy heart, Wellthly offers easy-to-follow recipes that suit your needs.
Comprehensive Health Reports：
Generate detailed health reports that can be saved to your phone or easily shared with your doctor, family, or friends. Keep a record of your health journey and share insights for better health management.
Why Choose Wellthly?
Precise Heart Rate & Health Data: Get accurate, real-time measurements to understand your heart's condition.
Tailored Health Insights: Receive personalized analysis based on your unique health profile.
Nutritional Guidance: Improve your heart health with healthy, easy-to-make recipes designed for cardiovascular benefits.
Detailed Health Reports: Stay informed with monthly reports that track your heart health over time.
Blood Pressure & Oxygen Monitoring: Comprehensive tracking of blood pressure and oxygen levels alongside heart rate data.
Who Is This For?
Whether you're just starting your heart health journey or are already managing your cardiovascular health, Wellthly is the perfect tool for anyone looking to improve their heart's well-being.With Wellthly, you can take control, understand your body better, and live a healthier life—one heartbeat at a time.
Disclaimers
This is an application for measuring heart rate, but it is not a medical device.Please do not make any medical decisions based on the results of this application.If you need medical advice, please contact your doctor.
Download Wellthly now and start your heart health journey today!

bluejetty:00179947:ios.summary:
The best Turntable RPM accuracy test mobile app available.
See the RPM speed variations, know as wow/flutter, of your turntable in real time graphics like you've never seen before, continuous display makes it easy to make adjustments as ne
bluejetty:00179947:ios.description:
The best Turntable RPM accuracy test mobile app available.
See the RPM speed variations, know as wow/flutter, of your turntable in real time graphics like you've never seen before, continuous display makes it easy to make adjustments as necessary if your turntable allows it.
Test the RPM speed and wow/flutter accuracy of your turntable, whether 16, 33 1/3, 45, or 78. 
And now with the Worldwide RPM Turntable Accuracy Database you can research what other RPM users are finding out about their turntable's accuracy and what they think of them. 
 ● RPM is proud to be recommended by Rega Research Ltd, makers of some of the best turntables in the world.
 ● Great review by Techmoan on Youtube
 ● Used in high end TT reviews in Stereophile magazine
See the wow/flutter accuracy as the max % deviation from the average rpm of the turntable, as well as graphically in the chart.
Save all your rpm test sessions to the history log for review or sharing later.
RPM uses the gyroscope in your iPhone to determine the rotation speed of your turntable, automatically determines which speed setting you're on, and reports how accurate it is.
Simply place your iPhone on your turntable, close to the centre but doesn't have to be over the centre spindle. As the iPhone rotates the display will remain stationary from your perspective for easy reading.
The UNIQUE feature of RPM is that it shows a scrolling graph of the rpm accuracy variation over time, this shows wow/flutter effects, especially those associated with the turntable not being level, belt wear, etc. You can even detect the small drag caused by the stylus resting in the grooves of the record.
The most recent amazing new innovative feature is to visualise wow and flutter variations plotted around the vinyl centre to show a heat map of exactly where in the turntable rotation inaccuracies occur. 
There are many ways of testing the average RPM of your turntable, some turntables even have this built in, however there is no other practical way of showing the wow/flutter variation over time than RPM.
The history graph parameters can be customised to:
 - Set the moving average sample size.
 - Accuracy at which to turn the rpm circle sold green.
 - Set a duration after which the display updates will freeze so they can continue to be read after the turntable is stopped.
The RPM realtime display is reliant on the iPhones gyroscope accuracy, if you suspect yours isn't quite right then you can now use Calibration Mode to auto test and then apply any necessary correction in real time.
This auto calibration uses the compass to count the turntable revolutions, if you have an older iPhone (not iPhone 6S or newer) then this may be unreliable, in this case you can still add your own multiplier if you have done an independent calibration.
Extensive testing means we're now confident that using RPM can help you setup your turntable to be within 0.1% of its target RPM, assuming your turntable can be adjusted and is itself stable within that tolerance of course.
The World RPM Turntable Performance Database now has over 10,000 submissions from RPM users worldwide to build the ultimate resource for researching the most accurate turntables out there. Upgrade to join in and upload your own turntable data, go to Settings and make sure you have the Freeze time set then do an RPM session as normal. At the end of the time you will be asked to name your session after which you will have the option to also upload it to the World DB. You can always upload from History later too.
Upgrade to enable unlimited measurements, continuous display, all settings, all speeds, no ads.

bluejetty:00178672:ios.description:
Rubik's Connected is the classic cube reimagined and redesigned for the 21st century - a Smart and Connected Cube. 
With its new technology, the Smart Cube offers a new and exciting playing experience for all levels of players, all ages and all capabilities. Including fun interactive tutorials for beginners, statistics and challenges for players who wish to level up their game, and the world's first online cubing league and competition, turning the Rubik's Cube into a social connected world.
More than that, Rubik's Connected offers casual games that use the cube as a controller, enabling anyone to enjoy the classic toy, even if they are not interested in learning how to solve it.
Learn (for beginners) -
A fun interactive tutorial will safely guide you through the world's most known puzzles secrets. 
The tutorials breaks the complex solving challenge into small fun mini-steps, and includes videos, tips and real time feedback (from the Rubik's in your hands, to the virtual one on your screen). 
Improve (for intermediates & pros) -
Practice and monitor your progress with advanced stats and analytics. 
The App measures your play down to the milliseconds. It provides accurate data for your solve time, speed, and moves. 
The App will automatically identify your solving algorithm, and will provide you the relevant measurement for each individual step in it.
Compete (for all levels) -
The App matches include various playing modes, from fun scrambling competitions (spaceship racing for all levels) to pro's versus battle matches.
Get into the world's first leaderboard, and join live competitions. Play against your friends or vs strangers.
To ensure a fair match, The App recognizes the starting position of each player and guides them through a unique set of moves to reach a common starting position. 
Play- 
Mini-games, missions and third party games incorporate various aspects of cubing in order to improve handling skills, instincts, or simple games for pure fun.
Rubik's Connected is a one-of-a-kind smart connected speed cube, for many hours of fun!
Connect your Smart Rubik's to your iPhone or iPad, and start cubing NOW!
* Be sure that your device meets the following minimum requirements:
iPhone 6s or higher
Bluetooth version 4.1 or higher.

More than that, Rubik's Connected offers casual games that use the cube as a controller, enabling anyone to enjoy the classic toy, even if they are not interested in learning how to solve it.

Learn (for beginners) -
A fun interactive tutorial will safely guide you through the world's most known puzzles secrets. 
The tutorials breaks the complex solving challenge into small fun mini-steps, and includes videos, tips and real time feedback (from the Rubik's in your hands, to the virtual one on your screen). 

Improve (for intermediates & pros) -
Practice and monitor your progress with advanced stats and analytics. 
The App measures your play down to the milliseconds. It provides accurate data for your solve time, speed, and moves. 
The App will automatically identify your solving algorithm, and will provide you the relevant measurement for each individual step in it.

Compete (for all levels) -
The App matches include various playing modes, from fun scrambling competitions (spaceship racing for all levels) to pro's versus battle matches.
Get into the world's first leaderboard, and join live competitions. Play against your friends or vs strangers.
To ensure a fair match, The App recognizes the starting position of each player and guides them through a unique set of moves to reach a common starting position.  

Play- 
Mini-games, missions and third party games incorporate various aspects of cubing in order to improve handling skills, instincts, or simple games for pure fun.

Rubik's Connected is a one-of-a-kind smart connected speed cube, for many hours of fun!
Connect your Smart Rubik's to your iPhone or iPad, and start cubing NOW!

iPhone 6s or higher
Bluetooth version 4.1 or higher.

bluejetty:00033555:ios.description:

Alarm: Theft warning sound. Just with a simple touch to active this function, your device would emit an alarm sound, flashlight or vibration mode when your phone is moved. This helps you to detect effortlessly if someone is trying to take your phone.

Charger alarm: Notify the status of your phone. You can easily set up notifications; the app will sound an alert when the phone is unplugged. By this way, you would know whenever someone removes your phone, ensuring that your phone is always accessible and within sight.

- Excellent anti-theft function and safety security protection features
- User-friendly interface and a variety of themes, sounds to choose from.
- Easy to use and customize with simple setting steps
- Suitable for all ages.
Enjoy worry-free phone usage with Don't Touch Phone: Alarm. Download now for a safer and enhanced experience with flawless functionality.

bluejetty:00146991:ios.summary:
Randalls Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Randalls’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food, pharmacy prescriptions and fuel. Choose convenience that fits you
bluejetty:00146991:ios.description:
Randalls Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Randalls’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food, pharmacy prescriptions and fuel. Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your fuel points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Randalls for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Randalls locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
FUEL 
Now you can pay and redeem Points for Fuel in the app. Save 10 cents off per gallon for every 100 Points, up to $1 off per gallon. Drive up, fill up and go! Available at select Safeway, Albertsons, Tom Thumb, Randalls, Carrs, Acme, and Vons-owned stations. 
Download the Randalls app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

YOUR SOUL MIRROR — understand yoursel
bluejetty:00041517:ios.description:
Meet Yourself. Connect with Life.
be&one is a mirror and a compass for your everyday life — a mindfulness and digital wellness platform built around two ideas: Your Soul Mirror and Your Daily Compass.
YOUR SOUL MIRROR — understand yourself
- Meditation — over 10,000 free curated meditations, music, and soundscapes for focus, rest, and sleep.
- Mindful Journaling — 15 journal types with professional coaching prompts: 7 free, plus 8 additional premium journal types.
- Mood Statistics — check in with how you feel and explore a 15-metric system that combines mathematical analysis with 9 named academic frameworks, including Russell's Circumplex Model of Affect. You log the data; we do the math. AI-generated insights then reflect your patterns back to you as prompts for reflection. (Premium)
YOUR DAILY COMPASS — orient outward and forward
- Daily Horoscope + Mantra — a reading drawn from your birth chart, plus a daily mantra that combines your horoscope with your mood check-ins. Your first personalized reading is on us, with the mantra included.
- Your daily horoscope teaser is always visible on Home.
- Meditation matching — each day, a session suggested for how you feel.
- Mood-based small-step suggestions.
- Daily Inspiration — a morning and an evening quote, each with a photo, ready to share.
- Happenings — celestial, cultural, and seasonal moments worth pausing for.
FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: over 10,000 free curated meditations, music, and soundscapes, meditation matching, Daily Inspiration, mood-based small-step suggestions, Happenings, 7 of our 15 journal types, and the always-visible Daily Horoscope teaser.
Premium: the full Daily Horoscope report and Mantra, all 15 Mood Statistics, and 8 additional journal types.
AVAILABLE IN 12 LANGUAGES
English, German, French, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Arabic, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, and Portuguese.
PLEASE NOTE
Astrology content in be&one is symbolic and offered for entertainment and self-reflection. It is not predictive and is not medical, financial, or professional advice. be&one is not a medical service or a substitute for professional care.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
be&one Premium is available as an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use & Privacy Policy: https://www.beandone.com/privacy

bluejetty:00129593:ios.summary:

Authenticator App to help keep your online accounts secure on supporting TOT
bluejetty:00129593:ios.description:
Two Factor Authenticator is a simple and secure Mobile Authentication app (2FA Authenticator) that generates Time-based One-time authentication Passwords (TOTP). 
Authenticator App to help keep your online accounts secure on supporting TOTP websites.
This Authenticator app makes your login more secure! By automatically scanning a QR code, this authenticator app generates a one-time password (OTP) for two-factor authentication (2FA) or multi-factor authentication (MFA), to protect your log-in and accounts from hacking.
All commonly used online services like Google, Facebook, Github, LinkedIn, Dropbox, and thousands of other cloud applications can log in using the 2FA token generated by this authenticator app. With this authenticator, you can easily log into all your online accounts without having to remember various passwords. 
Authenticator app features:
-Easy and user friendly 
No account setup is required, automatically scan QR Code with this authenticator and get a one-time password to enable 2FA/MFA authentication for your login.
-Secure & Private Authy Authenticate
All data stored in Authenticator is always encrypted, even when it's stored in iCloud to ensure that you are the only one who can access your data with 2-step authorization.
- Protect your passwords
Manage & Storage your account passwords, and keeps them safe and secure behind the one password that only you know.
- Backup & Sync :
In 2FA Authenticator, you can always make a secure encrypted backup, in case you lose your device or switch to a new one. With Autentifikator all your tokens will automatically synchronize across all devices.
-Authorize with Touch ID or Face ID
Confirm your identity with the application using Touch ID or Face ID and generate one-time tokens required to log in to your online accounts.
- All Popular Accounts:
We support verification (but are not associated with) the most popular services including Facebook, Google Chrome, Coinbase, Binance Playstation, Steam, Amazon, Paypal, Gmail, MS Microsoft, Instagram, Discord, Epic Roblox, and thousands of other providers. 
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://auth.intellvis.com/log/inislab/page?k=privepolicy
Terms of Use: https://auth.intellvis.com/log/inislab/page?k=termsofuse

Never miss a beat with InPulse! Check your heart rate, log your blood pressure, and record your oxygen saturation with your iPhone.
Simply place your finger on the camera to measure your heart rate. Receive reminders to check your pulse and log your vitals on a daily basis so you can stay well and fit. Get your stress levels under control and negative emotions identified and leveled.

- Measure your heart rate using your fingertip and camera.

- Take tests to explore and manage your emotional wellbeing.

bluejetty:00146521:ios.description:
RealMaster – Canada’s Most Powerful Real Estate App
Your all-in-one destination to search, buy, sell, and rent homes anywhere in Canada — with exclusive data you can’t find anywhere else.
Why RealMaster?
- 20+ years of sold price history for the GTA, plus extensive sold data for Greater Vancouver, Calgary, Edmonton, and more.
- Instant alerts for new listings, price changes, and sold updates on any property, building, or community you follow.
- Automatic sold price estimations powered by real-time market analysis.

- Co-op housing and stigmatized property details.

- Find houses, condos, townhomes, and commercial properties for sale or rent anywhere in Canada.

- Easily manage and unsubscribe from alerts anytime.
Extra Tools You’ll Love
- Mortgage calculator, commute planner, exchange rate tracker, and transfer tax calculator.
- Yellow Pages for mortgage agents, insurance agents, accountants, and realtors.
- Home renovation & maintenance service directory.
From Toronto to Vancouver, Montreal to PEI — we’ve got Canada covered.
Whether you’re a first-time buyer, seasoned investor, or just exploring the market, RealMaster puts the power of professional real estate tools in your hands — free, fast, and easy to use.
Download now and make your next move with confidence.

bluejetty:00082706:ios.description:
Unlock the power of intermittent fasting to reach your goal weight and get healthy. No diet and no yo-yo effect. Improve your metabolic health and feel full of energy.
What is intermittent fasting?
Intermittent fasting is one of the most popular health and fitness trends. Instead of a diet, it's an eating pattern that cycles between periods of fasting and eating. It doesn't specify which foods you should eat or avoid, but when you should eat.
Today, we eat 3–4 (or more) meals per day, and never feel hungry. This requires our organs to work hard all the time, and never take a break from digesting. Our eating habits may result in obesity and health problems, such as diabetes.
When fasting, your body will detoxify, burn fat and regenerate. After a few weeks, you'll feel healthier and more active. 
Gradual fasting plans, suitable for all! 
Create your own fasting plan 13-11, 15-9, 16-10, 16-8, 18-6, 20-4, 23-1, 24, 36, 48, Custom
5+2 Weekly Plan : During the week, eat normally for 5 days, and choose another 2 days for a little control.Women take 500Kcal and men take 600Kcal on fasting days. You can choose to take it all at once, but a better choice is to divide 600Kcal into two meals, 250Kcal for breakfast and 350Kcal for dinner. The food should preferably be some food with high protein content but low glycemic index (GI). It is not recommended to completely eliminate carbohydrates. When eating, chew slowly and savor well. The fasting days need to be separated, such as Monday and Thursday. This light fasting plan is healthy, effective and easy to implement, allowing you to lose weight easily while enjoying the other benefits of fasting. It can be performed long-term, gradually turning it into a healthy lifestyle.
16-8 is the most popular fasting plan for weight loss. With 16 hours fasting period, your body will gradually get used to fasting. 
Body Status Tracker : 
Blood Sugar Rises 
Blood Sugar Falls 
Glycogen Reserve Drops 
Ketosis State 
More Features : 
- Track your weight changes 
- BMI(kg/m²) 
- Water tracker 
- Drink water reminder 
- On 'Record' Page, you can click 'Start' in the 'Daily Steps' card to read step count data from Apple Health
Privacy Policy : https://wowfitness.github.io/Privacy-Policy/ 
Terms of Use : https://wowfitness.github.io/Terms-of-Use/

bluejetty:00185623:ios.description:
Dolphins, maybe the cutest, smartest and most popular creatures of the seas. But have you ever stopped to think what’s behind this adorable façade? Why, and ocean domination plot, of course! Combine their many different species to create as many mutations as possible and help them fulfill their evil porpoise!
You simply HAVE to sea how this deep conspiracy will end. Maybe we’ll all be subjects of a peaceful New Dolphin Order, or perhaps we’ll be thrown into giant tanks to entertain thousands of dolphinspectators with our clever human tricks. Either way, the future looks fishy, so just dive in and enjoy the swim!
FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the dolphins
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar dolphins to create new mysterious creatures
• Use dolphin eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a dolphin to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many dolphin species to discover
• A mind-blowing story with fishy twists!
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No dolphins were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
You’ll dolphinitely want to play this!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00145341:ios.description:
Talk to your dog using the Dog Translator app is a fun dog simulator designed for jokes, entertainment, and pet interaction.
Dog Translator: Talk to Your Dog!
What Is Dog Translator app?
Say something to your dog and hear a funny “translation,” or choose a phrase from the phrasebook, tap the button, and let your pet listen! Try to communicate with your dog or puppy in a new and playful way.
How It Works
• Human to Dog Translator – generate dog-like sounds from spoken phrases
• Dog to Human Simulator – playful mode for fun reactions
• Dog Soundboard – barks, growls, whines, and playful sounds
• Reaction Test – try different sounds and watch your dog’s behavior
This cool app works as a dog language translator and simulator. We’ve prepared the most popular dog sounds and phrases for you. Choose any sound you like, tap to play, and watch your pet’s reaction. You can “say”: Hello, How are you, Good dog, Bad dog, I love you, Come here, No, Yes, and more.
Top Features
• Human to Dog Translator
• Dog to Human Translator
• Realistic barking, growling, and whining sounds
• Soundboard with pre-recorded dog sounds
• Interactive elements for playing with your dog
• Simple, easy-to-use interface
• Works on phones and tablets
• Perfect for fun, pranks, and playing with your pet
Sometimes dogs really react to the sounds from the app. Sometimes your pet may not understand the phrase—but they will still hear familiar dog sounds and pay attention to you.
Dog Translator is a great way to have fun with your pet, entertain your friends, and enjoy a dog simulator experience anytime. Perfect for dog lovers and puppy owners.
Please note: this app simulates a dog translator. It does not provide real communication with dogs. Pets will not actually understand or follow commands from the app.
This game was created for fun and entertainment.
Have Fun With Your Dog!

Horror Clown is a horror game. In this game, you play as Bill - the captain of Loser's Club. After 27 years, clown has come back. He kidnapped all of Bill's friends. You must go to the house of horror clown to save them.
The evil clown is the embodiment of an ancient evil creature. The clown had its original shape as a yellow light called death light, existing in the Macro Universe (Macroverse), arriving at Earth for a long time. This creature possesses magical power, which has the ability to change its shape to whoever it wants.
Every 27 years,the evil clown wakes up after a long hibernation and looks for food. The clown especially likes to eat children, so the image of the clown is chosen to appear and scare the children. However, the horror clown does not swallow the prey immediately but "eats fear" from the victim. He likes to manipulate the minds of children with wounds or tragedies.
KEY FEATURES
Hide
The object in your environment could be your salvation. Clown can’t see you cowering in the closet or under the bed! 
Solve puzzles
Try to figure out the cause of this ghoulish chaos and complete terrifying quests!
Listen
Listen carefully to your surroundings, every stray noise could completely change the situation.
Survive
Just one wrong move could be the death of you.

bluejetty:00164870:android.description:
Welcome to Anime Rift 👋, your go-to anime streaming app! Stream a massive anime collection with over 5,000 titles — including series and movies, from past seasons to the latest episodes fresh from Japan, all in Sub and Dub.
APP FEATURES:
🎨 Easy & Customizable Interface — Enjoy a relaxing, user-friendly design with customizable color themes that suit your taste, making it simple and enjoyable to find, watch, and organize your favorite anime.
📚 Huge Anime Collection & Daily Updates — Explore over 5,000 anime titles — from classics to the latest shows. Daily updates with fresh new releases straight from Japan, shortly after broadcast.
📥 Watch anime in smooth HD/FHD quality — Stream instantly or download episodes to enjoy them fully offline — no internet needed.
🗣 Choose how you watch — Original Japanese audio with subtitles or fully dubbed anime. Supported languages include English 🇺🇸, Arabic 🇸🇦, Italian 🇮🇹, and Spanish 🇪🇸 — with French 🇫🇷 and German 🇩🇪 coming soon.
📚 Organize your anime your way — Mark shows as Favorites, sort them by status like Watching, Dropped, Completed, or Plan to Watch. Create and fully manage custom lists named by you for ultimate control.
🔔 Episode Notifications — Enable real-time alerts for new episode releases — never miss updates on your favorite anime.
🕒 Smart Watch History — Automatically track your episode progress, grouped by anime or individual episodes.
🧭 Discover by Genre, Season Trends & Schedule — Browse anime by genre — action, romance, fantasy, comedy, slice of life, and more. Navigate titles by anime or by popular studios like Madhouse, Bones, Kyoto Animation, MAPPA, and Ufotable. Stay up to date with daily release schedules, trending and popular anime and movies, seasonal premieres, and coming soon titles.
👥 Character Explorer — Explore detailed character profiles per anime title — including bios, relationships, story roles, and additional info. Dive into profiles of popular characters like Madara Uchiha, Naruto Uzumaki, Sung Jin-Woo, Goku, Luffy, and Tanjiro Kamado to enrich your anime experience.
🚀 Start your ultimate anime journey today! Download Anime Rift now — stream, organize, and enjoy 5,000+ anime titles anytime, anywhere!

bluejetty:00148709:ios.description:
Stay up-to-date with your USCIS case status in real time using the USCIS Case Tracker app. Whether you're awaiting a green card, EAD, or any other immigration benefit, this app empowers you with instant access to your case status information, helping you stay informed throughout the process.
Key Features:
- Real-Time Tracking: Get instant updates on your USCIS case status as they happen. The latest information is delivered straight to your device.
- Historical Insights: Gain valuable insights into the progression of your case over time. Review historical updates and changes to understand the status changes and trends.
- Multiple Cases, One App: Easily track multiple USCIS cases within the same app. Effortlessly manage all your applications from a single, convenient location.
- User-Friendly Interface: Our intuitive design makes navigating the app a breeze. Enter your case details effortlessly and access your status updates with ease.
- Wide Coverage: Track a variety of USCIS case types, including visa applications, green card petitions, work authorizations, and more.
- Easy Setup: Simply input your receipt number and let the app retrieve your case information automatically. It's hassle-free and efficient.
Disclaimer: The USCIS Case Status Tracker app is designed to provide users with convenient access to their case status information. This app is not affiliated with the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) or any government agency. The information provided in this app is sourced from publicly available data and is intended for general informational purposes only. While we strive to provide accurate and up-to-date information, we do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of the information provided. Users are encouraged to verify case status information directly with the official USCIS website or other official channels. The use of this app does not create an attorney-client relationship. For legal advice or assistance with immigration matters, it is recommended to consult with a qualified immigration attorney. By using this app, you agree that Case Tracker for USCIS Cases is not responsible for any inaccuracies, delays, or actions taken based on the information provided within the app.

bluejetty:00155423:ios.summary:
No more being handed workouts without accountability. 
Firefly delivers personalized daily home workouts guided by an AI fitness coach that corrects your form in real time. Using your phone’s camera, Firefly builds real workout habits thro
bluejetty:00155423:ios.description:
No more being handed workouts without accountability. 
Firefly delivers personalized daily home workouts guided by an AI fitness coach that corrects your form in real time. Using your phone’s camera, Firefly builds real workout habits through verbal and visual cues tailored to your mobility level.
We can’t see your video and we never save it, keeping your workouts 100% private for you.
With Firefly, you'll get:
REAL-TIME FORM FEEDBACK
Your AI coach corrects your form and posture instantly, to help you avoid building bad habits.
ADAPTIVE COACHING 
Achieve real results by pushing yourself to match the coach's form. Either let the coach adjust as you move or lock in a difficulty.
PERSONAL ACCOUNTABILITY
Complete your daily workout by matching the coach's form on every exercise. On HARD difficulty, only full-range, properly executed reps count.
OFFLINE WORKOUT
Perform your workouts on the go without the internet. 
REVIEW & IMPROVE
See exactly what went wrong after each workout. Replay your movements with a 3D stick figure, frame by frame. No video is stored.
PERSONAL INSIGHTS
Track your progress with form grades, workout history, and streaks. 
CUSTOMIZE YOUR ROUTINE
Program your own routines. Select trained exercises from our library.
WORKOUT PROGRAMS
Stay consistent with challenges, milestones, and rewards.
SEE YOUR BEST REP MOMENT
Before finishing, Firefly shows your strongest rep. Share it instantly.
DAILY CHECK-INS
Get reminders to work out each day and stay consistent.
WORKOUT GOAL TYPES:
Stay Healthy - General full-body movement workouts to keep yourself active
Build Muscle - Strength training focused with mobility exercises for recovery 
Fat/Weight Loss - Balanced mix of workouts meant to protect your muscles as you focus on nutrition
Improve Flexibility - Mix of Yoga & Pilates focused on core strength and mobility stretches
More Energy & Stamina - Full body workout with cardio to increase endurance
FOR COACHES, TRAINERS, PHYSICAL THERAPISTS, INSTRUCTORS
Scale your coaching without adding hours to your schedule. Firefly Classroom turns your programs into an AI coach that delivers consistent 1-on-1 coaching to every client 24/7. To get in contact, visit: https://www.firefly.fitness/contact-us-business
Please exercise safely and progress at your own pace.
Terms of Use: https://www.firefly.fitness/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.firefly.fitness/privacy
Support: https://www.firefly.fitness/contact-us

bluejetty:00015277:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Greek.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Greek empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Greek required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Greek the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Greek so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in greece.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Greek.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.
Use your new skills to make friends, impress old friends, bring smiles to children, get out of jams, experience new things, speak confidently, and make your travel and cultural experience more rich and fulfilling.
