bluejetty:00030217:ios.name: Eclipse Yourself: Health Watch
bluejetty:00030217:ios.summary: Eclipse empowers users to understand their individual health journey by monitoring the core health pillars of activity, recovery and readiness. Health monitoring is so much more than tracking numbers and scores. The true value is understand
bluejetty:00030217:ios.description:
Eclipse empowers users to understand their individual health journey by monitoring the core health pillars of activity, recovery and readiness. Health monitoring is so much more than tracking numbers and scores. The true value is understanding your balance at a glance. 
QUALITY GUARANTEED
· From the makers of world leading apps AutoSleep & HeartWatch, this is the one app that brings all our expertise together - designed to unlock the true power of your Apple Watch.
· Eclipse Yourself has been developed and used by professional sports for years. What was once only available for athletes, has been crafted into a tool for everyone to help enhance your fitness levels, optimise your sleep, and assess your mental and physical readiness.
ACTIVITY - “Are you in your optimal zone, doing too much activity or too little?”
· Regardless of your health goals, everyone has an optimal zone to keep their activity in balance. Eclipse use's this activity data to display a personalised 'Road to Success', so you can see if you are in the optimal zone by building fitness, maintaining, potentially over reaching or even not doing enough.
RECOVERY - “Are you at peak recovery based on your body's needs?”
· Understand the power of sleep and the link to better overall health. Each time we sleep our body recovers, however the quality of our recovery varies.
· Eclipse use's the most important sleep metrics to display a personalised 'Peak Recovery' visual to keep your recovery in balance.
· Recovery requires sleep data from the Apple Sleep app or AutoSleep app.
READINESS - “Are you ready to perform at your best?”
· Readiness can monitor physical fatigue and mental stress, giving insights on when you are ready to perform, and when you should consider your options, such as warning signs for sickness.
· Eclipse use's this data to display a personalised 'Readiness Sunrise' visual to keep your readiness in balance.
· Readiness requires sleep data from the Apple Sleep app or AutoSleep app.
SHARE - "Share your activity levels, recovery status and readiness with other users"
· The most advanced fully integrated Apple Watch sharing platform across groups and squads.
· Compatible on both iPhone and iPad.
· View up to 6 months of data with trends and analysis.
· Sharing permissions allow users to nominate what data they wish to share.
· Secure sharing using your personal iCloud (total privacy and control).
· Setup custom groups and apply filters and views to better monitor your group.
· Sharing is part of the 'Eclipse Yourself + Share' subscription. Sharing is not required for individuals monitoring just their own Eclipse.
· Requires available iCloud storage.
DISCOVER YOURSELF - "Unique functions and insights"
· Widgets for your iPhone.
· Post workout questionnaire.
· Daily wellness survey.
· Watch app & complications.
· Heart rate variability (HRV).
· Sleep duration, fatigue & heart rate.
· Flag injuries & illness.
· Workout intensity.
· Respiration rate.
· Waking pulse.
· Training load.
· Blood oxygen.
· Exports.
· Wrist temperature variance.
· Mental readiness.
· 7 day and 28 day trends.
· Personal bests.
· Pace and distance.
· Charts and quad graphs.
· Effort comparisons.
· Plus much more.
FAMILY SHARING INCLUDED
SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
· Eclipse Yourself is free to download. Ongoing use requires an active subscription, available on a yearly basis.
· You can subscribe and pay on the App Store, using your Apple ID. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
· Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
· Subscriptions and auto-renew can be managed by the user by going to the App Store 'Manage Subscriptions' settings page.
· Read our Privacy Policy and User Terms: https://eclipse.tantsissa.com/support/privacy

bluejetty:00148669:ios.description:
Now let’s talk about the elephant in the room: elephants themselves!They’re nosy, they’re noisy and some of them can even fly! The cheek!
That’s precisely why you must mix and match different kinds of these creatures and change these bothersome traits once and for all!
It’s a mammoth undertaking, we know, but your hard work will be very relephant!

- Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the elephants.

- Drag and drop similar elephants to create new mysterious creatures
- Use elephant eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
- Alternatively, fiercely tap an elephant to make coins pop from their eggs

- Different stages and many elephant species to discover
- A mind-blowing story with wild twists!
- The unexpected mix of creature evolution dynamics and incremental clicker games
- Doodle-like illustrations
- Open ended gameplay: enjoy the freedom!
- No elephants were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Your excuse to be nosy is right here!
Please note! This game is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money. Some features and extras mentioned in the description may also have to be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00167432:ios.developer: GECEN TEKNOLOJI YAZILIM BILISIM SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
bluejetty:00167432:ios.summary: "Bird Matching Master" is a addictive game that offers a fun puzzle experience by sorting colorful birds. Your task is to arrange birds of the same color on tree branches. When you gather all birds of the same color together, they will fly
bluejetty:00167432:ios.description:
"Bird Matching Master" is a addictive game that offers a fun puzzle experience by sorting colorful birds. Your task is to arrange birds of the same color on tree branches. When you gather all birds of the same color together, they will fly away. The game comes with a collection of stunning colorful birds and offers a variety of useful features. Therefore, you'll have a relaxing time while exercising your brain.
HOW TO PLAY?
Playing "Bird Matching Master" is quite easy.
Tap on a bird and continue tapping to place it on the desired branch.
Only birds of the same color can be merged.
Plan each move carefully and use strategy to avoid getting stuck.
There are multiple ways to solve the puzzle. When stuck, you can add an extra branch to make the game easier.
Sort all the birds to make them fly away.
FEATURES
Stunning and carefully designed graphics
A simple game suitable for all ages
Difficulty increases as you progress, providing ongoing mental challenges.
Relieve stress with relaxing sound effects and ASMR.
Filled with thousands of fun yet challenging levels.
Play anytime without a time limit.
Join "Bird Matching Master" to exercise your brain and have fun becoming a sorting master!

bluejetty:00061134:ios.description:
FireAnt Mobile là phần mềm theo dõi thông tin và hỗ trợ đầu tư chứng khoán, tài chính tốt nhất trên điện thoại hiện nay. Phần mềm cũng cung cấp nhiều công cụ cho phép nhà đầu tư phân tích, tìm kiếm cơ hội đầu tư trên thị trường.
FireAnt Mobile bao gồm nhiều tính năng ưu việt như:
- Hệ thống tin tức hiển thị khoa học, được sắp xếp hợp lý giúp người xem dễ dàng tiếp cận
- Chia sẻ, kết nối, tương tác với nhà đầu tư khác. Theo dõi các chuyên gia hàng đầu trong ngành để được cập nhật những đánh giá, phân tích mới nhất.
- Các khóa học và hội thảo online giúp nâng cao kiến thức, hỗ trợ phát triển tài chính trong tương lai
- Dữ liệu realtime được cập nhật nhanh và ổn định nhất hiện nay. Giá chứng khoán trong và ngoài nước được cập nhật từng giây. Đa dạng các loại hình chứng khoán như cổ phiếu, hợp đồng tương lai, chứng quyền...
- Các thống kê đa chiều về cổ phiếu: Cung cầu, Khớp lệnh,...
- Quản lý Watchlist dễ dàng theo dõi các chứng khoán bạn quan tâm. Tự động nhận push ngay khi có tin tức liên quan tới chứng khoán bạn quan tâm
- Thông tin chi tiết về từng cổ phiếu: Giá, Thông tin tài chính, Cổ đông,...
- Phần mềm phân tích kỹ thuật mạnh mẽ
- Phần mềm bảng giá trực quan, sinh động
- Các công cụ hỗ trợ Lọc cổ phiếu, TOP cổ phiếu,... giúp nhà đầu tư dễ dàng tìm kiếm cơ hội

Phần mềm cho phép người sử dụng cập nhật các thông tin mới nhất về thị trường tài chính, chứng khoán, theo dõi các cổ phiếu quan tâm, những thống kê chuyên sâu, tin tức... Phần mềm cũng cung cấp nhiều công cụ cho phép nhà đầu tư phân tích, tìm kiếm cơ hội đầu tư trên thị trường.

FireAnt Mobile bao gồm nhiều tính năng ưu việt như:

- Hệ thống tin tức hiển thị khoa học, được sắp xếp hợp lý giúp người xem dễ dàng tiếp cận
- Chia sẻ, kết nối, tương tác với nhà đầu tư khác. Theo dõi các chuyên gia hàng đầu trong ngành để được cập nhật những đánh giá, phân tích mới nhất.
- Các khóa học và hội thảo online giúp nâng cao kiến thức, hỗ trợ phát triển tài chính trong tương lai
- Dữ liệu realtime được cập nhật nhanh và ổn định nhất hiện nay. Giá chứng khoán trong và ngoài nước được cập nhật từng giây. Đa dạng các loại hình chứng khoán như cổ phiếu, hợp đồng tương lai, chứng quyền...
- Các thống kê đa chiều về cổ phiếu: Cung cầu, Khớp lệnh,...
- Quản lý Watchlist dễ dàng theo dõi các chứng khoán bạn quan tâm. Tự động nhận push ngay khi có tin tức liên quan tới chứng khoán bạn quan tâm
- Thông tin chi tiết về từng cổ phiếu: Giá, Thông tin tài chính, Cổ đông,...
- Phần mềm phân tích kỹ thuật mạnh mẽ
- Phần mềm bảng giá trực quan, sinh động
- Các công cụ hỗ trợ Lọc cổ phiếu, TOP cổ phiếu,... giúp nhà đầu tư dễ dàng tìm kiếm cơ hội

- Gói MIỄN PHÍ
- Gói Tiêu chuẩn: 149.000 VNĐ/tháng
- Gói Chuyên nghiệp: 399.000 VNĐ/tháng

bluejetty:00085618:ios.description:
Joined by over a million couples. Debatium is the daily ritual that keeps you close, together, wherever you are.
Couples don’t drift apart overnight. They just stop talking, one day at a time. Debatium is the small habit that keeps your connection alive: two people, two phones, one shared space.
Every day there’s a new question waiting. You each answer on your own, then reveal what your partner said. It takes a minute.
EVERYTHING YOU SHARE
• Daily question: one a day, answers hidden until you both reply.
• Your streak: keep it going day after day and watch it grow.
• Shared drawing: one canvas you fill in together.
• Photo of the day: share a moment and it lands on your partner’s home screen.
• Kiss: send a kiss that pops up live on their phone.
• Your dates: plan your next outings and time together.
• Important dates: your anniversary, your firsts, everything that matters.
• Distance: see how far apart you are, without ever sharing your exact location.
• Widgets: your relationship on your home screen, one glance away.
FOR EVERY COUPLE
Whether you live together or miles apart, three months in or ten years strong, Debatium fits your story. No lessons, no pressure. Just a little care, every day.
BUILT TO LAST
Debatium isn’t a one-night app. It’s a habit for two, made to nurture your relationship week after week. The more you come back, the more you learn about each other.
FAIR, AND AD-FREE
No ads. The daily question is free. And Premium is shared: the moment one of you upgrades, the other gets it too. No double payment.
Download Debatium, invite your partner, and answer your first question today.

Privacy Policy: https://lesignobles.com/projects/debatium/privacy/

bluejetty:00146048:ios.description:
Our app allows users to effortlessly cast their phone's screen to any compatible smart TV wirelessly, ensuring a lag-free experience. This versatile app is perfect for various activities, such as giving presentations or enjoying movies on your TV.
How to Use It:
To start mirroring your phone’s screen to your TV, ensure both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Open the app, connect to your TV, and select the "Screen Mirroring""button. Follow the on-screen instructions to begin mirroring without any delay. The app offers a premium version that unlocks all features.
Features:
- No need to install any app on your TV
- Wirelessly mirror any application or game (for viewing) from your iPhone/iPad to your TV over your Wi-Fi network
- Stream or cast photos, videos, and music from your iPhone/iPad to your TV
- Cast any web videos to your TV
- No cables, additional hardware, or other equipment required
Information about the subscription:
Payments for subscriptions are charged through your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation, and subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00069707:ios.description:
Will help you to avoid to avoid bill shocks when you are on internation roaming- with a home screen widget, Apple Watch support and alerts before you hit your carrier's limit. No VPN required.
App shows how much data you've used, how much is left and how many days you can safely use it without hitting your limit.
Works with all network types - 5G, LTE, 4G, 3G, Wi-Fi and international roaming.
REMAINING AT A GLANCE
Monitor Cellular, Wi-Fi and Roaming usage in one place
See Remaining data, Days left and Per-day allowance at a glance
Understand monthly trends with a clear bar graph of your billing periods
Tap any bar to see a color-coded upload vs download breakdown
REAL-TIME · NO VPN · NO SERVER
All monitoring happens on-device using live network interface counters. No VPN profile is installed. No data ever leaves your phone. 100% private, 100% on-device.
DAILY & MONTHLY HISTORY
Track today's and yesterday's usage separately
Review up to the last 6 billing cycles with per-period totals
Quickly spot spikes so you can avoid overages and throttling
HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Add the InternetTracker widget to your Home Screen
See Remaining / Days Left / Per Day plus Today & Yesterday usage without opening the app
Tap the widget to jump straight into the correct mode (Cellular, Wi-Fi or Roaming)
APPLE WATCH
Use Apple Watch complications to see your status at a glance
View your current remaining data and days left on Apple Watch
Check usage while traveling, right from your wrist
Data is synced from your iPhone so your watch always reflects your latest usage
SMART ALERTS
Set your monthly limit and billing cycle day once per bearer (Cellular, Wi-Fi, Roaming)
See a clear status banner: within limit, nearing limit or exceeded
Optional alerts before you hit your configured threshold
ROAMING TRACKER - TRAVELING ABROAD?
Switch to Roaming mode to track international data separately.
Get alerted before you hit your carrier's roaming cap and avoid expensive overage charges.
INTELLIGENT GAP RECOVERY
Didn't open the app for a few days? No problem. The app estimates your usage from raw hardware interface counters and fills in the missing days automatically — so your history stays complete and your monthly total stays accurate.
INTERNET TRACKER PRO
Upgrade to InternetTracker Pro to unlock the full experience:
- Remove all banner ads across the app
- Unlock full Remaining, Daily and Monthly views with complete history
- Enable detailed monthly usage graphs for each data bearer
- Use Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch to check usage instantly
InternetTracker is designed for clarity, not clutter. Whether you're on a strict roaming plan, sharing a hotspot or just want to avoid surprise bills, InternetTracker gives you the numbers that matter - right when you need them.
Enjoying the app? A quick rating helps others find it - thank you!

bluejetty:00178728:ios.description:
Get Rent is the first tycoon game based on a real map of the United States and the world. It allows you to literally bring the gameplay into the real world. Buy, sell, and upgrade real buildings that you encounter every day on your way to work or school. From grand and famous landmarks to local shops and businesses.
Collect the best properties, combine them into collections, and invest wisely in their development.
Trade famous buildings from the United States using geolocation, such as:
- The White House in Washington, D.C. - Put your stake in the history of the United States by owning this iconic building and earn impressive rental income.
- Statue of Liberty in New York City - Invest in this symbol of freedom and create a virtual empire in the heart of New York City.
- Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco - Acquire this iconic bridge and capitalize on its popularity as a tourist attraction and landmark.
- Hollywood Walk of Fame in Los Angeles - Own a piece of entertainment history by collecting properties along this famous boulevard.
In Get Rent, you will find:
- 50 million properties to acquire.
- Compete in rankings with friends from your city, country, and around the world.
- Develop unique skills of your choice.
- Use GPS to find local properties around you.
- Manage your agents and send them to remote and interesting locations.

bluejetty:00141015:ios.summary: Dive into the heart of Blue Roche, a snow-laden Canadian town teeming with myths and monsters, where every corner hides secrets waiting to be uncovered. "Myth or Reality: Snowbound Secrets" is the adventure for fans of mystery detective gam
bluejetty:00141015:ios.description:
Dive into the heart of Blue Roche, a snow-laden Canadian town teeming with myths and monsters, where every corner hides secrets waiting to be uncovered. "Myth or Reality: Snowbound Secrets" is the adventure for fans of mystery detective games, hidden object games, and object hunt! Equip yourself to solve puzzles and brain teasers, navigate through gripping fantasy story, mysterious locations and find hidden objects!
You are an explorer of myths, a destroyer of prejudice, and a guardian of order! No ghost, no monster can hide from you! There is trouble in the city of Blue Roche though: strange footprints, eyewitness accounts of monsters... You need to get to the bottom of this! Amidst the cold, snow, and ice something is lurking... Does it want to do harm? Is it hungry? Or is it surprisingly friendly? You should be careful because you never know how the next adventure will turn out. People are always afraid of something, but sometimes their fear doesn't justify the means. It’s up to you to figure out everything that happens in a small Canadian city. And be vigilant... The hills have eyes!
Object Hunt Locations!
Traverse through the snowy landscapes of a small Canadian town filled with secrets and hidden objects. No myths and monsters remain hidden as you find hidden objects behind eerie sightings and mysterious occurrences!
Engage in Puzzle Solving!
Sharpen your mind with a variety of puzzles and brain teasers that challenge your mystery detective games skills. Progress through the adventure by solving mysteries that intertwine with the locals' tales and secrets!
Achievements to Earn!
Boost your gaming experience by completing tasks and earning achievements that commend your progress and detective prowess in the realm of hidden object games! Whether you are navigating through treacherous paths or uncovering the secrets behind the snowy hills, every moment is filled with danger and discovery.
Impactful Choices!
Make decisions that influence the outcome of the game. Your choices determine how the adventure unfolds, adding layers of depth and engagement for all adventure seekers and fans of mystery detective games.
Rich Storytelling and Characters!
Meet characters each with their own mysterious backstory and secrets. Every interaction and discovery adds to the rich tapestry of this enthralling hidden object game.
Engage in a chilling adventure where myths and reality blur with the free trial version, then unlock the full fantasy story of mystery detective games!

bluejetty:00133219:ios.name: Relaxing Tangle
bluejetty:00133219:ios.summary: Relaxing Tangle is an interactive visual simulation designed to calm your mind and reduce stress. It combines fluid movement, glowing particles, light effects, and mini-games to create a soothing, immersive experience. You can touch, drag,
bluejetty:00133219:ios.description:
Relaxing Tangle is an interactive visual simulation designed to calm your mind and reduce stress. It combines fluid movement, glowing particles, light effects, and mini-games to create a soothing, immersive experience. You can touch, drag, and play to control the motion on the screen, making each moment feel unique and relaxing.
It is especially helpful for people who feel overwhelmed, anxious, overthink, or just want a peaceful break from a busy day. Many users also find it useful before sleep because the slow, flowing visuals help the mind slow down and relax naturally.
Relaxing Tangle is not a typical game. There are no scores or pressure. You simply explore, create, and unwind at your own pace.
Perfect for:
• Stress & anxiety relief
• Relaxation and mindfulness
• Focus and ADHD-friendly stimulation
• Night-time calming & sleep preparation
• Creative and sensory play
#---- Credits ----#
• Gerard Ferrandez, Akimitsu Hamamuro, Pavel Dobryakov,

• Music by Aakash Gandhi: https://www.youtube.com/@88keystoeuphoria
• Icons from: https://icons8.com/
• Terms of Use (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00177941:ios.description:
A new free to play brain teasers version of Labyrinths of World: Winter that many players will find out hidden objects and mini-games! This version has no plot differences with the original new easy hidden object games, and its main feature is that you can play the entire game FOR FREE!
While investigating Northern Light anomalies with hidden objects free for iPhone & iPad, Davona has uncovered hidden objects and distress signals coming from the Frostwind world! Something is threatening their survival, and they need the Seekers’ help with mystery adventure games! But the frigid temperatures are the least of their worries. Dangerous dragon attacks are increasing, and an old ally has turned rogue, putting all the worlds’ hearts at risk with search and find games! In a race against the clock, can you survive unfamiliar terrains and save the residents before it’s too late? Find out in these sensational seek and find games!
· STOP A DESTRUCTIVE DRAGON MIGRATION IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Continue your adventure in these finding games with an exciting Bonus Chapter! Can you resolve this problem peacefully?

We’ve prepared a lengthy list of achievements that you can get while playing hidden object adventure games. Demonstrate your skills!
· RESTORE A FROZEN GARDEN TO ITS FORMER GLORY!
Collect beautiful items on your journey through find the hidden objects and use them to create a magical garden! 
· ENJOY EXCLUSIVE WALLPAPERS, CONCEPT ART, MUSIC, VIDEOS, AND MORE!
Visit the Extra menu to enjoy bonuses that you can save on your device! You can keep your wonderful adventure with you wherever you go and free hidden object games. 
· NEVER GET LOST WITH THE STRATEGY GUIDE!
If you ever get lost on your adventure, use a handy strategy guide! It will help you solve all hide and seek games.
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Labyrinths of World: Winter! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00129634:ios.description:
تفشى المرض في جميع أنحاء البلاد واخذت معها الحضارات. لم تنجوا منها أي جيش أو حكومة. اصبحت الأرض ملك المصابين الآن. وكذلك الناجين الشجعان من اجل تحرير البلاد.
تكوين صداقات أو القتال مع الناجين الآخرين. افعل ما تريد يجب عليك البقاء على قيد الحياة. لن يكون الأمر بهذه السهولة. المصابين في كل مكان. الموارد نادرة جداً ويجب عليك إنقاذ الاحياء من المجتمع.
إنه عالم جديد هناك. خطير، نعم، لكنها مليئة بالفرص. القوة الهائلة بإنتظار هؤلاء الذين يمتلكون الجرأة الكافية لإنقاذ البلاد. ولكن تذكر ان تحمي نفسك. من العدل أن نقول إن الناس ليسوا ودودين بقدر ما كانوا من قبل...
رسومات بجودة عالية
استمتع برسومات ثلاثية الأبعاد متطورة مع بيئات تم إنشاؤها بواقعية و اسلحة بتفاصيل مثيرة للدهشة.
إنقاذ
حماية الناجين لزيادة عددهم و زيادة قوتك. تحديد موقع الابطال ذوي القدرات الخاصة، وسوف يكونون أبطال ضد حرب الطاعون!
البحوث
مرض الزومبي يتفشى بسرعة. تعلم كل ما يمكنك لفهم أسباب المرض. كل من يستطيع السيطرة على المصابين الذين يسيطرون على البلاد!
تكوين صداقات
كثرة العدد نوع من انواع القوة. إنشاء حلفاء وإقامة شراكات استراتيجية للبقاء على قيد الحياة من أهوال البرية المصابة. انضم للقوى القوية لسحق أي شخص يحاول استغلالك.
تحتوي هذه اللعبة على عديد من الخرائط و المستويات برسومات عالية و تعتبر من العاب سباق الاقوى. يمكنك تحدي اصدقائك او اللعب منفرد ومشاركة النتيجة مع اصحابك. وتاتي هذه اللعبة بشكل 3d.
تم تطويرها لتكون اقوى لعبة لهذا العام و الميزات التالية:
- تصوير داخلي
- مرحلة حرة لتستمتع بها كيفما شئت
- اسلحة مميزة بتصميم واقعي
- افضل الخرائط و المستويات الرائعة
- طور سلحك المفضل
اكتشف سر حب الملايين حول العالم لهذه اللعبة الممتعة،
شارك اصحابك المتعة والمرح في هذه اللعبة الصعبة للعديد من اللاعبين فهل انت منهم؟
متعة وتحدي بشكل فوري
بدون تسجيل٫ بدون تعقيدات٫ ابدأ اللعب مباشرة واستمتع
لعبة بسيطة ولكنها تسبب الإدمان

bluejetty:00068878:ios.description:
Easy to use scanner. Convert scans into PDF for easy sharing.
*Free version offers 5 scans every month. Upgrade to Pro to remove the limit*
The app can export scanned documents as PDF and also does text recognition (OCR). You can easily access all text content or perhaps just the website address or phone number.
You scanned documents are automatically saved to iCloud Drive and available on all your Apple devices.
iPad version supports drag and drop so you can quickly drag scanned documents to other apps.
| Scan
Scan one or multiple pages and adjust the edges if needed before saving the final scan. The app automatically detects the edges of the document for better experience.
You can rotate the scanned document or apply Grayscale, Black & White or Photo filters. Just make sure to do these edits before confirming the scan.
| Export
Easily share scanned documents as individual images or create PDF from all the pages in one scan.
| iCloud
All scanned documents are automatically uploaded to your iCloud Drive for easy access and backup. Just look for the "Scan it" folder. You can also customize this to export single PDF from multiple scans.
| Text Recognition
Scan it features OCR which means that scanned text will get recognized and you can quickly make use of it. For example if you scan business card you will get tappable links in results allowing you to make a call, send an email, open Safari or maps depending on the contents.
This recognized text can also be easily shared.
Examples where app can help:
* Scan business cards to quickly save contact information like an email or phone number
* Scan receipts to keep track of expenses
* Scan interesting book pages or other articles for later
* Scan and archive invoices and other important documents
* Paper notes, mindmaps and other important texts so you never lose it

bluejetty:00121003:ios.name: Canasta Jogatina: Card Games
bluejetty:00121003:ios.developer: GAZEUS GAMES SERVICOS DE INTERNET S.A.
bluejetty:00121003:ios.summary: Canasta has many variations, but in its essence, it’s a rummy-like card game where you create melds of cards of the same rank. Canasta Jogatina has two different game modes, classic and turbo. Play with 2 or 4 players and make many Canastas
bluejetty:00121003:ios.description:
Canasta has many variations, but in its essence, it’s a rummy-like card game where you create melds of cards of the same rank. Canasta Jogatina has two different game modes, classic and turbo. Play with 2 or 4 players and make many Canastas by melding at least seven cards of the same rank.
Check out some of the features of the Canasta Jogatina game:
- Classic or Turbo mode: Choose between Classic Canasta mode, with multiple hands and points adding up to 5000, or the Turbo mode, a quicker variation enabling you to play shorter matches!
- Partners: Choose between 2 or 4 players mode.
- 3 difficulty levels: Easy, Medium and Hard.
- Play on your own time: Game is automatically saved each turn, so you can close it and continue playing later.
- To err is human: Undo function so you can cancel mistaken melds.
- Make the game your own: customize your decks, background images and animation speed.
- Complete Stats: Delve into your match statistics and keep up with your results.
Canasta Jogatina is a wonderful pastime for the dull moments and an excellent way to relax in the evening after an eventful day.
If you like card games like Gin Rummy, Bridge, Buraco and Hearts, you will love Canasta.
So what are you waiting for? Download Canasta Jogatina now and relive your childhood with this classic card game. It’s free!

bluejetty:00037327:ios.description:
Nothing X - Your All-in-One Smart Device Manager
Nothing X is a professional smart device control and management platform. It supports quick pairing with its smart watches and earbuds, enabling seamless device connection and efficient management.
Device Management
- Connect and manage Nothing X smart watches and earbuds, easily controlling all device functions.
Personalized Customization
- Support for customizing functions on watches and earbuds based on personal usage habits, creating a unique user experience.
Health Monitoring
- Real-time detection of health data such as sleep quality, heart rate, and blood oxygen. Multi-dimensional tracking of health status provides reference for a healthier lifestyle.
Fitness Tracking
- Real-time recording of daily activities and fitness data, including running routes, heart rate, and step frequency—all fitness metrics are clearly visible.
【Tips】
- This app supports syncing data to Apple Health, where you can view your health data.
- GPS is used for recording running routes and updating watch weather; GPS remains active when the app runs in the background during workouts.
- Device functions depend on hardware; detected data is for reference only and not intended for medical diagnosis.
【Contact Us】
If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while using the product, you can submit them by going to "My - Help & Feedback" in Nothing X, or by visiting the link: https://nothing.tech/pages/contact-support.

bluejetty:00078298:ios.description:
“Would you dare to betray with me?”
Unexpectedly meeting death during a mission, “I” am confronted by a mysterious “voice”
And so, the “voice” offers “me” a shocking deal.
Can this daring mission and deal be successfully completed?
To survive, I must win both his heart and his body!
[Story]
Waking up from death, I see things that seem out of this world!
And a mysterious voice tells me,
“If you want to return to your world, save “Him”
But I have no idea who “He” is!
Moreover, the royal palace I suddenly enter is even more “deteriorated” than I thought…
Eventually, “I” get entangled in a complicated and sticky web of relationships.
“I” witness a secret scene of the queen.
And to hide this fact, the queen and her lover begin to threaten my life!

Who exactly is “He” that I need to save?
Can “I” fulfill the mysterious voice’s “inquiry” and return to my world?
“I will now follow my heart and body rather than keeping up my images”
-The cursed but irresistibly charming “King”
“The grass looks greener on the other side~”
- The slightly insane but irresistible “Dark Mage”
“If it’s you, I can offer my purity..”
- The stoic yet deeply romantic “Knight”
“I’m willing to sacrifice my life for your happiness.”
- The handsome “Foreteller” even behind the mask
[Recommended for]
 - Adults seeking high-level, mature stories
 - Fans of reincarnation, regression, and transmigration narratives
 - Arthurian Legends’s Fans
 - Handsome male characters enthusiasts
 - Fantasy romance enthusiasts
 - Players who enjoyed 'Love Pheromone' and 'Eternal Afterlife'

bluejetty:00023775:ios.summary:
Artista Impresso has been chosen as the official app of the Macy’s® Art in Bloom Flower Show—A Springtime Celebration of Imagination and Creativity! 
Transform your snapshot into a stroke-filled Impressionist masterpiece
Artista Impresso
bluejetty:00023775:ios.description:
Artista Impresso has been chosen as the official app of the Macy’s® Art in Bloom Flower Show—A Springtime Celebration of Imagination and Creativity! 
Transform your snapshot into a stroke-filled Impressionist masterpiece
Artista Impresso — Passion Filled Impressionism
The 19th century brush-wielding Impressionist artists were crazy about flowers and gardens, and it was good. With flowing brush strokes and thickly painted texture, Van Gogh made his sunflowers immortal; with harmonious movement of color, contrast, and form, Monet made his lily pond a celebrity. It took their genius, lifetimes of practice, and navigating the riot of their senses, but these extraordinary artists took what they saw and felt in the petals and leaves and transferred their impressions onto canvasses full of beauty, mood, and meaning. 
Lucky you, 21st century iPhone-wielding seer and lover of beauty—you have Impresso. With the same enduring attention to detail, light, color, and texure, Impresso transforms your photos into multi-textured, stroke-filled Impressionist masterpieces. And keen eyes will love how Impresso maintains the balance of your piece! The result—captivating, print-worthy paintings brimming with passion, life, and beauty. 
IMPRESSIONISM STYLES
Alla Prima—uses a small brush inside an already placed detail ellipse tool for up-close or full-length portraits and still lifes. Included with this beautiful paint style is a library of artistic finishes to fill the painting with light and color
En Plein Air—creates a stroke-filled landscape using one of the eight color palettes created by famous impressionist artists.
FEATURES

bluejetty:00120523:ios.description:
Various trains pass through the railroad crossing. 
Many types of trains, including regular trains, bullet trains, and maglevs, will pass by. 
Icons will appear from the bottom left. Try tapping them! 
This is a train game where you can transform into various bullet trains, regular trains, SL (steam locomotives), or maglevs.
Other surprises will also appear on the screen, so tap around and see what happens!
-Maglev Icon**: Transforms into a maglev train for a limited time. 
-Conventional Line Icon**: Transforms into various regular trains. 
-Shinkansen Icon**: Transforms into a bullet train for a limited time. 
-SL Icon**: Transforms into a steam locomotive for a limited time. 
-Scenery Switch Icon**: Changes the train route to a different location. 
-Whistle Icon**: Sounds the train whistle.
There are 4 types of special items. When used, the corresponding button can be used freely for a limited time. 
1.Big Button**: Tap this icon to make your train grow bigger in two stages. 
2.Freight Train**: Tap this icon to make a freight train pass by. 
3.Never-Opening Crossing**: Tap this icon to make a large number of trains pass by. 
4.Cross the Railroad**: Tap this icon to have various pedestrians cross.
Special items are also available in the scrollable icon menu. 
You can use one tap's worth of a special item without consuming a heart.
● Many working vehicles pass in the foreground road. Tap on them — patrol cars, ambulances, fire trucks, and city buses may appear.

bluejetty:00180826:ios.name: Dominoes Game - Domino Online
bluejetty:00180826:ios.summary: Dominoes is one of the most popular board games in the world. With awesome graphics and animations and an intuitive user interface, play this classic board game online and challenge players from all over the world. Super fun and easy to pla
bluejetty:00180826:ios.description:
Dominoes is one of the most popular board games in the world. With awesome graphics and animations and an intuitive user interface, play this classic board game online and challenge players from all over the world. Super fun and easy to play. Also perfect for developing logical thinking and enhancing memory.
GET RID OF ALL YOUR DOMINOES
In order to get the pieces/tiles together, the number of pips at the end of each of the tiles must match. The goal of the game is to get rid of all your dominoes before your opponent. Easy, right? You just need to match the tile you have with one of the ends already on the board. Set up a strategy and choose your plays carefully.
3 GAME MODES
The player with the highest double domino starts the game.
Each round, play until one player has no dominoes or until all players are blocked.
First player to run out of dominoes wins the round!
DRAW DOMINOES
All dominoes can only connect to 2 other dominoes (no spinner).
If you are stuck, you can pick a domino which hasn't been distributed yet from the boneyard.
Players start the next rounds alternatively.
First player with 100 points wins the game.
BLOCK DOMINOES
All dominoes can only connect to 2 other dominoes (no spinner).
If you are stuck, you have to pass until a move is possible.
Players start the next rounds alternatively.
First player with 100 points wins the game.
ALL FIVES DOMINOES
The first double became the Spinner. The Spinner can be connected to 4 other dominoes.
When you set a tile, the 2, 3 or 4 ends of the board are summed up. If this total is a multiple of five (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 or 35 points), you immediately score that number of points.
If you are stuck, you can pick a domino from the boneyard.
The winner of the last round starts the next round with any tile.
First player with 200 points wins the game.
CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Play against real players from all over the world or create a private room and invite a friend to play. You can also play offline and test your playing skills against our challenging AI. Show how good and smart you are!
CLIMB THE LEADERBOARD
Track your stats and improve your performance. You will love this game and you won't stop playing until you are the number 1. Compete for the top.
CUSTOMISE AVATAR AND THEMES
Clean and user-friendly design to ensure you can enjoy and focus solely on the game without any fuss or unwanted interruptions.
A great selection of board design and domino tiles themes for you to choose from. Customise your avatar and choose a country. Play to win coins and unlock them all.
TEST YOUR SKILLS
Have fun and sharpen your mind playing different game modes. Learn all the tricks and strategies. With lots of practice and a little bit of luck you will be unstoppable.
Are you a Dominoes master?
Go ahead, look no further. Download and start playing now!

bluejetty:00070317:ios.summary:
Ferrite is the award-winning app you need for creating podcasts, radio journalism, or other professional voice production work — lectures, speeches, voice-overs and more.
It combines the ease-of-use of a “voice memo” audio recorder, with a
bluejetty:00070317:ios.description:
Ferrite is the award-winning app you need for creating podcasts, radio journalism, or other professional voice production work — lectures, speeches, voice-overs and more.
It combines the ease-of-use of a “voice memo” audio recorder, with a versatile multi-track editing studio. Powerful tools like effects and automation are available when you need them. With time-saving features and a UI designed to get out of your way, people around the world are switching to Ferrite.
— Streamlined Recording —
Open Ferrite and with just one tap you’re recording. No fuss, and it won't break a sweat even with hours-long sessions. Just make sure your device has enough free space!
Recording an interview and you want to highlight a few quotes? Have to take out some inappropriate language? Or just fluffed a sentence and need to fix it? Bookmark moments during your recording and they’ll be flagged up during edits, so you can jump right to them.
Monitor levels with live recording meters, or listen through headphones. Tag your audio to find it quickly later. And of course you can import audio from your Music Library, iCloud, and other services such as Dropbox.
Please note: the free version has limited duration for recording & editing projects. Upgrade to Pro and you can edit projects up to 24 hours long!
— Editing is a Snip —
Ferrite features full multi-track editing, from quick cuts, to producing a complete podcast or broadcast package. Zoom out to see hours at a glance, or zoom in all the way down to individual samples.
Take a single clip, or a bunch, and arrange them in an editing project: move, crop, slice, fade in and out, or crossfade between clips just by overlapping them. You have full control over each track’s volume and panning, and can Mute or Solo as needed.
And best of all, you needn’t fear trying out changes: Ferrite has great Undo/Redo — even if you quit the app and come back a month later, you can still undo all the way back to the moment you created your project!
— Advanced Features —
Need more? Ferrite also includes:
• Automatic ducking: set tracks to “duck under” others (e.g. ducking music behind voiceovers).
• Strip Silence: Carves away all the silent sections from a recording, making it easy to edit the remaining audio.
• (iPad only) Split View and Slide Over support: Use Ferrite side-by-side with other apps. Recording a narration? Open another app with your script and place Ferrite down the side of the screen. Or open the User Guide in Safari on one side while you learn Ferrite on the other.
With a single In-App Purchase, you can unlock many additional tools, including:
• Preview at up to 2× speed
• Prepare your audio for production with Noise Reduction and Auto Levelling.
• Add professional effects to your tracks such as EQ, Noise Gate and Dynamic Range Compression, for projects that sound clean and engaging.
• Automate volume, panning and effects settings so they vary over time, both on individual tracks and the final mix.
• Tighten Audio can automatically take out awkward pauses and gaps.
• Producing a podcast or series? Create a template to get each new episode off to a flying start.
• Add cover art, chapters and more.
• Found the perfect settings for an effect or tool? Save them as a Preset for re-use in other projects.
• Audio Unit Extensions: if you have other apps installed that provide effects as Audio Unit Extensions, they’ll show up in Ferrite, where you can add them to tracks or projects.
• Advanced search, smart folders, and template folders.

bluejetty:00147325:ios.summary: One Parking provides you with a safe and secure touchless parking experience. Enjoy the ease of parking from entry to exit with the One Parking application. The One Parking application can be used in all participating One Parking Garage l
bluejetty:00147325:ios.description:
One Parking provides you with a safe and secure touchless parking experience. Enjoy the ease of parking from entry to exit with the One Parking application. The One Parking application can be used in all participating One Parking Garage locations. Easily find our garages in your area using the application. Simply download and register and view all the participating garages. The One Parking application gives you all the details on your selected garage, from photos, rates, hours of operations, and directions. 
At all participating garage entries, you will see a QR code that looks like the following. With the One Parking application, scan the QR code to check in.
Scanning the QR code starts your touchless and secure parking session. The gate will automatically open for you. Now sit back and enjoy your plans. Whether shopping, eating with friends and family, or even going to a work meeting, the One Parking application will help keep track of your parking session. Now it's time to head back to your car. Open the One Parking Application and easily view what garage you parked at and get an up-to-date parking session time period. How easy can it be? 
Checkout and payment are even easier and secure. When you arrive at the exit gate, click Scan QR to Exit. Payment will be securely processed and the gate will automatically open. Your parking history and invoices are easily accessible through your application. 
One Parking takes the uncertainty of finding parking as well as the concern of security. Keep yourself safe and your payment information safe by using the One Parking application today.
One Parking is continuing to add more garages daily. Please check back to find more touchless and secure parking near you.

bluejetty:00036726:ios.summary:
Join Forces with a Little Dinosaur, Pilot Mechas to Victory!
Enter the mysterious arena and challenge formidable opponents. Think through your battle strategies, cleverly utilize items, and defeat enemies one by one to become the ultimate c
bluejetty:00036726:ios.description:
Join Forces with a Little Dinosaur, Pilot Mechas to Victory!
Enter the mysterious arena and challenge formidable opponents. Think through your battle strategies, cleverly utilize items, and defeat enemies one by one to become the ultimate champion. This thrilling adventure offers both challenge and excitement, perfect for kids who love coding games.
Two Gameplay Modes for Continuous Growth
In Adventure Mode, progressively challenge levels and grow with your mecha. In Battle Mode, face randomly matched opponents and strive for consecutive wins. This engaging experience helps kids develop coding skills while enjoying educational games designed for children.
Intuitive Code Blocks Make Learning to Code Easy
Blocks are code, and coding for kids has never been easier. Drag and drop to program your mecha. The colorful graphics make it easy for every child to understand. By arranging and combining blocks, kids can learn coding basics and enhance their computational thinking skills.
8 Themed Arenas with 144 Thrilling Battles
Explore various arenas with unique challenges: hide in the bushes in the forest, slide on icy surfaces in the snow, use conveyor belts for quick movement in the city, and discover more in the base, desert, volcano, and laboratory. Each arena offers a unique environment for logic games and problem-solving.
18 Cool Mechas to Upgrade and Strengthen in Battle
Choose from a variety of mechas: offensive, defensive, and agile types. Each brings a different battle experience. Upgrade your mechas to enhance their attributes and create your ultimate champion. This feature-rich coding game for elementary school children offers hours of fun and learning.
Product Features:
• Graphical Coding Game: Designed specifically for kids, making programming for children fun and intuitive.
• Two Gameplay Modes: Adventure and Battle modes provide endless enjoyment.
• 18 Upgradable Mechas: Each mecha is unique and super cool, perfect for STEM games for kids.
• 8 Themed Arenas: Embark on a journey to become the champion across diverse environments.
• 144 Carefully Selected Levels: Challenge strong opponents and develop coding skills.
• Intelligent Assistance System: Helps kids easily overcome challenges in these educational games.
• Offline Coding Games: Play without needing an internet connection.
• Distraction-Free Experience: No third-party ads, ensuring safe coding games for kids.
This educational app for kids incorporates STEM and STEAM learning principles. It's perfect for coding games for toddlers, preschoolers, and kids aged 5 to 12. With an emphasis on safe, kid-friendly programming, this app is designed to be an educational technology tool that enhances learning through interactive coding games.
Whether your child is learning Scratch for kids, Blockly for kids, or even Python and JavaScript basics, this app makes learning to code fun and accessible. Perfect for beginner coding games, it supports the development of coding skills for kids in a playful, engaging manner.
Discover the ultimate coding adventure with this fun programming game. Download now and let your child embark on a journey of learning and excitement!

Yateland's educational apps ignite the passion for learning through play among preschool children worldwide. We stand by our motto: "Apps that children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, please visit https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00183008:ios.name: Cowboy Revenge-Wild Horse Guns
bluejetty:00183008:ios.summary: Cowboy Revenge-Wild Horse Guns is not a simple rodeo adventure game in which you have to look after ranch or to maintain the stable. In this western cowboy game, you have to take revenge of your beloved wife from the lawless posse. You have
bluejetty:00183008:ios.description:
Cowboy Revenge-Wild Horse Guns is not a simple rodeo adventure game in which you have to look after ranch or to maintain the stable. In this western cowboy game, you have to take revenge of your beloved wife from the lawless posse. You have to train yourself for horse racing, gun shooting and arrow archery shooting for taking the revenge of your wife from western bloody goons.
This American cowboy game is based on the story impeccable cowboy who never hurt anyone. He always remains busy in his horse stable. Once on a normal fine day, he was busy like all other cowboys schedule. Suddenly he saw smoke on the horizon raising from his home and found his horse coming towards him wildly. He realized that something bad had happened to his lovely beautiful wife. He rides on his horse and runs towards his home wildly. But it was too late. He could only see his home burning in front of his eyes but he could do nothing. His wife has been murdered by the six western gangsters. A gang of US gunfighter shot his wife and burnt their home.
One that day he decided to become a cowboy fighter shooter to take the revenge of his wife. A revenge wrote in blood and be best of all legends. He promised to himself for killing all the wildest cowboy fighters and west gangsters for the revenge of his beloved wife. After that, he carried the cowboy gun and started the new mission of his life, unlike other cowboys game. 
So in this western game, you have to play as the west cowboy for training yourself. Start learning from horse riding in extremely worst situations, try to become a professional and experienced horse rider. Ride your horse across different hurdles and obstacles and perform different horse stunts for training yourself. After horse riding training, start cowboy archery training by aiming bull eye boards. Cowboy archery training would help you to fight against gangsters and western goons. After archery training, you would be trained for cowboy shooting and cowboy fighting because enemies and west gangsters may be equipped with latest weapons so you should also be trained for fighting in any condition. In one mission you would be trained to shoot while running or hiding behind the walls and later missions you would be trained with shooting skill while riding your horse at maximum speed. 
So this is the time to start cowboy adventure by riding the wild horse and by hunting gunfighters of the western world. There are multiple challenging missions of bounty hunting. Be the cowboy hero hunter and demolish the wrath of western mafia gangsters. Such cowboy games demand extraordinary skills of cowboy shooting, cowboy archery and you should be highly trained horse rider for fighting against west gunfighters. Explore the town by riding your racing horse and search the gangsters for killing them on the spot.
*** Features of Cowboy Revenge-Wild Horse Guns ***
- realistic countryside environment
- real animation of cowboys and horses
- real story base game
- HD graphics 
- compatible with the variety of devices 
- real physics-based controls of cowboy horse
- contains real cowboy gun and sword
- one of best cowboy games
It’s time to play cowboy games with horses and guns on your devices. Stop searching ordinary cowboy shooting games.

bluejetty:00064203:ios.description:
Son dakika haberleri ile 7/24 yayın yapan sozcu.com.tr, en güncel gazete haberleri ve köşe yazıları ile ücretsiz yayın yapan bir uygulamadır. Ekonomi, dünya, eğitim, magazin, spor, sağlık gibi birçok farklı kategoride içerik üreten haber uygulaması, analizleri ve tarafsız yayın ilkesiyle de rakiplerine fark atıyor. Sözcü Gazetesi'nin güçlü haber kadrosu görünenin ötesinde bir bakışla haberlerini okuyucularına sunuyor.
- Yılmaz Özdil, Rahmi Turan, Emin Çölaşan gibi isimlerin yer aldığı Türkiye'nin en iyi yazar kadrosunun köşe yazılarını okuyabilirsiniz.
- Türkiye ve dünya gündemini, günün her anı son dakika haberleri ile takip edebilirsiniz.
- Ekonomi haberleri, döviz kurları, altın fiyatları ve finans piyasasını yakından izleyebilirsiniz.
- Canlı skor, maç sonuçları, transfer haberleri, puan durumu ve son dakika spor haberlerinden anında haberdar olabilirsiniz
- Astroloji ve günlük burç yorumlarını Dinçer Güner'in yorumlarıyla okuyabilirsiniz.
- Son dakika magazin haberleri ile beraber, en güncel konser, etkinlik haberlerinin yer aldığı kültür-sanat haberlerine kolaylıkla erişebilir, ayrıca moda, seyahat ve gurme gibi birçok farklı kategoriden de haberdar olabilirsiniz
- Meteoroloji'den yapılan son dakika uyarıları ile birlikte 81 ilin hava durumu raporlarına göz atabilirsiniz.
- Sağlık haberleri kategorisinde uzman doktor yorumlarını ve sağlık alanındaki son gelişmeleri okuyabilirsiniz.
- Sosyal medyada en çok izlenen eğlenceli ve komik videoları izleyebilirsiniz.
Sözcü uygulamasını telefonunuza ve tabletinize ücretsiz olarak indirip 7/24 tüm haberlere kolayca erişme ayrıcalığını yaşayın.
Sözcü Plus ve Egazete özelliklerini de denemeyi unutmayın!

bluejetty:00184818:ios.description:
Inaugurado em 2007, o Shopping Metrô Itaquera, administrado pela rede Ancar Ivanhoe, é uma das principais referências comerciais na Zona Leste de São Paulo. Com localização privilegiada, está instalado em um bairro com aproximadamente 520 mil habitantes e possui seus acessos interligados à estação do Metrô Corinthians-Itaquera, CPTM, Terminal Urbano e Arena Corinthians.
Com mais de 300 lojas, sendo 14 âncoras, mais de 70 quiosques, duas Praças de Alimentação com 38 fast-foods e 5 restaurantes, como Outback, Gigante Nordestino e Coco Bambu (em breve), o shopping abriga as principais marcas do varejo que inclui Renner, Riachuelo, Kalunga, Lojas Americanas, Daiso Japan, Extra Hipermercados, Casas Bahia, Lojas Marisa, C&A, Preçolândia, Besni, Pernambucanas e Magazine Luiza, além de uma moderna operação de cinema (Cinépolis) com oito salas, uma academia Smart Fit e faculdade Anhanguera.
O empreendimento também é conhecido por sediar o maior Poupatempo do Estado de São Paulo e o primeiro Drive Thru de McDonald’s dentro de um shopping center na Zona Leste.

bluejetty:00066110:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00066110:ios.description:
This is a Mahjong game of the Japanese style rule.
The Slider that exists under the screen is moved, and the tile is selected. 
And, the Slider is done in the tap and the tile is discard.
Mahjong is the game to finish four Melds and one Pairs.
Example: [1, 2, 3][6, 6, 6][6, 7, 8][N, N, N][4, 4]
However, there is a hand not approved when Chi, Pon, and Open Kan.
Please note whether there is a hand when you do 1 and 9 in Chi and Pon.
In the rule of the japanese mahjong, one or more hands are necessary.
The hand can be made by paying 1,000 points and doing Reach.
However, when Chi, Pon, and Open Kan are done, Reach cannot be done.
If it is a closed hand, high point will be obtained.
About Lost Hand. A hand that is Waiting, but cannot be won off someone else's discard due to the fact that the owner of the hand already threw a winning tile in their own discard.
Lost Hand if one in all winning tiles are here even if discard doesn't do the tile which it wants to do. But, self-draw is possible even with Lost Hand.
The knack is that Ron is never done by the other party.
Ron is never done with the tile that does Discard.
Please reason the Hand from other party's Discard and win.

bluejetty:00040064:ios.description:
EN
N1 is the only news app that you need to stay on top of all happenings in Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia and Serbia.
With award-winning news teams in each of the three countries, N1 brings you news as it happens, objectively and professionally.
Use the N1 app to:
• Access the most important news, breaking news, reports, and live updates in no time.
• Get in-depth coverage of relevant news from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Slovenia, and Serbia.
Download N1 and never miss the news you need to know.
SR
N1 je jedina informativna aplikacija koja vam je potrebna da budete u toku sa svim događajima u Bosni i Hercegovini, Hrvatskoj i Srbiji.
Sa nagrađivanim novinarskim timovima u sve tri zemlje, N1 vam objektivno i profesionalno donosi vesti sa lica mesta.
Koristite N1 aplikaciju da:
• Brzo i jednostavno pristupite najvažnijim i najnovijim vestima, izveštajima i informacijama koje se ažuriraju svakog trenutka.
• Steknete detaljan uvid u relevantne vesti iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Hrvatske, Slovenije i Srbije.
Preuzmite aplikaciju N1 i nikada ne propustite vesti koje treba da znate.
BH
N1 je jedina informativna aplikacija koja vam je potrebna da budete u toku sa svim događajima u Bosni i Hercegovini, Hrvatskoj i Srbiji.
S nagrađivanim novinarskim timovima u svakoj od tri države, N1 vam objektivno i profesionalno donosi vijesti sa lica mjesta.
Koristite aplikaciju N1 da:
• Brzo i jednostavno pristupite najvažnijim i najnovijim vijestima, izvještajima i informacijama koje se ažuriraju svakog trenutka
• Steknete detaljan uvid u relevantne vijesti iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Hrvatske, Slovenije i Srbije.
Preuzmite N1 aplikaciju i nikada ne propustite vijesti koje trebate znati.
SLO
N1 je edina novičarska aplikacija, ki jo potrebujete, da sledite dogajanju v Sloveniji, Bosni in Hercegovini, Srbiji in na Hrvaškem. Naša medijska hiša ima kredibilne novinarske ekipe v vseh omenjenih državah. N1 vam novice prinaša objektivno in profesionalno.
Uporabljajte aplikacijo N1, da boste:
• hitro dostopali do najpomembnejših in izrednih novic, poročanja in dogajanja v živo,
• spremljali poglobljeno pokrivanje pomembnih novic za Slovenijo, Bosno in Hercegovino, Srbijo in Hrvaško.
Prenesite aplikacijo N1 in nikoli ne spreglejte pomembnih novic.

bluejetty:00070241:ios.description:
Welcome to the Flying Unicorn Simulator of your dreams.Step into a magical universe where your unicorn can fly, swim, ride, and take on exciting challenges.From the snowy peaks of Winter Map to the sun-soaked beaches of the Summer Map, there's always an adventure waiting! 
EXPLORE AMAZING WORLDS:
The skies are yours to conquer! Glide through beautiful skies, lush forests, towering mountains, and enchanted castles
Discover exciting maps like Crimson Valley, Sky Island, Tulip Farm, Unicorn Island, and more! Each map offers a unique environment with tons of fun activities, including skiing, water sliding, Ferris wheels and endless adventures.
Take on the Floor is Lava challenge, race your friends, or simply roam the vast, colorful landscapes of the unicorn world!
CUSTOMIZE YOUR UNICORN:
Create the perfect look for you and your unicorn! Customize everything from saddles and wings to horns, eyes, and accessories to design a unicorn that’s truly yours
A UNIVERSE OF UNICORNS
Flying Unicorn Simulator is home to a growing collection of 13 magical unicorn types! Whether you’re flying high with the Star Unicorn, gliding through snow with the Ice Unicorn, or embarking on sweet adventures with the Gingerbread Unicorn, there’s a unicorn for every kind of dream. With more unicorns coming soon, the magic never ends!
ADOPT CUTE PETS:
From dragons to cats, dogs, and penguins, your unicorn will have the perfect companion for every adventure!
JOIN FRIENDS ONLINE:
Ride and Fly with your friends, discover beautiful places together, take on exciting challenges and enjoy the fun of socializing in this magical world.
Challenges, magical events and new unicorns & pets are added regularly. There’s always something new to discover in the magical world of unicorns.
Download now and begin your adventure today!
Premium membership subscription is provided on a monthly basis.
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes account at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
This app offers optional in-app purchases that cost real money. You can disable the in-app purchasing functionality by adjusting your device settings.

bluejetty:00180540:ios.description:
Discover your Golden Ratio face score! Take a selfie or choose a photo and get a detailed analysis of your facial proportions based on the golden ratio (1.618).
KEY FEATURES:
• Instant Face Analysis — Snap a photo or pick one from your gallery. Our AI detects facial landmarks and calculates 12 key proportions in seconds.
• Golden Ratio Score — Get an overall percentage score showing how closely your features align with the mathematically ideal proportions.
• Visual Proportion Map — See green and red measurement lines overlaid on your face, making it easy to understand each ratio at a glance.

bluejetty:00177452:ios.description:
SimpleMoon provides a simple, elegant view of one thing: the moon phase and illumination for today (or any day you choose). SimpleMoon also shows you when the next full moon and new moon will occur from the "Today" view. 
So easy to use
Tap the navigation buttons at the top or swipe to move between days. Use the calendar icon at the bottom to choose what date you want to see the moon view and illumination. 
Reliable and accurate
SimpleMoon uses advanced mathematical calculations to determine the moon data for that day. It works even if you don't have an internet connection!
Northern or Southern Hemisphere
Did you know that the moon looks different depending on which hemisphere of the earth you are in? Go to Settings and pick which hemisphere you are in, and you will see the moon as it appears to you in the sky.
Special thanks to my children, Alexander and Sophia who helped me design and test the app.

bluejetty:00074837:ios.description:
The instax UP!™ smartphone App allows you to scan your instax™ photos that have been printed with a FUJIFILM instax™ instant camera or Smartphone printer and store them digitally.

Go on, give some love!
(4) All the latest instax™ news & inspiration
The instax UP!™ App will keep you up-to-date with all instax™ product information.
From the latest instax™ news, tips, and inspiration.
It's all here.

Transfer instax™ photos from our other instax™ Apps* to the instax UP!™ App for even more fun!
*Other instax™ Apps include the instax mini Link™, instax SQUARE Link™, instax Link WIDE™, instax mini Link™ for Nintendo Switch, instax mini Evo™ and instax mini LiPlay™ Apps.

bluejetty:00099016:ios.summary:
Welcome to Daily Stoic — your personal companion for living a more intentional, stoic life, one day at a time.
In a noisy world, Daily Stoic offers quiet clarity. Grounded in the principles of stoicism, this app brings timeless wisdom into
bluejetty:00099016:ios.description:
Welcome to Daily Stoic — your personal companion for living a more intentional, stoic life, one day at a time.
In a noisy world, Daily Stoic offers quiet clarity. Grounded in the principles of stoicism, this app brings timeless wisdom into your modern routine — helping you develop a stoic mindset through daily reflection, guided journaling, and simple, powerful practices.
At Daily Stoic, we believe that stoicism is not just ancient philosophy — it’s a daily practice. Stoicism teaches us to focus on what we can control, accept what we cannot, and act with virtue. Every morning, Daily Stoic gives you a fresh opportunity to live with intention, calm, and resilience — the very essence of a stoic approach to life.
Whether you’re just beginning your journey with stoicism or have long embraced the stoic path, Daily Stoic adapts to your pace. You’ll find daily stoic questions, stoic quotes, and stoic challenges — all designed to help you apply the wisdom of stoicism in your own life.
Every day, Daily Stoic offers you:
A stoic quote to ground your mind
A daily stoic question to spark reflection
A short story rooted in stoicism
A practical challenge to train your stoic habits
In Daily Stoic, there are no ads. Just your thoughts, your growth, and the wisdom of stoicism to guide you.
The team behind Daily Stoic is made up of writers, designers, and thinkers who live and breathe stoicism. We study the stoic texts, live the stoic values, and build features that help you embrace the spirit of stoicism every single day. With each update, we refine the experience so you can deepen your daily stoic practice.
We know that developing a stoic mindset takes consistency — that's why Daily Stoic is built for daily use. With just five minutes a day, you can build strong habits, reframe challenges, and move closer to the kind of person stoicism encourages you to be: wise, just, courageous, and self-disciplined.
As you explore Daily Stoic, you’ll also find a community of others on the same stoic path. Through shared reflections and insights, you’ll see how stoicism unites us — across time, culture, and personal struggles. The stoic way isn’t about isolation — it’s about learning to face life together with clarity and calm.
Our mission is simple: to bring stoicism into your daily life in the most meaningful way. Daily Stoic isn’t just another wellness app — it’s a living expression of stoic philosophy. And we’re honored to help you grow through its teachings, every day, in small, steady steps.
Thank you for choosing Daily Stoic. Let’s build a stoic life — together.

bluejetty:00083517:ios.description:
The Nix Toolkit is the new all-in-one companion app for our Nix Sensor device line-up. It’s compatible with all Nix Mini, Nix Pro, Nix QC, and Nix Spectro devices. Functions in the app will be turned on and off depending on which device you have connected.
Functions include:
1. “Single scan” (available for all devices)
2. “Premium databases” (available for all devices)
3. “Create and share custom library (Compatible with Nix Pro, Spectro and QC devices only)
4. “Multipoint average scanning for all tools”
5. "Nix Paints feature"
6. "Nix Quality Control feature"
The “Single scan” function displays digital values (CIELAB, HEX, and RGB) and Spectral curve on swipe (Spectro device only) when you scan a sample with your Nix Color Sensor.
Premium databases offer paid subscriptions to world-class color libraries (including Pantone, RAL, and NCS). Once subscribed you can browse the entire library, and scan and match to the closest color.
The Nix Toolkit app lets you take control of how you perceive color. Select from dark or light mode, or use your own system settings.
If you have any questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We’d love to help with whatever questions or issues you have. Please note that a free account is required to use the app (you will be prompted to create one when you first open the app). A Nix device (Mini, Pro, QC, or Spectro) is required to unlock app functions.
Learn more about the Nix Sensor line-up at www.nixsensor.com.
If you find any bugs please contact us directly at info@nixsensor.com and our team will attend to them quickly.
Nix®, Nix Pro™, and Nix Mini™ are trademarks of Nix Sensor Ltd. All other trademarks used herein are simply references to trademarks owned by others and are not intended as trademark use.
Terms of use: https://www.nixsensor.com/legal/

bluejetty:00099309:ios.description:
Walk famous trails around the world without leaving your neighborhood.
Walk the World turns your daily steps into progress on real routes across 17 countries. Walk the Camino de Santiago in Spain. Climb Mount Fuji in Japan. Explore the old streets of Prague. Your real steps move you forward on virtual trails, with landmarks to discover and postcards to collect along the way.
No running. No leaderboards. No judgment. Just walking.
HOW IT WORKS
The app reads your steps from Apple Health. Each step you take moves you forward on your chosen route. Hit checkpoints to discover real landmarks, earn trail stamps, and collect finish-line postcards for every route you complete.
67 ROUTES ACROSS 17 COUNTRIES
From national parks in the US to ancient trails in the Middle East. Short routes for beginners, long treks for the committed. New routes added regularly.
BUILT FOR WALKERS, NOT RUNNERS
This isn’t a fitness tracker. There’s no calorie counting, no pace targets, no shame. Walk at your own speed. Every step counts, whether it’s a morning commute or a weekend hike.”

No running. No leaderboards. No judgment. Just walking.

HOW IT WORKS

The app reads your steps from Apple Health. Each step you take moves you forward on your chosen route. Hit checkpoints to discover real landmarks, earn trail stamps, and collect finish-line postcards for every route you complete.

67 ROUTES ACROSS 17 COUNTRIES

From national parks in the US to ancient trails in the Middle East. Short routes for beginners, long treks for the committed. New routes added regularly.

BUILT FOR WALKERS, NOT RUNNERS

This isn’t a fitness tracker. There’s no calorie counting, no pace targets, no shame. Walk at your own speed. Every step counts, whether it’s a morning commute or a weekend hike.”

bluejetty:00021928:ios.description:
Athan Academy is a one-tap Islamic learning app that helps Muslims perfect their Islamic knowledge through interactive audio and video courses by certified Ulama.
Athan Academy brings you an amazing chance to learn Quran from the basics and then master tajweed to enable you to recite Quran more confidently and fluently with
- Interactive Quran classes
- Quran Tajwid practice exercises
- Direct feedback on your recitation from a Quran teacher
- Flexible learning schedules
- Weekly performance updates
Athan Academy app has been developed by the world's largest online platform for Muslims; Athan and Islamicfinder.org with the help of a team of Islamic Scholars, Qari, Ulama, Mufti and Alim. It contains:
Master Qur’an Tajweed: 
Practice Tajwid rules, Makharij, and how to read Quran fluently with examples of Surahs in video lessons and exercises.
Learn specific techniques from a Qari/Quran teacher to beautify your recitation.
Understand the complete use of Arabic grammar and Quran punctuation.
Interact directly with a Qari/certified Alim in Quran classes to learn Quran flawlessly.
Spiritual Healing Masterclass:
- Learn the six spiritual practices derived from the Quran to manage stress, and strengthen your connection with Allah
- Discover Quran’s teachings for personal growth and improving your physical and mental health
- Practice self-reflection to deepen your relationship with the Quran
Basics to recite Qur’an Tajwid and Makharij from an Arabic Teacher:
- Online Quran Learning / Online Quran Classes with audio and video lessons by an experienced Qari / Ulema
- Quran Arabic with Quran Tajweed and Makharij from a skilled Qari
- Learn the pronunciation of Quran Arabic with the feedback from a certified Alim / Qari
- Quran E-Learning / Online Quran Classes to perfect the art of reciting the Quran in Arabic language by Ulema
- Connected letters in the Arabic language
- Browse Al-Quran through Surahs, Juz and Ayah
- Quran for kids
- Learn Quran Arabic easily with Online Quran lessons exercises / Online Quran Classes
MasterClass for Muslim Teens:
- Understand modern challenges and how to counter them
- Practice your learnings with real life examples
- Connect with your community of peers
How to perform Salat:
- Learn Step by Step Namaz through the video of Salat Guide
- Learn Sunnah Namaz / Salat and how Muslim Prayer is performed
- Easy Namaz guide for kids to learn Salat
How to perform Ablution:
- Learn Step by Step Wudhu through the video of Wudu Guide
- Learn how to perform Ablution according to Sunnah
Other Courses:
- Importance and Etiquettes to read Quran
- Purification of Mind, Body & Soul
- Masnoon Duas every kid and adult Muslim should learn
- A day in the Life of Prophet Mohammad (S.A.W.)
- Essential Basics of Zakat
Athan Academy’s interactive courses are created by a team of Arabic language experts including Islamic scholars, Quran Teacher, Aalim and Ulema.
Paid Courses:
While most courses on Athan Academy are free, some require a one time charge. Below are the charges for the paid courses:
1- Master Tajweed in 4 months = $70
2- Learn to Recite Quran in 12 weeks = $50
3- MasterClass for Muslim Teens = $10
4- Spiritual Healing Masterclass = $15
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase and the subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription

bluejetty:00182466:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00182466:ios.description:
A revolutionary way to track your meals, enhanced by AI.
Welcome to a new era of nutrition tracking, tailored to your style. With the new Lifesum experience, you can choose to log your meals by snapping a photo, using your voice, typing a text or scanning a barcode. 
We made food tracking easy so you can make more healthy choices for your body and mind.
JOIN 65 MILLION USERS ON THE PATH TO BETTER HEALTH.
Health isn’t about perfection—it’s about progress. Lifesum encourages small, manageable changes that add up to lasting results. 
Whether it’s drinking more water, adding more fruits and veggies to your plate, or choosing healthier snacks, Lifesum celebrates every win, no matter how small.
SMARTER, SIMPLER MEAL TRACKING
Track your meals your way:
• Snap a photo to get instant nutrition details
• Speak for easy, hands-free logging
• Type for more detailed tracking
• Scan barcodes for fast info
• Use quick tracking for simple entries
TOP LIFESUM FEATURES
• Calorie counter
• Macro tracker and food rating
• Nutrition plans for weight management and body composition
• Water tracker
• Fruit, vegetable and fish tracker
• Meal plans with grocery lists included
• Integration with fitness trackers for in-depth health monitoring
• Life Score test for personalized nutrition recommendations
WEIGHT MANAGEMENT AND HEALTHY EATING
Whether you're looking to manage your weight, eat healthier or simply feel better in your everyday life, Lifesum provides the tools and support to make your goals achievable, sustainable and enjoyable.
From balanced meal plans to specialized lifestyles like keto, paleo, or high protein, Lifesum adapts to your preferences and needs. 
Simply share your goals, preferences, restrictions, and activity levels, and Lifesum creates nutrition plans just for you.
Lifesum also offers a massive library of delicious recipes, all crafted to help you eat smarter.
BEYOND CALORIES: A COMPLETE WELNESS SOLUTION
Lifesum goes beyond simple calorie counting. With its unique Life Score feature, the app evaluates your overall health based on your eating habits, hydration, and activity levels. 
This helps you focus on long-term well-being instead of short-term fixes. Additionally, you’ll find helpful tips and reminders to build healthy habits that last.
SEAMLESS INTEGRATION WITH YOUR LIFESTYLE
Connect with your favorite apps and devices to get a holistic view of your health. Sync with Apple Health to import exercise calories, weight, steps, active calories, and exercise time — and export food calories, nutrition, water, and weight back to your health profile. Connect to apps like Oura, Withings, and Runkeeper via Apple Health to bring all your health data together. Progress stays at your fingertips, making it easy to stay motivated and on track.
ALL YOU NEED FOR A CUSTOMIZED EXPERIENCE
• Calorie counter, with the option to adjust your daily calorie goal and add/exclude calories burned through exercise
• Macro tracking and adjustable goals for carbs, protein, and fat intake
• Create and save your favorite foods, recipes, meals, and exercises
• Body measurement tracking (weight, waist, body fat, chest, arm, BMI)
• Library of thousands of recipes with smart filters for quick results
• Weekly Life Score based on nutrition and exercise measurements, so you understand where you are and what's next to build the healthiest version of you
• Sync with health and fitness apps to track your steps and exercise in real time
Lifesum is free to download and use with limited features. For the full Lifesum experience, we offer 1-month, 3-month, and annual Premium auto-renewing subscriptions.
Payment is charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in iTunes account settings or cancel your subscription at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.
View our Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy: http://api.lifesum.com/mobile-terms

bluejetty:00157206:ios.description: SaferWatch is revolutionizing the way people report crime, suspicious activity and online threats. SaferWatch was built to provide a higher level of safety for individuals and enhance security for organizations including schools, corporations, public venues, neighborhoods and communities. SaferWatch empowers users to easily report incidents as they see it happening or submit a tip at a later time. SaferWatch provides real-time two-way communication during emergency and non-emergency situations. Citizens, students, parents, teachers, administrators, security personnel and law enforcement can now seamlessly communicate all on the same secure network. SaferWatch Alerts provide detailed safety instructions based on the incident and the ability for users to contribute information. SaferWatch is also key for corporations to provide duty of care to their employees and customers and help mitigate risk. SaferWatch offers several patent pending features. SaferWatch does not send out Alerts as a company, SaferWatch's clients monitor their own SaferWatch networks and interact with users.

No adjustment is necessary, the application automatically detects your TV (Your TV must be powered on) and then you can control your TV directly from your iPhone.
For questions or comments, write us at the following address: contact.panamote@gmail.com

Panamote is not an official product Panasonic, we are not affiliated with Panasonic society.
