bluejetty:00061653:ios.description:
The official iPhone, iPad and Apple TV app for our macOS CCTV software SecuritySpy (securityspy.com). The essential component of a complete video surveillance system for your Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, this app allows you to easily monitor and control your camera system from wherever you are.
This iOS app is completely free for registered SecuritySpy users, and also fully functional during the initial trial period. It offers the following features:
- Live video and audio from your cameras
- Multiplex: cycle through groups of simultaneous live camera views in full screen
- Captures: play back recordings, including motion-detected clips, image files or whole-day movies
- Save/share images and recordings via email, iMessage, iCloud Photo Sharing and more
- Picture in Picture: watch a live camera in a floating window over other apps
- Receive push notifications when motion is detected
- PTZ control (Pan, Tilt, Zoom)
- Two-way audio
- Arm or disarm camera recording modes
- Easy setup with auto-discovery of SecuritySpy servers on your network
- View and manage multiple SecuritySpy servers
Please note you will need a Mac running SecuritySpy 5.5.11 or later (securityspy.com), with a license that covers the number of cameras you want to use in the app.
We are always happy to hear your feedback, so please get in touch if you have any suggestions for future updates.

bluejetty:00089550:ios.summary: Tired of "Storage Almost Full" alerts on your iPhone? Drowning in duplicate photos, blurry screenshots, or messy contacts? Pics Clean is your practical all‑in‑one tool to organize your device gallery and contacts — no technical skills neede
bluejetty:00089550:ios.description:
Tired of "Storage Almost Full" alerts on your iPhone? Drowning in duplicate photos, blurry screenshots, or messy contacts? Pics Clean is your practical all‑in‑one tool to organize your device gallery and contacts — no technical skills needed!
Smart Similar Photo Cleaner
Our on‑device algorithm scans your photo library to detect similar shots, burst photos, blurry images, and redundant screenshots. Preview items side‑by‑side, batch‑select, and delete in one tap. Keep your favorite memories while freeing device storage. Great for sorting travel albums, selfie collections and old snapshots.
Photo & Video Compression
Reduce file sizes of your photos and videos directly on your device. Customize compression quality to balance storage savings and visual fidelity. Preserve important content while cutting down space occupation, ideal before sharing or archiving media files.
Live Photo Optimization
Convert Live Photos to static images to help reduce file size for your media library.
Customizable Smart Cleaning
Every user’s needs are unique. Flexible cleaning modes let you organize your gallery the way you prefer. Sort unwanted photos, archive old snapshots, set your preferences and streamline your photo library easily.
Duplicate Contacts Merger
Tired of scrolling through messy duplicate contacts? Our fast scanner finds duplicate entries, matching phone numbers and incomplete contact records. Merge contact details or remove duplicates with one tap for a tidy address book.
Speaker Debris & Moisture Assistant
Play tuned sound frequencies to help loosen light debris and residual moisture trapped in the speaker grille. This function assists with limited cleaning only. Actual improvement varies depending on device condition and blockage type; it cannot resolve severe hardware clogging or damage.
Why Choose Pics Clean
‑ 100% Local Processing: All scans run on‑device. Your photos, videos and contacts stay private, no cloud uploads.
‑ Intuitive Interface: Beginner‑friendly layout for simple navigation.
‑ Fast Workflow: Quickly organize photos and contacts right on your phone.

We believe wellness is about you, not just the practice. We act as the facilitators of your journey, providing a warm, thoughtful space and personalized activity recommendations that are easy to follow and flexible to adjust as per your own routine. 
Meditation & Mindfulness:
- 700+ guided and non-guided neuroscience-backed meditations
- 2-minute mindful breathing exercises for relaxation, focus & stress relief

- Zodiac-specific meditations built around your sun and moon signs
- Astrology as a lens to understand yourself, not just predict your week
Sleep Music, meditations & stories:
- Ambient sounds of jazz, nature & space to help you relax and calm
- Bedtime stories for adults and kids, blending ancient Indian mythology and modern techniques
- Sleep Meditation, Yog Nidra & Sleep Courses to build a sleep routine that works for you
- Sleep music and ASMR sounds for a peaceful, uninterrupted sleep
Pranayam, Yoga, and Home Workouts:

Personalized Wellness Journeys:
- Set daily reminders: Stay consistent to build a meditation routine and mindfulness practice
- By understanding your behavior and goals, we suggest the right routine at the right moment
- Save favourites: Keep most-loved wellness activities handy for offline access
Track your progress:
Gently track your wellness journey with our streak, journey, personal AI coach features, and personalized reminders. 
#Why choose Swa:aha (formerly Level SuperMind)?
- Built for India & Beyond. Hindi + English language. Rooted in Vedic, Hindu, and Indian wellness traditions.

- Ad-free. Pay once, breathe easy. No pop-ups between you and your practice.

- Private by design. Your journal, your chart, your journey - all yours alone.

At Swa:aha (formerly Level SuperMind), we believe that wellness isn’t just about the routine - it’s about YOU.
Our mission is to empower you with personalized tools to build the wellness routine that suits your life. We are the facilitators of your wellness journey. 
Our goal is to help you achieve true mental peace, deep sleep, and an overall balanced life, on your terms.

Exercise your brain and become a merge master with Dice Puzzle : Dominoes, the brand new match and merge puzzle game
Drag and drop customizable dice blocks such as wood dice, fuzzy dice, cookie dice, bling dice, and more onto the puzzle board and try to make your match! Along with customizable dice are customizable backgrounds so you can personalize your own gaming experience.

CHALLENGING

UNIQUE
- Customize your background and dice to reflect your personality!
TIMELESS
- No time limit - no pressure!
ENDLESS FUN
- Daily challenges give you unique opportunities to test out new strategies!

bluejetty:00133170:ios.description:
Over the last 10 years, over 5 million people have learned to play with the Rocksmith method* and Rocksmith™+ builds on that by featuring a unique visual interface, real-time feedback, and a focus on playing songs. Over 95% of players improved with the Rocksmith method.** Use any piano, keyboard, or MIDI controller or any acoustic, electric, or bass guitar to play a huge library of hit songs with more to come!
Get the most out of your comprehensive learning subscription for years to come with content updates including new interactive lessons, modes and features plus a steady stream of monthly new song additions. Continue your journey on the Rocksmith+ site with free supplemental articles and videos to further hone mechanics. You can learn about proper technique and form, music theory, gear, instrument care and more
LEARN TO PLAY WITH THOUSANDS OF YOUR FAVORITE SONGS
- Discover a large expanding song library with thousands of official master recordings with genres from around the world, including classic, indie, or alternative rock, to hip hop, pop, metal, country, Latin, R&B and more
- Rocksmith+ has a variety of authentic arrangements, just like how artists originally played them, and all songs will be playable on guitar & bass with chord charts to hum and strum to
LEARN PIANO WITH HUNDREDS OF SONGS & NEW LESSONS
- Use any keyboard or digital piano that sends MIDI data and connect directly to your device with a supported cable***
- Use acoustic pianos & keyboard speakers with phone & tablet mic input
- Play hundreds of songs spanning classical, pop, R&B, soundtracks, & more with newly added piano arrangements and a new 3D noteway for beginners
- Toggle Sheet Music view with our option to display traditional music notation
- Learn from expert teachers with newly added interactive video lessons for piano
- With all of Rocksmith+'s real-time feedback, note detection, Adaptive Difficulty, and practice tools like Riff Repeater
PRACTICE TOOLS YOU CAN CONTROL
- The classic Rocksmith noteway returns alongside a new Rocksmith Tablature option for experienced guitarists. 
- Core features like Riff Repeater, Adaptive Difficulty and Video Lessons have been improved to be more efficient and effective. 
- New tools like MIDI Playback, Note by Note, and Chord Explorer offer additional ways to learn, no matter your skill level, Rocksmith+ can help you learn guitar or bass.
LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE WITH PERSONALIZED REAL-TIME FEEDBACK
- Continuously analyzes your performance and song selections to recommend songs and exercises that will allow you to grow your skills and enjoy the learning journey
- The progress tracking system shows your growth day by day, skill by skill, so that you can easily keep track of your results
- The more you play, the more Rocksmith+ will adapt to your learning and help you find more of your favorite songs or discover new ones
USE ANY ACOUSTIC, ELECTRIC, OR BASS GUITAR
- Rocksmith+ mobile app offers phone-as-mic technology to track your learning with no additional gear needed
- This technology will work with acoustic instruments and electric instruments played through an amp
CREATE YOUR OWN GUITAR & BASS ARRANGEMENTS FOR ANY LICENSED SONG
- Rocksmith Workshop is a new user-generated content system on PC that's included with your subscription that allows anyone to transcribe and add arrangements from our pre-licensed songs to the library. 
- Rocksmith Workshop will let users create all aspects of a song arrangement, from the transcription to the tones. Community arrangements are peer-reviewed for quality and available to all users.
*5 million copies of Rocksmith and Rocksmith 2014 sold.
**According to a national research study conducted by C&C Market Research.
**Connection equipment not included. More information at rocksmith.com/info.
Available songs may vary by region and instrument.

Over the last 10 years, over 5 million people have learned to play with the Rocksmith method* and Rocksmith™+ builds on that by featuring a unique visual interface, real-time feedback, and a focus on playing songs. Over 95% of players improved with the Rocksmith method.** Use any piano, keyboard, or MIDI controller or any acoustic, electric, or bass guitar to play a huge library of hit songs with more to come!

Get the most out of your comprehensive learning subscription for years to come with content updates including new interactive lessons, modes and features plus a steady stream of monthly new song additions. Continue your journey on the Rocksmith+ site with free supplemental articles and videos to further hone mechanics. You can learn about proper technique and form, music theory, gear, instrument care and more


LEARN TO PLAY WITH THOUSANDS OF YOUR FAVORITE SONGS
- Discover a large expanding song library with thousands of official master recordings with genres from around the world, including classic, indie, or alternative rock, to hip hop, pop, metal, country, Latin, R&B and more
- Rocksmith+ has a variety of authentic arrangements, just like how artists originally played them, and all songs will be playable on guitar & bass with chord charts to hum and strum to


LEARN PIANO WITH HUNDREDS OF SONGS & NEW LESSONS
- Use any keyboard or digital piano that sends MIDI data and connect directly to your device with a supported cable***
- Use acoustic pianos & keyboard speakers with phone & tablet mic input
- Play hundreds of songs spanning classical, pop, R&B, soundtracks, & more with newly added piano arrangements and a new 3D noteway for beginners
- Toggle Sheet Music view with our option to display traditional music notation
- Learn from expert teachers with newly added interactive video lessons for piano
- With all of Rocksmith+'s real-time feedback, note detection, Adaptive Difficulty, and practice tools like Riff Repeater


PRACTICE TOOLS YOU CAN CONTROL
- The classic Rocksmith noteway returns alongside a new Rocksmith Tablature option for experienced guitarists. 
- Core features like Riff Repeater, Adaptive Difficulty and Video Lessons have been improved to be more efficient and effective. 
- New tools like MIDI Playback, Note by Note, and Chord Explorer offer additional ways to learn, no matter your skill level, Rocksmith+ can help you learn guitar or bass.


LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE WITH PERSONALIZED REAL-TIME FEEDBACK
- Continuously analyzes your performance and song selections to recommend songs and exercises that will allow you to grow your skills and enjoy the learning journey
- The progress tracking system shows your growth day by day, skill by skill, so that you can easily keep track of your results
- The more you play, the more Rocksmith+ will adapt to your learning and help you find more of your favorite songs or discover new ones


USE ANY ACOUSTIC, ELECTRIC, OR BASS GUITAR
- Rocksmith+ mobile app offers phone-as-mic technology to track your learning with no additional gear needed
- This technology will work with acoustic instruments and electric instruments played through an amp


CREATE YOUR OWN GUITAR & BASS ARRANGEMENTS FOR ANY LICENSED SONG
- Rocksmith Workshop is a new user-generated content system on PC that's included with your subscription that allows anyone to transcribe and add arrangements from our pre-licensed songs to the library. 
- Rocksmith Workshop will let users create all aspects of a song arrangement, from the transcription to the tones. Community arrangements are peer-reviewed for quality and available to all users.


*5 million copies of Rocksmith and Rocksmith 2014 sold.
**According to a national research study conducted by C&C Market Research.
**Connection equipment not included. More information at rocksmith.com/info.

Available songs may vary by region and instrument.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00174901:ios.summary:
Love RSS feeds? So do we!!
RSS feeds are a great way to follow updates on your favorite website. However, some sites set up their feeds to only show a portion of each entry, you know, to get you to click through to their actual website. We
bluejetty:00174901:ios.description:
Love RSS feeds? So do we!!
RSS feeds are a great way to follow updates on your favorite website. However, some sites set up their feeds to only show a portion of each entry, you know, to get you to click through to their actual website. We find that really annoying, and we're sure you do too.
Which is why, unlike other RSS feed readers, that either push you into a browser (in-app or otherwise), or depend on third party text parsing services and require you to be online to fetch the full text of one article at a time (which makes it no different from having to click/tap through to a website), in lire, you get your favorite RSS feeds as they should've been. You don't need to click through to any website (though, you do still have the option to, if you really wanted). It takes your favorite partial feeds, does its magic, and converts them in to full feeds, so you don't have to click/tap on those annoying 'Read more' or 'Continue reading' links.
Once they're cached, you don't even need to be connected to read your full-text feeds.
Use as a standalone feed reader, sync with iCloud,
or,
sync with any of the several services: Feedly, Feedbin, FeedHQ, The Old Reader, Inoreader, BazQux Reader, Newsblur, Feed Wrangler, FreshRSS, Miniflux, Nextcloud News, Tiny Tiny RSS.

bluejetty:00099276:ios.summary: In unfamiliar environments, awareness is your best defense. Whether you’re checking into a hotel, renting a short-term apartment, or working in a shared office, there’s always a chance that hidden or unrecognized devices are nearby. This ap
bluejetty:00099276:ios.description:
In unfamiliar environments, awareness is your best defense. Whether you’re checking into a hotel, renting a short-term apartment, or working in a shared office, there’s always a chance that hidden or unrecognized devices are nearby. This app helps you take control with powerful scanning tools that are easy to use and always accessible.
Start with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi analysis, instantly detect all nearby connections and devices with just one tap. Uncover unauthorized access points or unknown connections trying to interact with your phone. It’s perfect for situations where you're unsure who else has been in the space before you, like rentals, hostels, co-working areas, or even public transportation hubs.
The built-in infrared camera filter allows you to visually inspect a room. In low-light or shadowy corners, bright spots in the filtered view may signal the presence of electronics, even those that are otherwise difficult to spot. Quickly scan bedsides, ceilings, air vents, or décor that might conceal technology. The scanner runs quietly and gives you a unique edge in maintaining spatial awareness.
Need to track changes in your network status? The app offers real-time insight into your current IP address and can help flag unexpected changes, giving you clues if your device suddenly connects to a different network without warning.
Every scan session is automatically saved, so you can track what you’ve found, when, and where. This is particularly useful if you visit certain locations frequently, just compare current scans with past ones to identify what’s changed.
Stay calm in new places: the application helps to quickly detect unauthorized devices nearby - in hotels, rented apartments, coworking spaces and other spaces.
Features available only in Premium:
Unlimited scanning of Wi-Fi and Bluetooth devices without limits.
Full-featured infrared signal mode: use the camera filter to find devices even in dark corners.
Advanced network tools: detailed diagnostics of the IP address and tracking of changes at first.
Completely no ads.
Free features:
Useful detection guide
Saving scan history: track their results and compare them during repeat visits.
Basic information about the current network status.
Premium subscription includes a free 3-day trial period. Payment will be written from your iTunes account after confirmation of purchase. The subscription is automatically renewed unless you change it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your account.
No ads and smooth, priority performance.
Privacy and Support:
Explore our privacy policy:https://gilfoylegeneral.digital/PrivacyPolicy.html
Click to review our Terms of Use and understand how we protect your data:https://gilfoylegeneral.digital/TermsOfUse.html
Get in touch with our support service:c.gilfoyle@gilfoylegeneral.digital
Wherever life takes you — stay one step ahead. Download the app and stay informed, alert, and in control.

bluejetty:00178162:ios.description:
IM Calling, this is the only phone application you need in your life and work. It can provide a virtual number to hide text messages and calls, MMS, call history search, free long-distance calls, etc.
[Why the 2nd number is necessary]
Did you know that your personal information is closely related to your phone number? The more strangers know your number, the more likely your privacy will be exposed. However, in many cases, we must tell strangers our phone number. For example, buying and selling things online, ordering tables in restaurants, receiving deliveries, negotiating business...
what should you do? Let IM Calling solve this problem for you by providing you with a second phone number or more phone numbers.
[How IM Calling works]
The second number is like the code between your real phone number and the text message and call. In other words, this is a fake number. When other people call your second number, IM Calling will intercept text messages and calls from other people and route them to your mobile phone. When you call another person, the caller ID shows your virtual number. And no one can find your real number from the virtual number provided by IM Calling.
[Advantages of IM Calling]
Obtain a second or more anonymous phone number to make calls and send text messages, and choose your virtual number to meet your various needs, such as blind dates, call to order food, receive courier...when you don’t need it , Destroy at any time. No contacts, no trouble
Separate your work and personal life and provide the second number to your customers or project partners. Destroy it after the completion of the business or project.
You can choose a local number from more than 12 countries/regions-the United States, England, Canada, France, Germany, Japan... When your family or friends are overseas, you can select a local number from IM Calling to call them , Without having to pay long distance or roaming fees, and without paying any other fees. With IM Calling, you only need WiFi or data, and a small amount of gold coins.
Make cheap international calls as well as text messages, call logs, faxes and prevent spam calls
In-app purchase:
You will become a premium user with an auto-renewable subscription. If you don’t want to subscribe, you can unsubscribe at any time. We offer 1 number, 2 numbers, and 3 numbers to purchase. When you purchase 1 number, you can try it for free for the first three days.
* 1 number Free trial for the first three days, and then automatically renew with $9.99 every month
* 2 numbers are automatically renewed with $16.99 every month
* 3 numbers are automatically renewed with $24.99 every month
*The payment will be deducted from the iTunes account when the purchase is confirmed.
*Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
*The account will be charged for renewal of 1 number, 2 numbers or 3 numbers within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
*Subscriptions can be managed by the user, and auto-renewal can be turned off through the user's ""Account Settings"" after purchase.
*Any unused portion of the free trial period (if provided) will be forfeited when the user subscribes.

Privacy Policy: https://musjoy.com/IM Calling/html/privacy_policy.html

bluejetty:00040007:ios.description:
Bán hàng dễ hơn, quản lý nhẹ hơn với Sổ Bán Hàng
- Bán hàng cùng trợ lý AI: Có AI hỗ trợ chăm khách, chốt đơn, nhắc công nợ và giải đáp các việc kinh doanh mỗi ngày.
- Nhanh, dễ dùng: Ứng dụng chạy mượt, thao tác nhanh ngay cả trên những chiếc điện thoại cấu hình không cao. 
- Bắt đầu trong 5 phút: Cài đặt đơn giản, dễ làm quen, không cần mua thêm máy móc hay thiết bị cồng kềnh.
Sổ Bán Hàng giúp bạn quản lý từ A–Z
- Bán hàng nhanh, chốt đơn dễ: Tạo đơn, tính tiền và lưu thông tin khách hàng chỉ với vài thao tác. Dù bán tại cửa hàng hay bán online đều dễ quản lý. 
- Thu tiền, kiểm tra giao dịch dễ dàng: Nhận thanh toán bằng QR và nhiều hình thức khác. Hệ thống tự động cập nhật và thông báo khi khách thanh toán, giúp hạn chế nhầm lẫn và thất thoát. 
- Quản lý hàng hóa, doanh thu rõ ràng: Nhập - xuất kho dễ dàng bằng quét mã. Theo dõi hàng tồn, doanh thu, lãi lỗ và xem báo cáo ngay trên điện thoại. 
- Bán hàng F&B tiện hơn: Dành cho quán ăn, nhà hàng, cà phê với các tính năng gộp bàn, tách đơn, QR gọi món tại bàn, theo dõi món và doanh thu. Nhân viên phục vụ nhanh hơn, chủ quán dễ kiểm soát hơn. 
- Quản lý khách hàng và công nợ: Theo dõi khách hàng, nhắc công nợ, chăm sóc khách và quản lý chương trình khuyến mãi, tích điểm để khách quay lại nhiều hơn. 
Hệ sinh thái tài chính đồng hành
Sổ Bán Hàng còn kết nối với các giải pháp tài chính và ngân hàng, giúp chủ kinh doanh có thêm cơ hội tiếp cận các nguồn vốn phù hợp khi cần mở rộng việc kinh doanh.
Bảo chứng uy tín từ các chuyên gia: Được phát triển bởi đội ngũ chuyên gia công nghệ cấp cao từ Lazada, OPPO, Be Group và các định chế tài chính lớn, Sổ Bán Hàng tự hào được vinh danh qua các giải thưởng danh giá:
- Quán Quân TECHFEST 2022 do Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ tổ chức.
- Giải thưởng từ Asean Startup Innovation Week, Google, MasterCard Strive và BLOCK71.
Tải ngay Sổ Bán Hàng để bán hàng dễ hơn, quản lý nhẹ hơn, phát triển kinh doanh hiệu quả hơn.

- Chính sách bảo mật: https://sobanhang.com/chinh-sach-bao-mat/

bluejetty:00162107:ios.name: JET – scooter sharing
bluejetty:00162107:ios.summary:
JET is a scooter rental service using a mobile application. You can rent an electric scooter at one of the hundreds of parking lots located around the city and complete the rental wherever it suits you.
Kicksharing, bike sharing... What is
bluejetty:00162107:ios.description:
JET is a scooter rental service using a mobile application. You can rent an electric scooter at one of the hundreds of parking lots located around the city and complete the rental wherever it suits you.
Kicksharing, bike sharing... What is it and how does it work?
Call it whatever is convenient for you – in fact, the JET service is a stationless electric scooter rental.
To rent a vehicle, you don’t need to visit a pick-up point, communicate with an employee and provide a deposit in the form of a passport or a certain amount of money.
All you need to rent:
Download the application and register in the service. You only need a phone number, registration will take 2-3 minutes.
Find the electric scooter on the map or at the nearest parking lot.
Scan QR on the steering wheel, through the built-in function in the app.
The rental has started – enjoy your trip! You can find out more about the rules for using the service on the website: https://jetshr.com/rules/
In which countries is the service available?
The service is available in Kazakhstan, Georgia, Uzbekistan, Mongolia, Brazil, and Chile.
You can rent a scooter in any of these cities through the JET app. The rental rules for different cities may differ, so we recommend that you familiarize yourself with them before renting, but in general, if you used similar rentals such as Urent, Whoosh, VOI, Bird, Lime, Bolt or others, the principle of renting will not be much different.
If you want to open the JET service in your city, leave a request on the website: start.jetshr.com
You will not find this in other services:
MULTI RENT
Rent an electric scooter for the whole family. To do this, you only need one JET account. You can rent up to 5 scooters with one account. Just open several scooters in sequence by scanning their QR codes.
WAITING AND RESERVATION
Our application has a waiting and booking function. You can book an electric scooter in the app and it will wait for you for 10 minutes for free. During the rental period, you can close the lock and put the scooter in ""standby"" mode, the rental will continue, but the lock will be closed. You can go about your business without worrying about the safety of the scooter.
BONUS ZONES
You can complete the lease in a special green area and get bonuses for it. To receive bonuses, you must make a lease lasting more than 10 minutes.
Rent price:
The rental price may vary in different cities. You can see the current rental price in the application by clicking on the electric scooter icon. You can also buy one of the bonus packages, the higher the value of the bonus package, the larger the amount will be credited to your account as bonuses.
Powerbank station
Is your phone or laptop out of charge? Find a powerbank station on the map in the app and rent it. Just scan the QR code of the station. Charge up - cables are built-in. There are Type-C, micro-USB, and Lightning for iPhone. You can return the charger to any station.
Download the JET kicksharing app – a welcome bonus awaits you inside, try the service and leave a review. Your opinion is very important to us. Enjoy your trip!

bluejetty:00188199:ios.summary:
PocketBible enhances your walk with God by putting resources and features at your disposal to improve your understanding of Scripture, empower your teaching and ministry, and keep you in the Word every day.
PocketBible couldn't be simpler
bluejetty:00188199:ios.description:
PocketBible enhances your walk with God by putting resources and features at your disposal to improve your understanding of Scripture, empower your teaching and ministry, and keep you in the Word every day.
PocketBible couldn't be simpler to use. Go anywhere in the Bible by selecting book, chapter, and verse. Split the screen to view Bibles and commentaries side-by-side. Select the "Today" button to read today's devotional or Bible reading plan. Search for any word or verse in any book in your library. Take notes, highlight, and bookmark your Bibles; share these annotations with PocketBible running on any of your devices.
When you install PocketBible, you'll have instant access to the KJV Bible. Register to get access to over 50 free resources, including:
• 11 Bibles
• 4 extensive commentaries and cross-reference resources
• 6 Bible dictionaries
• 17 Bible reading plans and devotionals
• 14 other reference works
Hundreds of additional Bibles and contemporary reference books are available. Bibles and reference books reside on your device. No Internet connection is required once they've been downloaded.
Are you already a PocketBible user? PocketBible for iOS can access any of your previously purchased books and Bibles. And the notes, highlights, or bookmarks you've created on another platform will sync seamlessly to PocketBible on your iOS device!
FEATURES: 
• Easy book, chapter, and verse selection. 
• Quickly find any word or phrase in your entire library.

bluejetty:00017817:ios.name: Easy Pivot Point
bluejetty:00017817:ios.summary:
Pivot points are widely used by traders to identify potential support and resistance levels based on the previous period’s high, low and close.
Easy Pivot Point automatically calculates and displays pivot levels for major currency pairs, i
bluejetty:00017817:ios.description:
Pivot points are widely used by traders to identify potential support and resistance levels based on the previous period’s high, low and close.
Easy Pivot Point automatically calculates and displays pivot levels for major currency pairs, indices, commodities and exotic instruments, across multiple timeframes in a clean, focused dashboard built for fast decision making.
Whether you are trading ranges, breakouts or monitoring key levels, this app helps you instantly see where price is positioned relative to important pivot zones.
-----------
Why Traders Use Pivot Points
• If price trades above the Pivot Point, sentiment is generally considered bullish
• If price trades below the Pivot Point, sentiment is considered bearish
• Support and resistance levels (S1–S3, R1–R3) often act as reaction zones
• Breaks beyond R3 or S3 may signal strong continuation or exhaustion
Pivot levels are especially popular in the FX market, where many instruments fluctuate within defined ranges.
-----------
What Makes Easy Pivot Point Different
• Real-time dashboard showing where price is trading relative to pivot levels
• Clean summary insight for each instrument (no chart clutter)
• Expandable ladder view showing the nearest two levels around current price
• Smart grouping for faster scanning
• Multi-timeframe support: H1, H4, Daily, Weekly and Monthly
Designed to be fast, focused and distraction-free.
-----------
Alerts That Matter
Subscribers can enable alerts when price interacts with key pivot levels.
• Break above resistance
• Break below support
• Timeframe-specific alerts
• Easily manage alerts per instrument
Premium: Daily alerts
Unlimited: All timeframes
-----------
Important Note
Pivot points are short-term indicators and are most effective within the active trading period of the selected timeframe. They are not long-term forecasting tools.
-----------
Subscription Information
If you choose to subscribe:
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
• You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings
Premium plan: $3.99 USD per month
Unlimited plan: $7.99 USD per month
Prices may vary by country.
Privacy Policy:
http://easyindicators.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use:
http://easyindicators.com/terms.html
-----------
We welcome feedback and suggestions.
Contact us via the in-app support feature or email: support@easyindicators.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/easyindicators
Twitter: @EasyIndicators

bluejetty:00131809:ios.description:
Dark Reader is an eye-care Safari extension that enables night mode by creating dark themes for websites on the fly. It inverts bright colors to make web pages high contrast and easier to read. Dark Reader integrates seamlessly with system dark mode.
Adjust brightness and contrast to match your display and ambient lighting. Enable dark mode on every web page or give websites a sepia tone. Select from multiple color theme presets or create your own by customizing background and text colors. Enable or disable Dark Reader for specific websites, automatically sync with system dark mode, or detect already dark websites and leave them unchanged.
Developed by the original creators of Dark Reader. Since 2014, we continuously evolve alongside modern web technologies to deliver fast and reliable dark mode support for people sensitive to bright light.
A single purchase includes access to the macOS version (Safari browser) when using the same iCloud account.
Dark Reader contains no ads and does not collect user data.
Enable Dark Reader in Safari preferences and disable similar extensions to prevent conflicts. Enjoy browsing!

bluejetty:00024650:ios.description:
Caught in prison for a crime I didn't commit...
Now, let’s escape without getting caught by the police!
'Super Prison Escape' - What kind of game?
Escape from prison and find the real culprit!
Look for safe places and sometimes team up with fellow prisoners to deceive the eyes of the police officers!
Pick up items around the field and use them in the right places.
You might be able to buy some time and escape by trapping the police officers.
Never give up until the very end!
Because you can take control of your own life!
◆Escape drama with easy controls!◆
First, get items on the field with touch controls.
It's crucial how you use these items to deceive the police officers.
You can use the items you’ve picked up by dragging and dropping them in specific places.
There are many spots in the field where you can perform this action.
If you use them incorrectly, you might get caught by the police again!
Although the prison is a lonely place, there are kind fellow prisoners.
By cooperating with them, you can achieve things that seem difficult at first glance.
What awaits you beyond the thrilling escape drama? What is the identity of the real culprit who framed him?
Play now and witness his fate!

bluejetty:00017084:ios.description:
Download the Triple R app and listen to all your favourite shows anytime, anywhere.
Stream live radio, listen back to previous episodes On Demand, or check out Triple R Recommended content!
For nearly 50 years, Triple R has shaped and inspired the culture of Melbourne/Naarm. Since its inception as an educational broadcaster in 1976, Triple R has become one of Australia’s most influential community radio stations.
Broadcasting on 102.7FM, 3RRR Digital and rrr.org.au, the Triple R grid houses over 70 diverse programs. Music shows cover every genre imaginable from hip hop to punk rock, from R&B and electro to jazz, hip hop, country and metal. Specialist talks programs delve into topics as varied as the environment, politics, science, gardening, film, literature, the arts and local interests.
APP FEATURES
- Live radio on the go, 24/7
- Immediate access to Triple R 102.7FM on your phone
- Tune in to live radio, and catch up on a year’s worth of radio On Demand
- Explore Triple R’s full weekly schedule
- Listen back to previous episodes of your favourite shows
- Explore Triple R Recommends highlights and interviews
- Browse curated collections of our programs
- CarPlay functionality
- Casting to smart devices

bluejetty:00142043:ios.name: BreathNow - blood pressure app
bluejetty:00142043:ios.summary: BreathNow is a powerful blood pressure app, heart rate monitor and stress monitor for Apple Watch which helps to relax and lower blood pressure, pulse and stress with breathing exercises, meditations and more. Includes cardio fitness test f
bluejetty:00142043:ios.description:
BreathNow is a powerful blood pressure app, heart rate monitor and stress monitor for Apple Watch which helps to relax and lower blood pressure, pulse and stress with breathing exercises, meditations and more. Includes cardio fitness test from the University of Cambridge. Requires external blood pressure monitor to take blood pressure readings.
Key app features:
Measure heart rate, stress and cardio fitness with your phone’s camera or Apple Watch.
Track and lower blood pressure and pulse with calming activities, no meds
Get daily cardio insights and manage heart health risks
Perform slow breathing and meditate to lower anxiety, BP, heart rate and stress
Fall asleep easily with guided breathing on Apple Watch
Easily measure which relaxation techniques worked best for you
The main advantage of BreathNow blood pressure app is that it is not only a blood pressure & heart rate monitor and stress monitor. It also provides practical tools to lower blood pressure and heart rate with meditation, slow breathing exercises and more. 
Measure heart rate, stress and cardio fitness (VO2Max) with your phone’s camera, no external sensors needed. Our cardio fitness (VO2Max) test is developed by scientists from the University of Cambridge. 
Enter your blood pressure data manually or connect your external blood pressure monitor to Apple Health via Bluetooth and analyse what activities helped you to lower blood pressure. Your data are stored securely in Apple Health and you may print them out or share remotely with your doctor. 
BreathNow alerts you to important cardio signals like elevated heart rate, blood pressure, stress, irregular heart rhythm (also known as Afib) and low blood oxygen level if it is detected by your Apple Watch.
If BreathNow identifies a risk area from one of the daily indicators, it will suggest a user to perform an activity from an extended list to reduce a heart health risk. Choose between: slow breathing, meditation, acupressure, calming music, yoga and other activities. The list of breathing exercises includes lower BP breathing, 4-7-8 meditation breathing exercise, IMST breathing exercise, box breathing etc.
BreatheNow blood pressure app features:
+ Free heart rate and stress monitor for iPhone and Apple Watch
+ Free blood pressure tracker
+ Free daily heart risk insights
+ Free cardio fitness test from the University of Cambridge
+ Free breathing exercise to lower blood pressure for iPhone and Apple Watch
+ Free instructional videos to lower heart health risks
+ Plans to lower blood pressure
+ Broad selection of meditation and other activities to lower anxiety, BP, stress and pulse
+ Reminders
+ Leaderboard for motivation
+ Your data stored securely in Apple Health
Terms of Use https://www.dmitrikonash.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy https://www.dmitrikonash.com/privacy-policy
Supports iPhone with iOS15 and above.
We offer auto-renewing in-app subscriptions for a Pro version which includes all heart rate meditation, breathing exercise app, meditation breathing exercise. Payments will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews at the end of the period unless cancelled by the user.
PLEASE NOTE: Heart rate monitor results may differ from heart rate measured by a medical device. BreathNow blood pressure app requires an external blood pressure monitor for taking blood pressure readings. 
DISCLAIMER: BreathNow blood pressure app does NOT provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice. Please seek doctor's advice for any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00184220:ios.description:
China Bank Mobile App is a FREE app that lets you access your China Bank account 24/7 using your smart phone.
Manage your finances and do more with China Bank Mobile at your fingertips –
• Balance inquiry
• Pay your bills
• Transfer funds
• Access to Emergency Cash. Soon, you can withdraw in any BancNet ATM without a China Bank ATM card.
• Send money to anyone (Coming soon.)
China Banking Corporation (Philippines), more popularly known as China Bank, initially catered to the needs of the Filipino-Chinese community. Established in 1920, the Bank was a vital key player in the reconstruction and economic recovery of the country after World War II. In 1927, China Bank was listed in the local stock exchange and in 1969 became the first local bank to process deposit accounts online. In 1991, the bank procured its universal banking license.
Today, China Bank is one of largest private universal banks in the Philippines. It offers a wide range of financial products and services through its vast network of branches and ATMs both in-bank and off-site. China Bank maintains its focus on building a customer-centric organization and building on the foundations for sustainability, as well as laying the groundwork to be able to compete in the digital banking sphere. It has continued to expand its branch network, strengthen its manpower with highly skilled professionals, enhance its technological platforms, and enter into new business lines.
It also provides merger and acquisition, capital raising, debt and securities underwriting, financial restructuring, and economic advisory services by way of its investment banking arm, China Bank Capital Corporation, and securities brokerage through China Bank Securities. It also provides insurance brokerage services and bancassurance through its subsidiaries China Bank Insurance Brokers Inc. and Manulife China Bank Life Assurance Corporation, respectively. The Bank has more than 500 branches nationwide, including more than 150 from its thrift banking subsidiary, China Bank Savings.
China Bank is also one of the first banks to distribute EMV-ready ATM cards in compliance with the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, and has also recently upgraded its online personal banking portal to better serve its ever-evolving set of clientele.

The intuitive and
bluejetty:00016212:ios.description:
Color Splash lets you give photos a dramatic look by converting them to black and white, while keeping your chosen details in color. This effect draws the viewers' attention to the colored areas, creating striking images.
The intuitive and responsive multi-touch user interface makes Color Splash amazingly easy and fun to use. Use your finger as a brush to "paint" sections of your image black and white, or to bring back the original color. Zooming in and out using the two-finger pinching gesture allows you to work on details with pixel-accuracy.
Features:
- Short tutorial videos explain the use of all features and will have you editing your images in minutes.
- Choose photos to edit from your iPhone photo library or from Dropbox or Flickr.
- Save multiple sessions to resume your work later.
- Email your creations to friends, share them on Flickr or save them to your Dropbox.
- Undo any number of accidental brush strokes.
- An alternative view mode highlights the regions that will remain in color with a red tint. This makes it easier to see and adjust the boundaries between color and black & white regions.
- Choose from 4 different brushes (hard or soft edged, opaque or transparent) and adjust the brush size.
- Hide the toolbars in full screen mode.

Your ship is always moving forward and all you have to do is tilt or tap to turn left and right to collect 1
bluejetty:00146826:ios.description:
15 Coins is a deceptively difficult minimalistic arcade game with one goal: collect 15 Coins before you are killed by your clones.
Your ship is always moving forward and all you have to do is tilt or tap to turn left and right to collect 15 Coins. The only thing standing between you and victory are endless clones that follow the path you've traveled. Crash into a clone and it’s game over. You’re not alone though, you can collect a power-up to temporarily freeze the clones and smash into them to destroy them!
Can you avoid your clones long enough to collect 15 Coins?
================
"15 Coins is a rather intriguing game that I have fun playing, and a fantastic example of how minimalistic, challenging arcade games should be done." - 148apps.com - Rated 4.0/5.0
"15 Coins is a simple arcade style game that is impossibly difficult. Similar to Flappy Bird, it makes you want to keep playing over and over, no matter how poorly you perform, just to try to get one more coin before you die…" - iDownloadBlog.com - No Rating
"15 Coins is hard. Alright, that was the shortest review I've ever written. I'll be back Monday." - Cult of Mac - 4.0/5.0
"If you're a fan of these minimalistic arcade games that are all about skills and reflexes, then you should pick this one up." - App Advice - Rated 4.5/5.0
"Worth Way More Than 15 Of Your Coins" - Apple'N'Apps - Rated 4.0/5.0
"Extremely simple. Extremely hard. Extremely addictive" - Appgefahren.de - No Rating
"15 Coins has me locked in a cycle of trying to outdo myself. It's a stylish and accessible game that's worth a look for anybody who enjoys quickfire action and high score-chasing." - PocketGamer - No Rating

bluejetty:00131630:ios.description:
Nutrition for people who take their results seriously.
You put too much work into your training to leave your nutrition to chance.
The RP Diet Coach App gives you the structure, planning, and accountability to lose fat, build muscle, and get more out of your training. Built by experts and designed for people serious about changing their physique.
Serious goals require more than just tracking.
What you get with the RP Diet Coach App
• Personalized calories and macros based on your goals
• Meal-by-meal targets for how much to eat and when
• Weekly nutrition targets with flexibility for training, rest days, and life
• Weekly reviews and recommended adjustments based on your progress
• AI Meal Scanner for estimating macros from a photo
• AI nutrition label scanning for fast food logging
• Recipe Builder that creates meals to fit your macros
• 750,000+ foods, restaurant entries, and barcode scanning
• Raw vs. cooked food tracking
• Flexible scheduling and meal reminders
• HealthKit integration
Built for people who train
Logging calories and macros tells you what you ate. RP Diet Coach helps you know what to do next.
Your plan is built around your body, goals, training, and schedule. The app helps you plan your meals, manage your weekly nutrition, and adjust your diet based on your actual progress.
Your nutrition shouldn't exist separately from your training.
Whether you're cutting to get lean, eating more to build muscle, or maintaining while focusing on performance, RP Diet Coach helps keep your nutrition aligned with your training and goals.
Stop guess. Start executing.
Subscription pricing and terms: 
We offer 2 different subscriptions that provide full access to the app and all its features. You can choose to subscribe monthly or annually.
If you purchase a RP Diet Coach subscription, please note billing and charges are done through your iTunes account and auto-renewed based on your subscription term. At the end of the term, unless auto-renewable subscription is disabled, your subscription will automatically renew in your iTunes account. You will be charged for the regular price of your subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of the current term. Your subscription can be managed or cancelled in your Apple ID Account Settings.
Privacy Policy:
https://rpstrength.com/policies/privacy-policy
Terms of Service:
https://rpstrength.com/policies/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00023224:ios.summary:
"Warning! Fatal Error: System integrity severely compromised..."
This is an unprecedented threat to the existence of Dolls. In face of formidable enemies and a future filled with uncertainties, the scattered Dolls grit their teeth and steel
bluejetty:00023224:ios.description:
"Warning! Fatal Error: System integrity severely compromised..."
This is an unprecedented threat to the existence of Dolls. In face of formidable enemies and a future filled with uncertainties, the scattered Dolls grit their teeth and steel themselves as they travel in search of the slim hope of salvation.
Humankind may have abandoned them, but as the person in charge of "Project Neural Cloud", you have steadfastly set foot in this unknown land and founded the "Exiles" as you take in meandering Dolls. With you as their leader, the Exiles shall explore the secrets of the world, find a way out of this desperate situation, and uncover the truth...
「Unique and intricate characters」
Next-gen Dolls from all walks of life await your orders. Seek them out and expand the ranks of the Exiles. Train your favorite Dolls and help them break free of the shackles on their neural clouds. Uncover their hidden pasts... Hush, those are secrets between you and your Dolls.
「Combat that calls for both strength and strategy」
Experience a brand-new combat mode that embodies the essence of roguelike games, with meticulous settings and characterization. Take risks and engage powerful enemies, play it safe and carefully plan your moves with the big picture in mind, or play it by ear and improvise depending on the situation⁠—more than one path leads to victory. Organize your ranks and come up with viable team comps while making good use of friendship buffs, and leave the rest to the Exiles.
「Fun and functional construction system」
Gather materials on your journey to construct and upgrade facilities within the Oasis, the Exiles’ new home. Build a city based on your preferences, upgrade its infrastructure, and construct dormitories to obtain rich resources and powerful buffs. May you and your beloved Dolls enjoy a brief respite before you set off on your next adventure.

bluejetty:00036479:ios.description:
Unlock your artistic potential with Donny! Turn all your ideas into breathtaking AI art in seconds. Enter a prompt, pick a style, and watch the magic unfold! 
Want a unique portrait? Just upload your photo, choose a style, and let Donny's AI work its magic. Upgrade your digital profile —transforming ordinary photos into extraordinary art!
► Diverse Art Styles
Experiment with various styles, from Pixar cartoon to photorealism. Find the style that transforms your vision into stunning artwork. Create your own world with any characters you want!
► AI Tattoo
Generate one-of-a-kind tattoo designs in seconds with Donny's powerful AI. Describe your idea, and watch as our technology brings your vision to life, creating unique and amazing tattoo designs!
► AI Avatar
Transform yourself with Donny. Upload your photo, choose a style, and let our technology work its magic. Create extraordinary avatars, exploring various styles and characters.

Craft exceptional logos effortlessly! Just share your brand idea and transform your brand vision into unique designs. Elevate your brand identity with ease!

Describe your vision, and Donny will craft one-of-a-kind artwork tailored for your room or home. Download in high resolution for proud display.

Share your original artwork with friends directly from the app.. Choose from an array of styles and proudly say, "I created it myself!"
Stuck on ideas? Let us guide you! Get creative suggestions for your prompts, ensuring your AI-generated art is always unique and captivating.
Donny is more than an app; it's your gateway to a world of creativity. With our user-friendly interface, anyone can become an artist. Whether you're a design enthusiast or someone looking to enhance your social media presence with stunning avatars, Donny has you covered.

bluejetty:00135261:ios.summary: It's that time of year when Santa's elves visit your home checking off their naughty or nice list. Like track Santa, you can now track elves. This year you'll be ready to catch them on camera using Elf Cam. Your kids will scream at the magi
bluejetty:00135261:ios.description:
It's that time of year when Santa's elves visit your home checking off their naughty or nice list. Like track Santa, you can now track elves. This year you'll be ready to catch them on camera using Elf Cam. Your kids will scream at the magical site of seeing their elf running around their own home. 
Enjoy Elf Cam, the original AR Elf camera app. 
WATCH YOUR ELF COME TO LIFE
Choose your elf, pick a route and let your Elf run wild around your home. Catch it on camera and watch the delight of your children when you show them the magic. 
CREATE YOUR OWN ELF
- Unleash your creativity by designing your personalized Christmas elf.
- Customize colors, hats, gloves, attire, glasses, and more to your heart's content.
- Explore endless outfit combinations and express your festive spirit.
- Feeling undecided? Try our Randomize feature to generate a charming Christmas elf for you.DESIGN YOUR OWN ELF
SUPER SIMPLE
It's super fun to make your Elf, jump, crawl, run, dance and be a the cheeky Elf that it is. You should know that your Elf does has a mind of its own and will 'on occasion' improvise and wiggle it's bottom at the camera. 
VIDEO FILTERS
Add more magic to your videos by adding one of our video filters. Try out night vision, CCTV or make it snow in your living room.
SHARE THE MAGIC
We built this for our kids, but we wanted to share the joy with the world. We'd love to see your videos, reactions and delight if you feel like sharing with us. 
SUBSCRIPTION
There is a small annual subscription fee to use the app once downloaded. Cancel at any time.
LEGAL
Support: hello@elfcam.app
Privacy Policy: www.elfcam.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: www.elfcam.app/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00033472:ios.name: To The Trenches: WW1 Army RTS
bluejetty:00033472:ios.summary:
Command a WW1 army in pixel-art trench warfare. Send infantry over the top, call in artillery and gas strikes to dominate the front lines.
Real-time strategy that can be played fully offline, with a large roster of nations, changing weather
bluejetty:00033472:ios.description:
Command a WW1 army in pixel-art trench warfare. Send infantry over the top, call in artillery and gas strikes to dominate the front lines.
Real-time strategy that can be played fully offline, with a large roster of nations, changing weather and an endless campaign where no two battles are alike.
Free to play with no ads of any kind. One purchase unlocks every nation, skill and elite units.
Lead your army through the chaos of 1917 Trench Warfare in this retro-style military strategy game. Command infantry, deploy brutal artillery strikes and dominate the battlefield with tactical precision. Procedurally generated battles mean every fight offers new challenges.
▶ FEATURES ◀
[PROCEDURAL BATTLES]
- Procedurally generated battlefields, so no two wars are alike.
- Face dilemmas that can change morale, rewards and your troops' stats.
[SPECIALIZED UNITS]
- Unlock, upgrade and deploy Sharpshooters, Flame Troopers, Sentries, Trench Raiders and Medics.
- Call in artillery, and with Unlimited add Tanks, Armored Vehicles, Mortar Teams and Strafing Runs.
- Grow your army through the in-depth Officer Tree and your platoon officers.
[AUTHENTIC WW1 SETTING]
- Detailed pixel art shows the brutality of trench warfare.
- Fight through mud, and with Unlimited, lightning storms, blizzards and sandstorms that change your tactics.
[UNIQUE FACTIONS]
- Play Germany, France, Britain or Austria-Hungary for free. Every nation has two faction perks that change how it fights.
[OFFLINE FRIENDLY]
- Battles play without an internet connection.
▶ WHAT'S FREE ◀
- Procedurally generated battles, artillery, mud and platoon officers
- Most of the Officer Tree
- Germany, France, Britain and Austria-Hungary
- Seasonal events
- No intrusive ads
▶ WHAT UNLIMITED ADDS ◀
One purchase, no subscription, unlocks:
- More nations: Italy, Ottoman Empire, Russia, the USA, Canada, Bulgaria and Serbia
- Tanks and armored vehicles
- Specialists: Sharpshooters, Flame Troopers, Sentries, Trench Raiders and Medics
- Grenades, Mortar Teams and Strafing Runs
- Weather: lightning storms, blizzards and sandstorms
- Daily, weekly and monthly missions
Command. Adapt. Survive.
Do you have what it takes to lead your army to victory? Enlist now and head To The Trenches!
▶ SOCIALS ◀

bluejetty:00180528:ios.description:
Acronis Mobile protects your mobile data against accidental deletion, lost devices, and online attacks by delivering easy, reliable and complete backup for all of your iOS smartphones and tablets.
With hybrid protection that’s better than the backup that comes with your phone, Acronis Mobile offers reliable data protection for your mobile devices, ensuring your contacts, photos, videos, reminders, and calendars are safe, accessible, and private. You can simultaneously back up your mobile files to the Acronis cloud and a local computer (Mac or PC) – using your Wi-Fi network to save on data charges.
Need to retrieve a specific photo or contact? The new Acronis Mobile lets you browse your backup files for the individual item you want, without having to restore everything.
\*\*\* Note: This app is not designed to work with business-oriented Acronis Cyber Protect. If you are looking for the mobile backup app for your business, search for “Acronis Cyber Protect” \*\*\*
Features
• Protect an unlimited number of mobile devices
• Back up contacts, photos, videos, calendars, and reminders 
• Browse back up files to recover a specific item or make a full recovery 
• Back up to the cloud and a local computer (PC or Mac) at the same time 
• Access backup files to retrieve data from the current device or your other mobile devices
• Ensure greater data privacy by encrypting your mobile backups
• “Save Power Mode” helps manage battery usage, stopping continuous backups when power is low 
• Back Up continuously while charging
• Save data charges with the “Use Wi-Fi Only” setting, or back up on-the-go via your cell connection
• Access backed up data from any device, anytime, anywhere
• Manage all of your backups with an intuitive, user-friendly dashboard 
The newly redesigned Acronis Mobile delivers backups that are easy, reliable, and complete.

bluejetty:00183560:ios.summary: Stop guessing at checkout. Sales Tax & Discount Calculator gives you the out-the-door total fast—after percent-off discounts, coupons, rebates, sales tax, and tip. It also handles multiple local taxes (state + county + city) and reverse cal
bluejetty:00183560:ios.description:
Stop guessing at checkout. Sales Tax & Discount Calculator gives you the out-the-door total fast—after percent-off discounts, coupons, rebates, sales tax, and tip. It also handles multiple local taxes (state + county + city) and reverse calculations when you only know the final total.
Great for questions like:
• “What’s the final price after 20% off and 8.25% sales tax?”
• “How much do I pay after a coupon and tax?”
• “What’s 30% off $79.99, then tax?”
• “If the total is $108.37, what was the pre-tax price?”
• “What’s the subtotal before tax?” / “What’s the after-tax total?”
• “What’s the total with state + county + city tax?”
• “How much should I tip on $42.50 at 18%?”
• “Split this bill between 3 people (with tip).”
FEATURES
• Sales tax calculator with quick tax-rate changes
• Discount & rebate calculator (percent off)
• Apply up to 3 sales taxes (e.g., state + county + city)
• Reverse price calculation (work backward from the total)
• Tip calculator (percentage)
• Split bills in seconds
• Share results via Messages or email
• Works great on iPhone & iPad (Split View / Slide Over, landscape)
Whether you’re shopping, dining out, or comparing prices, this app is a fast way to double-check totals before you pay—so you know exactly what you’re spending.

bluejetty:00180915:ios.name: VR Jurassic Dino Park World
bluejetty:00180915:ios.summary: This VR Jurassic Dino Park World & Roller Coaster 360 Cartoon game designed for smartphones, allows both you and your children to fully sink in the amazing world of dinosaurs and a prehistoric adventure. You just need to put on a virtual r
bluejetty:00180915:ios.description:
This VR Jurassic Dino Park World & Roller Coaster 360 Cartoon game designed for smartphones, allows both you and your children to fully sink in the amazing world of dinosaurs and a prehistoric adventure. You just need to put on a virtual reality device like vr-box etc. to fully enjoy the wonderful experience of seeing dinosaurs in a first person. 
A virtual reality game for the entire family.
It is about dinosaurs. Yes, it is true that it is about dinosaurs and a theme park. However, in the movie heroes had to deal with bloodthirsty raptors and a t-rex who loves to eat layers. Dinosaurs which you can find in this game are among most tame creatures in a gaming history. It is a dino park simulator where your kids are not only going to have fun but also, learn a lot about these mighty creatures which once ruled the entire world. The best part of it though is the fact, that your children can simply use their own smartphones to access this wonderful world of adventure.
Key features:
-VR Jurassic Dino Park World & Roller Coaster 360 Cartoon is a virtual reality game in which, you visit dinosaurs from era of Jurassic. Go this park now. 
-Enjoy 18 different rollercoaster rides. During each one of them, dinosaurs are going to accompany you. 
-You don't need VR goggles to enjoy the game. 
-Enjoy the movie mode and learn the history of the island, dinosaurs and your own character.
-Use the free roam mode to observe dinosaurs in their own habitats. 
A 360 virtual reality experience with many things to do.
In order to make a game interesting, it has to provide players with something to do. It is the absolute basis of a proper entertainment. This dino world simulator game provides your children with a real, theme park like experience filled with joy and entertainment. 
First of all, there is a mode where the child can jump into 18 different rollercoaster. Each one of them is going to take your child for a ride, during which he or she is going to be accompanied by different species of dinosaurs. Creatures like velociraptors, brachiosaurs, stegosaurs, triceratops or even a mighty t-rex can be seen up close from the first point of view. Remember though, that these animals are much bigger, stronger and more dangerous than any other species currently living on earth. This adventure certainly is not for scared one. For those of you who might want to know more, the rollercoaster rides which you can find here are the same like the ones which you can find in the realistic VR Jurassic. 
There is also a free roam mode. Here you can freely move around the park and watch dinosaurs which live on the entire Jurassic island. These creatures are not blocked by any boundaries. Hence, you will be able to observe them in their own habitats. Learn about their behavior etc. You can walk with them and simply observe what they do. It can easily be compared to a big open zoo or a safari. Though, you should notice that in both zoo as well as on safari you cannot find dinosaurs. Only a virtual reality can provide you with such an experience. 
Another interesting thing which you can do in the game is to enjoy a so-called movie mode. Here you can watch various movies about the history of the island itself, as well as history of your own character. You wake up in the middle of a jungle and you have to do everything to survive, while being mesmerized by the beauty of it.
You don't need VR goggles to play!
Despite the fact, that this is a virtual reality roller coaster game you don't need the VR goggles at all to enjoy it. The game and all elements which you can find in it, can be easily played without the VR. It is still going to be enjoyable and fun for you and your children. In general VR Jurassic Dino Park World & Roller Coaster 360 Cartoon is a game for everyone with a lot of an educational value about dinosaurs.

bluejetty:00034027:ios.description:
Ready for a word-guessing challenge? 
PixelPhrase ™ Guess The Word is here to elevate your experience! Forget the easy 4 pics or 2 pictures riddles—now guess the word from just one image. Challenge yourself with the ultimate AI-generated pictures in this word puzzle!
This word-brain game offers hundreds of levels with eye-catching images created by artificial intelligence. Guess the word from a wide variety of unique puzzles and enjoy this word challenge daily!
How to Play: 
Guess the word from the pic! Each level features a unique AI-generated picture, and you need to type the correct word to solve the puzzle.
For example:
- Milk bottles shaking hands? The word is "milkshake."
- A worm in a book? The word is "bookworm."
Challenge your skills and enjoy hundreds of exciting levels in this pic-to-word game!
Game Features:
- Hundreds of unique images with new ones added regularly.
- Perfect for both adults and kids.
- Use power-ups to reveal letters, disable unused letters, and get hints when you’re stuck.
- Pics-based challenges that test your word-guessing skills.
Challenge your friends with these unique pic word riddles and become the top word-guessing master!

bluejetty:00081834:ios.summary:
Master the art of inventory management in this unique auto-battle strategy game! Pack your bag with powerful weapons and magical artifacts, then watch your hero unleash devastating combos in thrilling PvP duels.
STRATEGIC INVENTORY MANAGEM
bluejetty:00081834:ios.description:
Master the art of inventory management in this unique auto-battle strategy game! Pack your bag with powerful weapons and magical artifacts, then watch your hero unleash devastating combos in thrilling PvP duels.
STRATEGIC INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
Every slot in your backpack matters! Craft, merge, and strategically arrange items to create powerful synergies. The right combination of weapons and artifacts can mean the difference between victory and defeat. Expand your inventory space to unlock even more tactical possibilities.
CHOOSE YOUR PATH TO VICTORY
Command a diverse roster of heroes, each with unique abilities and playstyles. Whether you prefer to rain down elemental spells, charge into battle with steel and valor, or strike from afar with deadly precision, there’s a hero that matches your strategic vision.
DYNAMIC PLACEMENT SYSTEM
More than just collecting items — it’s where you place them that counts. Adjacent items can enhance each other’s power, creating unexpected combinations and devastating effects. Experiment with different layouts to discover powerful synergies and create your own meta-defining strategies.
COMPETITIVE PVP BATTLES
Test your tactics against players from around the world in intense 1v1 matches. Study your opponents, adapt your strategy, and climb the rankings to prove yourself in the arena. With each battle bringing new challenges, no two fights are ever the same.
REWARDING PROGRESSION
Your journey to the top is filled with epic rewards and achievements. Unlock powerful new items, expand your tactical options, and watch your rank climb as you master the art of inventory combat. Regular updates bring fresh content and new strategic possibilities to explore.
Ready to pack your bag and join the Brawl? Your legend begins now!

bluejetty:00186737:ios.name: Distant Suns 5
bluejetty:00186737:ios.description:
Distant Suns: The night sky, reimagined.
2013 finalist in the Family category of TabTimes' best tablet app contest;
"I am putting together some mobile astronomy apps for our local "Sky's the Limit" Observatory in Twentynine Palms, CA. I have been searching for something as good as, or better than, Distant Suns. Short answer: I have not found it yet. ...nothing portrays the night sky as well as Distant Suns. 
Distant Suns has been your personal guide to the cosmos since 1985. First on the desktop, now right in your hands. While others play games, you can travel to the stars.
Award-winning Distant Suns has the reputation of both having one of the most realistic displays of the night sky, while being one of the easiest to use astronomy apps for casual sky watchers as well as serious astronomers. 
•Named in the "100 Essential Apps" by iLounge
•Featured on NPR's MarketPlace 
Features include:
•No Internet required. Just a sense of wonder.
•View from the Earth or out in the solar system
•Simply aim and gaze.
•Over 18 million pinpoint stars scintillating like diamond dust in the palm of your hand (18 mil? Yup.)
•Integrated with NASA's Night Sky Network space events in your area (US only at present)
•What's Up? Gives a quick one snapshot overview of the evening's sky
•Realistic ghostly band of the Milky Way
•Stories behind each constellation
•Viewpoint Lock keeps any object centered
•Current weather patterns on the earth, updated daily
•Change the look of the stars
•Galaxies, nebula and star clusters
•Hubble Space Telescope images
•All 8 planets (or 9 for you purists)
•GPS aware 
•Special color mode preserves your night vision.
•Touch the sky to reveal hidden data for each object
•Planetary data and information
First Light is a proud member of Moms with Apps, a collaborative group of family-friendly developers with family-friendly apps.
Twitter: @distantsuns
Support: www.distantsuns.com

bluejetty:00022796:ios.description:
Discover 10,000+ ideas for your bucket list, from everyday adventures to lifelong dreams.
Check Marks helps you find something worth doing and enjoy the satisfaction of checking it off. Explore ready-made challenges, create your own lists, and turn more of your "someday" plans into experiences.
READY-MADE IDEAS, NOT A BLANK PAGE
Get inspired by 156 challenges across 12 categories. Find books to read, movies to watch, dishes to try, places to explore, creative hobbies, date ideas, outdoor adventures, and small ways to make everyday life more interesting.
Plan a screen-free evening, try a new cooking technique, explore somewhere close to home, or start a family tradition. Your bucket list doesn't have to begin with a trip around the world.
Browse by category or mood, or search for a challenge or an individual idea. Pick something that speaks to you and take the first step.
LET SURPRISE ME PICK YOUR NEXT IDEA
Not sure where to start? Tap Surprise Me to discover a Check Mark you might not have thought of. A new hobby, a small adventure, or something just for fun: inspiration can start with one tap.
MAKE YOUR LISTS YOUR OWN
Create Custom Lists for your personal goals, travel plans, reading list, or everyday projects. Add your own Check Marks and keep the things you want to do together in one place.
Use a ready-made challenge when you need inspiration, or build a list around what matters to you.
FIND YOUR 1,000
Take on a personal goal: complete 1,000 Check Marks. Start with one, then build your collection of things you've tried, learned, discovered, and experienced.
See your progress, revisit completed Check Marks in My Achievements, and pick up where you left off in My Lists. Share a Check Mark as an image to celebrate a win or inspire someone else.
BUILD HABITS ALONG THE WAY
Some goals are things you do once. Others are things you want to keep doing. Create habit Trackers, choose a daily schedule or specific days of the week, and set reminders to help you keep going.
Read a little more, make time for creativity, or build a routine that supports your bigger goals.
GO FURTHER WITH CHECK MARKS PRO
Start with free access and upgrade to PRO for the full library of 10,000+ ideas, unlimited Custom Lists and Check Marks within them, unlimited habit Trackers, and unlimited Surprise Me picks.
Choose a monthly or annual subscription, or get Lifetime Access with a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled and can be managed in your Apple Account settings. Lifetime Access does not renew.
Your next great memory can start with one small idea. Find it. Do it. Check it off.

bluejetty:00022225:ios.description:
The fastest way to set reminders and persistent, nagging alarms. Perfect for habits, medication, and staying on track without the clutter of a calendar.
Tired of forgetting important tasks or appointments? Beep Me is the reminder app designed to help you manage your schedule effortlessly. Whether it’s setting a quick reminder or one that keeps nagging you until you act, Beep Me has you covered with just a couple of taps.
Imagine this:
You’re in a meeting and remember you promised to call Jack later. Quickly note “Call Jack” and set a reminder for 2:30 PM. Or, you’ve got a pizza in the oven and need a timer for 20 minutes? Beep Me makes it easy to set reminders in seconds without the hassle of complicated apps or calendar clutter.
Key Features:
◆ Nagging Mode: Never miss a reminder again! Set how often and how many times Beep Me should nag you until you act.
◆ Quick Setup: Create reminders in seconds using either timer-style (e.g., “Remind me in 20 minutes”) or clock-style (e.g., “Remind me at 2:30 PM”).
◆ Repeat Reminders: Customize daily, weekly, monthly, or custom intervals to fit your schedule.
◆ Apple Watch Integration: View, snooze, or mark reminders as done straight from your wrist when a reminder pops up.
◆ Customizable Sounds & Widgets: Choose your preferred notification sounds and add widgets to your home screen for quick access to reminders.
◆ Beep Priority: Set High priority to break through Focus modes, or Urgent to sound alarms even in Silent mode.
What Users Are Saying:
◆ "This app is a game-changer. The nagging reminders mean I never forget anything!"
◆ "Quick, intuitive, and exactly what I needed to stay on top of my tasks."
Ready to stay on top of your schedule? Download Beep Me today and experience a life with fewer forgotten tasks and more peace of mind!

bluejetty:00069647:ios.name: Scaniverse - 3D Scanner
bluejetty:00069647:ios.summary:
3D mapping, reconstruction, and visual positioning from Niantic Spatial
Scaniverse captures, reconstructs, and localizes physical environments — on your phone, and now in the cloud. It’s a foundation for AR, robotics, spatial computing, co
bluejetty:00069647:ios.description:
3D mapping, reconstruction, and visual positioning from Niantic Spatial
Scaniverse captures, reconstructs, and localizes physical environments — on your phone, and now in the cloud. It’s a foundation for AR, robotics, spatial computing, construction planning, and other apps and workflows that require high-fidelity 3D digital twins.
Capture: Point your phone at any space and turn it into 3D data.
- Scan spaces indoors and out, from a single room to a warehouse
- Works with your mobile device’s cameras and sensors
- Combine scans from multiple users and devices into one unified site project
Reconstruct: Process scans into detailed, responsive 3D images.
- State-of-the-art cloud processing turns your scans into immersive Gaussian splats for planning and simulations
- Precise meshes for robotics simulation and collision geometry
- Export in SPZ, PLY, GLB and FBX
Localize: Test Niantic VPS 2.0 in app, deploy with NSDK.
- Better than GPS everywhere, precise where you've mapped. 
- Works indoors, in urban canyons, and GPS-denied environments
- Integrate via NSDK 4.0 for Unity, Swift, and Kotlin
Accounts: Free tier for personal scanning and testing, with limited cloud processing and multi-user collaboration. Paid plans unlock more processing, bigger teams, 360° camera scans, and enterprise support.
Still the world's best free 3D scanner: The classic Scaniverse experience you know is still here — unlimited on-device Gaussian splat capture and processing, several export formats including SPZ, and the shared global map. Nothing's changed. 
Scaniverse is built on the legacy of 25 years of geospatial innovation, including Google Earth and Google Maps. It’s the gateway to Niantic Spatial’s Large Geospatial Model, which builds on the same mission of making the world navigable and understandable, this time through a spatial AI for machines.
Learn more: scaniverse.com
Terms of use: scaniverse.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.nianticspatial.com/privacy-consumer and scaniverse.com/privacy
