bluejetty:00064329:ios.name: TV Cast Pro for Google Cast
bluejetty:00064329:ios.summary: Watch web-videos, online-movies, livestreams and live-tv shows and your personal photos, videos & music by using Google Cast on your Sony TV, Vizio SmartCast TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Toshiba TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player or Nvidia Shield ga
bluejetty:00064329:ios.description:
Watch web-videos, online-movies, livestreams and live-tv shows and your personal photos, videos & music by using Google Cast on your Sony TV, Vizio SmartCast TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Toshiba TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player or Nvidia Shield gaming console. Enjoy the show on your big screen.
With Video & TV Cast you can browse through the web and stream any online video on your Google Cast enabled device (movies, tv shows, sports, music and more). Just navigate to your favorite website and send the embedded video with a single tap to your TV or gaming console. The discovered video will be shown below the browser. A tap on the video link will send it to your Google Cast enabled device immediately. Streaming personal media from your device is also supported.
* The app only works with devices with Google Cast or Chromecast built-in, like Vizio TV, Toshiba TV, Sony TV, Philips TV, Sharp TV, Chromecast, Nexus Player, Nvidia Shield gaming console
* iTunes movies, Flash video and DRM protected videos like Amazon Prime, Netflix, Hulu, Vudu, DirecTV, Xfinity, HBO now are not supported!
* The app streams only the video part of a website and not the whole website content (No screen or tab mirroring!). 
* Sometimes it is necessary to play the video on your iPad or iPhone first before it gets discovered by the app for streaming. 
* If a specific video does not cast, please check our FAQ. If that does not help, please give us a chance to help you by dropping a mail to info@video-tv-cast.com instead of leaving a negative comment on the App Store. We will try to add support for your video as soon as possible.
>>> PRO FEATURES
* Remote Playbar: A remote control that allows you to fast forward or rewind videos while browsing. It syncs across all your iPads & iPhones that are connected to the same Chromecast. So your video can be controlled by different users in the same room.
* Personal Media: Cast unlimited personal photos, videos and music directly from your device or from cloud services like iCloud and Dropbox. 
* Ad-Blocker + No Sponsoring Ads: The Pro app version has no ads and the Ad-Blocker blocks ads & popups on most websites that you visit. You can update, enable/disable ad-blocking at any time in the settings.
* Bookmarks: Save unlimited website bookmarks. Synchronize and transfer them between different TV Cast apps and iOS devices by using backup and restore via iCloud.
* Subtitles: Display subtitles & closed captions on TV.
* Change Homepage: Set your personal homepage in the settings.
>>> A MESSAGE FROM THE DEVELOPERS
We want to say thank you for all your great support and kindly invite you to honestly rate our app. This helps us to keep up our app development and support for you. Please do not trust other apps that ask you for 5-star ratings in exchange for premium upgrades. This is against good developer ethics and also against Apple guidelines.
If you have any feedback, feature requests or other request, please notify us at info@video-tv-cast.com
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with Google, Sony, Philips, Vizio, Sharp, Asus, Nvidia or one of their products and trademarks.

bluejetty:00179259:ios.description:
***** Over 300,000 Downloads! *****
Ocean Waves is a simple app that keeps playing wave sound.
Unwind with Ocean Waves, a player that delivers immersive wave sounds right to your device. Whether you're looking to relax, focus, or drift off to sleep, Ocean Waves has you covered—now controllable via Apple Watch.
*** Main Features and How to Use ***
- Play/Pause Waves: Tap the play-pause button.
- Sleep Timer: Set your timer with a dial and hit "SET". To cancel, turn the dial to 0 and press "CANCEL".
- Background Play: Ocean Waves plays even when the app is in the background. Continue to listen while using other apps (as long as those apps don't require sound).
 *** Other Features ***
- Stereo Sound: By using speakers or headphones that support stereo playback, the wave sound can be heard differently in each ear, providing a more immersive experience.
- AirPlay Support: Using the iOS system, you can easily stream between Apple devices and enjoy high-quality wave sounds.
- Bluetooth Support: You can connect wirelessly to audio equipment and enjoy the sound source wirelessly.
*** Unlock More with Paid Version ***
The premium version is available for purchase within the app.
One-time Purchase Plan: $15.99
Annual Plan: $5.99
Monthly Plan: $2.99
- Features:
 - Remove ads.
 - Extended timer up to 12 hours. *Note: The timer may not work correctly if the device is locked.
 - You can change the maximum time for the timer. (It's useful for meditation and Pomodoro if set to less than an hour.)
 - Night mode settings with reduced screen brightness. In automatic adjustment mode, the beach scenery beautifully adapts to the time of day. 
 - You can configure 3D spatial audio settings. Within the 3D audio space, bird sounds appear in different locations each time. Moreover, listening with AirPods equipped with head tracking technology enhances the spatial experience.
 - You can configure volume fade settings. The volume of the ocean waves will smoothly change during playback and pause.
*** Payment Notes ***
- Prices and currencies may vary by country, region, and time.
- Charged via Apple ID account.
- We do not accept cancellations or refunds for the one-time purchase plan.
- We do not accept cancellations or refunds for the current year of the yearly plan.
- We do not accept cancellations or refunds for the current month of the monthly plan.
*** Terms of Use (EULA) *** 
https://www.codepaint.app/terms/ocean-waves
*** Privacy Policy ***
https://www.codepaint.app/privacy-policy
*** Special Thanks ***
- skyseeker: https://www.skyseeker.net/

bluejetty:00098701:ios.description:
Draw Whimsical Anime-Inspired Art with the Magic of AR
Cartoon Style: Sketch AI Art is a creative drawing app that lets you trace beautiful, anime-style illustrations using Augmented Reality. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced artist, this app transforms your phone into a personal art assistant—helping you draw magical scenes with ease and joy.
Using your phone’s camera, Cartoon Style: Sketch AI Art projects handcrafted templates onto paper or any surface. Simply trace what you see and bring your imagination to life, one line at a time.
Key Features
• Anime-Inspired Templates: Explore a growing library of templates inspired by fantasy worlds—ranging from serene landscapes to dreamy buildings and whimsical natural scenes.
• AR Tracing Mode: Point your camera at a blank sheet of paper and start tracing the projected artwork. No prior drawing skills needed.
• Step-by-Step Drawing: Follow clear, guided instructions that help you sketch in the right sequence and build your artwork smoothly.
• Relax and Create Anywhere: Enjoy a calming and creative experience—whether you're at home, in a café, or on the go.
• Monthly Content Updates: Stay inspired with new templates added regularly to keep your drawing journey fresh and exciting.
• Portable and Simple: No expensive tools required. Just your phone and a piece of paper are enough to create beautiful art.
Whether you’re learning to draw or looking for a peaceful, creative outlet, Cartoon Style: Sketch AI Art helps you explore your artistic side through a blend of imagination and modern technology.
How to Use
• Open the app and select a drawing template.
• Place a sheet of paper on a flat surface.
• Use your phone’s camera to project the image.
• Trace carefully with a pencil or pen.
• Complete your drawing and try a new one whenever you like.
Why You'll Love It
• Suitable for all ages and skill levels
• A fun and immersive way to practice drawing
• Great for fans of calm, fantasy-inspired art styles
Contact Us
We’d love to hear your thoughts and ideas.
Contact us at: https://cemsoftwareltd.com/contact.html
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
• Unlock all features with a subscription to Cartoon Style: Sketch AI Art.
• Subscriptions are billed weekly or yearly based on your plan.
• Manage or cancel your subscription via: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy & Terms
Your data is protected in accordance with our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://cemsoftwareltd.com/term.html
https://cemsoftwareltd.com/privacyPolicy.html
Download Cartoon Style: Sketch AI Art and start drawing something magical today.

bluejetty:00122074:ios.description:
Speed through epic endless runner action in Sonic Dash! Run, jump, spin, and race across stunning 3D courses with Sonic the Hedgehog and friends in SEGA’s hit fast-paced runner game. Dash through iconic zones, dodge obstacles, collect rings, and defeat powerful bosses in an adrenaline-fueled adventure packed with nonstop action, lightning-fast gameplay, and exciting events!
Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Shadow, Amy, Blaze, Silver, and many more legendary Sonic characters. Unlock new runners, upgrade your abilities, and build the ultimate team as you compete in thrilling endless races and special limited-time challenges.
Feel the rush of high-speed runner gameplay with easy controls, explosive boosts, and cinematic environments inspired by the Sonic universe. Whether you love arcade games, offline runner games, racing games, or action-packed adventures, Sonic Dash delivers endless fun for players of all ages.
Race through iconic Sonic worlds including Green Hill Zone, Sky Sanctuary, Beach Zone, and more. Sprint across high-speed tracks, dodge traps, and blast through Badniks with Sonic’s signature Spin Dash attack.
Take on epic boss battles against Dr. Eggman, Zazz, and other powerful enemies. Dodge attacks, react fast, and unleash powerful moves to earn huge rewards and dominate the leaderboards.
Join fast-paced Blitz events and special seasonal challenges to unlock exclusive characters, rewards, and powerful upgrades. Compete in daily missions, complete exciting objectives, and discover new adventures every week.
SONIC DASH FEATURES:
EPIC ENDLESS RUNNER ACTION
• Run, race, jump, and dash at incredible speed
• Experience smooth and fast-paced endless runner gameplay
• Easy-to-use controls designed for quick reflexes and nonstop action
• Collect rings, power-ups, boosters, and rewards
PLAY AS YOUR FAVORITE SONIC CHARACTERS
• Unlock Sonic, Shadow, Tails, Knuckles, Shadow, Amy, Rouge, Blaze, Silver, and more
• Upgrade characters with unique powers and abilities
• Discover new costumes, special variants, and rare event characters
FAST-PACED BLITZ EVENTS
• Compete in limited-time blitz events and special challenges
• Unlock exclusive rewards, characters, and collectibles
• Climb leaderboards and complete daily missions
ICONIC SONIC WORLDS IN 3D
• Race through Green Hill Zone, Sky Sanctuary, Beach Zone, and more
• Enjoy visually stunning 3D runner environments
• Dash through loops, corkscrews, underwater paths, and high-speed tracks
EPIC BOSS BATTLES
• Battle Dr. Eggman, Zazz, and dangerous enemies
• Dodge attacks and strike back with powerful Spin Dash moves
• Earn massive rewards and high scores
MORE THAN AN ENDLESS RUNNER
• Rescue animal friends and explore the Sonic universe
• Customize and upgrade your experience
• Discover fresh content, events, and surprises regularly
If you love endless runner games, racing games, fast arcade action, and Sonic adventures, Sonic Dash is the ultimate speed experience. Download now and start running!

Lumina allows you to experience the NET Bible with all of its notes for free and in a visually friendly and intuitive way.
- Read the New English Translation (NET) Bible like the book that it is, by swiping through its pages without worryi
bluejetty:00015527:ios.description:
Lumina allows you to experience the NET Bible with all of its notes for free and in a visually friendly and intuitive way.
- Read the New English Translation (NET) Bible like the book that it is, by swiping through its pages without worrying about chapter boundaries.
- Tap the current passage title to change passages.
- Learn and grow by reading the 58,506 translators’ notes and the associated Bible cross references in popups.
- Highlight/underline passages of interest.
- Bookmark your favorite passages by tapping a verse number.
- Take notes that are tied to verses by tapping a verse number.
- Sync your highlights, notes, and bookmarks with lumina.bible.org and other iOS devices running this App.
- See an indication of your notes when reading the text.
- Search the bible using our fuzzy search that doesn't require you to know all of the words or even the translation it came from.
- Share verses via Twitter, Facebook, Email, and Messaging by tapping a verse number.
- Choose books by using a grid, canonical list, or alphabetical list of books. Force Touch a Book/Chapter to go directly to it.
- Two-finger swipe left/right to navigate your history during sermons and Bible studies.
- Change the font and size of the text.
- Night Reading Mode
The NET Bible is a modern of the Bible with 58,506 translators’ notes! It was completed by more than 25 scholars – experts in the original biblical languages – who worked directly from the best currently available Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek texts.

No matter where you are amongst your busy schedule, staying on top of your business finances is crucial to your success. Introducing the new HSBC HK Business Express mobile app, another magnificent tool co-created by HSBC and our customers. Now, you can gain better control of your cash flow and receive financial insights tailored to your business needs anytime, anywhere.

• Secured and easy access: Mobile Security Key or biometric logon through fingerprints or facial recognition
• Simpler and faster payment: You can now make local and international payments on the go, and make it even easier by using Mobile Security Key instead of your physical Security Device. bluejetty:00013871:ios.name: Blink - The Frontline App
bluejetty:00013871:ios.summary: The app frontline workers love to open every day. Blink is where key workers start their day, get stuff done, and feel supported and involved. Everything they need – apps, conversations, tools – is one click away. The result? A measurable b
bluejetty:00013871:ios.description:
The app frontline workers love to open every day. Blink is where key workers start their day, get stuff done, and feel supported and involved. Everything they need – apps, conversations, tools – is one click away. The result? A measurable boost in engagement, retention – and a thriving, digitally-connected workforce.
---
"The best investment we've made in 20 years." – Managing Director, Stagecoach
"If you want to be ahead of the curve in how you handle internal communications, Blink is absolutely the way to do it." – Director of Organizational Development, Promises Behavioral Health.
"Engagement has gone through the roof." – Director of Communications, State Transit.
---
Blink isn't an intranet or a traditional comms app – but it will replace both.
Inside Blink, you'll find five core tools that will transform your workforce.
1. A Hub for you to keep tabs of every file, asset and tool on one dashboard.
2. A Feed for posting targeted announcements, stories and updates.
3. A Messenger to get quick answers: group, 121, GIFS, and video calls all enabled.
4. Micro Apps – mini-systems that do pretty much anything you want them to (payslips, leave requests, rotas).
5. A Single Sign-On to take you to any app in seconds, within Blink, without a login.
---
Instead of using paper and noticeboards...
... you'll have one (digital) place to keep information up-to-date, centralized, and on the record.
Instead of internal updates that go unread...
... you'll build a community and strengthen culture through authentic user-generated stories.
Instead of unused tools and forgotten logins...
... you'll be able to access any workplace app in seconds using Single Sign-On.
Instead of high costs and overheads...
... your workforce will be able to access Microsoft 365 and Sharepoint without a license.
Instead of strain on your IT team...
... you'll have a system that requires no input from them – Blink takes care of itself.
Instead of an unreachable frontline workforce...
... you'll be able to access anyone, anytime, anywhere, without an @email address or phone number.
---
ABOUT BLINK
A single idea inspired Blink: an organization's greatest asset is its frontline. Our goal is to empower every frontline worker to maximize their impact, through frictionless technology that gives them a voice, a sense of belonging, and a better everyday. Over 200 frontline organizations trust us to power their workforce, across sectors like healthcare, transport, logistics, retail and hospitality. 
Blink is headquartered in London with additional offices in New York and Sydney.
We hope you'll give Blink a try today.

bluejetty:00121618:ios.description:
Welcome to Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire — the coziest tile matching puzzle on the App Store!
Tap pairs of identical tiles, clear adorable cat-themed boards, and let the Lucky Cat bring calm and fortune to your day. Whether you are a seasoned mahjong player or a total newcomer, Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire welcomes you with hundreds of handcrafted layouts, beautiful artwork, and a soothing soundtrack designed to help you unwind anytime, anywhere.
GAME FEATURES
- Hundreds of handcrafted mahjong layouts, from easy to truly challenging
- Charming lucky cat tile sets inspired by Japanese and Chinese folklore
- Classic mahjong solitaire rules: match pairs of free tiles to clear the board
- Daily puzzle challenges with exclusive rewards and collectible postcards
- Smart hints, shuffles, and unlimited undos to guide every move
- Offline play: no Wi-Fi required, perfect for travel, commutes, or bedtime
- Relaxing background music and gentle sound effects
- Crisp visuals optimized for iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
- Clean, eye-friendly interface suitable for kids, adults, and seniors
HOW TO PLAY
- Tap two identical tiles that are free on the left or right side
- Tiles covered by other tiles are locked until you uncover them
- Flower tiles pair with any flower; season tiles pair with any season
- Clear every tile on the board to complete the level and earn rewards
- Use hints, shuffles, and undos whenever you get stuck — no pressure
WHY YOU WILL LOVE IT
Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire is more than a classic tile match game — it is a mindful escape. Each board is carefully designed to challenge your memory, focus, and planning skills while keeping the experience calm and rewarding. Perfect for a quick five-minute break or a long evening of relaxation.
If you enjoy Shanghai mahjong, Taipei mahjong, connect-style mahjong, classic solitaire, brain training puzzles, or zen tile matching games, you will feel right at home.
DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE
Looking for a stress reliever after work? A brain workout for seniors? A commute companion? A cozy bedtime puzzle? Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire fits into any moment of your day. The intuitive touch controls, generous tile sizes, and colorful artwork make the game accessible and welcoming for every age and skill level.
DAILY CHALLENGES AND EVENTS
Log in every day to discover fresh puzzles, limited-time events, and themed board collections. Complete daily challenges to unlock new cat tile skins, beautiful backgrounds, and bonus boosters that help you progress faster. Each new update brings fresh boards and seasonal surprises to keep the adventure alive.
A MINDFUL PUZZLE EXPERIENCE
Take a deep breath, tap a pair, and watch the tiles disappear. Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire is crafted for anyone who loves thoughtful, unhurried games. There are no timers forcing you to rush, no pushy ads breaking your flow, and no paywalls blocking the fun. Just you, your tiles, and the soothing rhythm of a perfect match.
STAY CONNECTED
We love hearing from our players! Send feedback, feature ideas, or just say hi — every message is read and every review helps us make Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire better. Follow us for news about upcoming features, new tile collections, and community events.
Download Lucky Cat Mahjong Solitaire now — your Lucky Cat is ready to bring you good fortune, one pair at a time!

bluejetty:00139879:ios.description:
It’s the 1920s. Leo Parker, renowned archaeologist and explorer, is in Giza working on an excavation for the British crown. Soon to head home, Leo gets wind of the discovery of a new tomb. His exploration of this tomb begins an adventure that will lead him to discover not just about the ancient past, but about himself as well.
Sand is part puzzle game, part adventure, part graphic novel. Unravel the story of the long-dead Pharaoh Anat as you solve puzzles and discover clues across a variety of Egypt-themed settings. Delve tombs, trace clues in the stars themselves, haggle with merchants, unlock ancient doors and journey back to ancient Egypt itself in search of answers.
* Beautiful hand-drawn artwork.
* A rich story that unfolds over the course of the game.
* Challenging puzzles.
* A detailed hint system to nudge you in the right direction.
* Easy mode for if you get really stuck.
* Intuitive inventory system.
* Optimised for the latest devices.
* A unique alternate-history story.
* Start Leo’s adventure for free!
Perfect for fans of adventure, point and click and Myst-like games as well as those entirely new to the genre, Sand is a must-buy!

bluejetty:00062013:ios.description:
There never was such a SuperInteresting and SuperIntriguing way to learn numbers!!!
"SuperNumbers!" is a happy game for children to learn counting from 1 to 10. 
While playing with little number-characters your child will learn numbers and how to write them. They will master counting and learn the correlation between numbers and quantities. 
"SuperNumbers!" app offers many amazing educational games:
• FIRST EXPOSURE TO NUMBERS AND THEIR NAMES. 
"Catch the NumBlot!" Collect the needed NumBlot in the bucket with paint. 
• LEARN HOW TO WRITE NUMBERS. 
"Draw SuperNumbers!" Draw your own SuperNumbers with help from the magical paint. 
• LEARN TO COUNT FROM 1 TO 10. 
"Feed the SuperNumber!" Catch and count the food for the hungry SuperNumber. 
• CORRELATION BETWEEN NUMBERS AND QUANTITIES. 
"Puzzle-hide and seek with SuperNumbers!" Catch all the rogue SuperNumbers and put them onto their correct place. 
FEATURES:
• SuperAmusing characters.
• SuperEntertaining education.
• SuperHilariuos animation!
• SuperVariuos games!
• SuperFunny sound effects! 
• SuperMerry music!
• SuperComfortable interface!

bluejetty:00073981:ios.description:
Track anime and manga effortlessly across your Apple devices. Update episodes and chapters in a tap, see your progress at a glance, and sync with MyAnimeList or AniList.
Rated 4.6/5 and praised by fans as "superior to every other tracker."
WHY FANS LOVE MANGO
• MyAnimeList and AniList, your choice
Sign in with either service and the whole app just works: widgets, Siri Shortcuts, Apple Watch, all of it. Use both? Pick a primary service and save every change to both at once (ManGo+). Tap any MyAnimeList or AniList link to open it right in ManGo (ManGo+).
• Tracking that takes one tap
Choose between classic lists and customizable poster grids. Use swipe actions or a single tap to update your list, add scores and notes, and keep rewatches and rereads moving across every device, including Apple Watch.
• Never miss a new episode
Get notified the moment a new episode airs or a series premieres. Start a 'Binge Session' Live Activity to follow your progress right on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
• Discover what to watch next
Browse seasonal charts of upcoming and continuing shows, and explore the top rankings for anime, manga, movies and more to finally clear that backlog.
• Widgets that actually do something
A huge range of interactive Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets lets you track without opening the app. See anime and manga together in the large Progress widget, then update an episode or chapter right from your Home Screen.
• Hear every opening and ending
ManGo automatically finds anime openings and endings in the Spotify and Apple Music catalogs.
• Built for the whole Apple ecosystem
Use Siri Shortcuts to find and open anime or manga, track from Apple Watch with complications and Smart Stack, and enjoy a native experience on Apple Vision Pro.
• Make it yours
Fine-tune the interface, set fully custom gestures, and choose your own app tints, themes and icons (ManGo+).
Note: ManGo is a third-party app which uses the MyAnimeList and AniList APIs and is in no way affiliated with MyAnimeList.net or AniList.co.
ManGo+ unlocks additional features, including saving your list to MyAnimeList and AniList at once, as a lifetime purchase, monthly, or yearly subscription. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends, charged to your iTunes account. Manage in your iTunes Account Settings. bluejetty:00095339:ios.name: LookLab AI: Video Enhancer
bluejetty:00095339:ios.summary:
LookLab: Your AI Creative Studio
Ever had a picture you loved, but wished it had a little more... magic? Or a moment you captured that you wish could come to life? At LookLab, we believe your memories and ideas deserve to be extraordinary.
bluejetty:00095339:ios.description:
LookLab: Your AI Creative Studio
Ever had a picture you loved, but wished it had a little more... magic? Or a moment you captured that you wish could come to life? At LookLab, we believe your memories and ideas deserve to be extraordinary. That’s why we built an AI-powered creative partner that fits right in your pocket.
Forget complicated software and technical jargon. LookLab is designed for you. It’s a playground for your photos and videos, where you can transform the ordinary into the spectacular with just a few taps.
---
What Can You Create with LookLab?
Your creativity is limitless, and your tools should be too. Here’s a glimpse of what’s waiting for you inside:
For Fun: Reimagine Your World
This is where the magic starts. Perfect for social media, sharing with friends, or just surprising yourself with what’s possible.
* Become the Star of Your Own Movie (Video Lab)
 Got a favorite selfie? Turn it into a stunning, animated video. Choose from dozens of styles—like cinematic, vintage, or cartoon—and watch as our AI brings your photo to life with breathtaking motion and effects. It’s as simple as picking a photo, choosing a style, and hitting "generate."
* Give Your Photos a New Identity (Photo Lab)
 Tired of the same old filters? Our Photo Lab uses powerful AI to completely reimagine your pictures. Apply artistic styles that make your photo look like a painting, a sketch, or something from a different era. It’s not just an edit; it’s a transformation.
* Try on a New Face (Face Swap Lab)
 Ever wondered what you’d look like in a different role? Swap your face into our gallery of showcase photos and see yourself in a new light. Become a vintage movie star, a futuristic hero, or just have a laugh with hilarious combinations. You can even use your own photos for endless custom fun.
For Business: Your Professional AI Toolkit
For creators, marketers, and small business owners, LookLab offers a suite of powerful tools designed to make your content stand out.
* Perfect Product Shots with Background Remover: Get a clean, transparent background for any product photo, instantly.
* Create Limitless Canvases with AI Image Expander: Magically extend your images, adding more background to fit any format without cropping.
* Achieve Crystal Clear Quality with Photo & Video Upscaling: Turn blurry, low-resolution photos and videos into sharp, stunning 4K visuals.
* Bring Ideas to Life with Text-to-Image: Describe what you want to see, and our AI will generate a unique, high-quality image from your words.
* Make Your Content Speak with Audio-to-Video: Upload a photo and an audio clip, and our AI will create a realistic, talking avatar. Perfect for social media updates, presentations, and more.
* Take your video clips from simple to cinematic with our new AI Video SFX feature. Have you ever filmed a moment and wished you could add Hollywood-style special effects? Now you can. Just upload your video, and then describe the magic you want to create—whether it’s adding a "futuristic sci-fi look," creating a "dramatic, moody atmosphere," or making it feel like an "animated cartoon." You can even provide a reference image to guide the AI’s artistic direction. In a few minutes, LookLab works its magic, transforming your everyday footage into a professional-quality scene with stunning effects that will leave your audience speechless.
* And so much more... including an AI Image Editor, Image-to-Video creation, and professional video special effects.
---
### What is LookLab?
LookLab is more than just an app; it’s your creative partner. We handle the complex technology so you can focus on what matters most: bringing your vision to life. Whether you’re creating a viral video for TikTok. LookLab gives you the power to create things you never thought possible.

30 Day Fitness Challenge at home with no equipment needed!
Follow the 30 Day Fitness Challenge and see your fat cells melt away. Get your whole body toned and feel like the best version of yourself. Drop any extra weight with no struggle and see a noticeable difference in your shape in 30 days. Try it now!
Professionally designed challenges to maximize fat loss and tone ab, butt and leg muscles. As you progress, each challenge slowly increases in intensity and day 30 will test anyone! (recovery days built-in)
This little app is built on our popular 7 Minute Workout +, the workouts are quick, but highly effective! This high-intensity training with little rest results in higher daily metabolism and is the equivalent of working out for over an hour.

The 30 Day Fitness Challenge is also the next high tech generation of training apps based on our years of experience on developing health & fitness technologies. These tiny tiny little things have been helping more than 1.2 million people all over the world improving their health since 2012
By fully considering workouts rules, 30 Day Fit Challenge Workout increases exercise intensity step by step, so you can easily stick daily workouts. Don't need to go to gym, just use your bodyweight and take a few minutes a day, 30 Day Fit Challenge will greatly help you keep fitness and lose weight effectively.
Features
+ 30 day abs challenge
+ 30 day push up challenge
+ 30 day squat challenge
+ 30 day butt challenge
+ 30 day arm challenge
+ 30 day plank challenge
+ 30 day cardio challenge
- Records training progress automatically
- Reminds you to workout every day
- Detailed video guides
- Increases exercise intensity step by step
- Share with your friends on social media
Each challenge has 3 difficulty levels, from beginner to pro. Find the workout that's best for you. Begin your 30 day challenge now, and after 30 days, you may find that your emotional and intellectual fitness improve along with your physical fitness. You are special and so is your body. Take care of it and stay away from diseases like diabetes and obesity by exercising daily. Download 30 Day Fitness Challenge app now!

apple-itunes:363978811.name: Seconds Pro Interval Timer
apple-itunes:363978811.description:
Seconds Pro is an interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, EMOM, circuits and any workout built from timed intervals. It calls each interval out loud, keeps running with the screen off, and runs on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
Apple has featured it, and Joe Wicks, The Body Coach, has said it is the fitness app he uses more than any other.
BUILD ANY WORKOUT
- Start from a HIIT, Tabata or circuit template, or build a timer from scratch with sets, rounds and intervals of different lengths.
- Chain timers into one compound timer, so a warm-up flows into the main set and then a cool-down.
- Color-code every interval so you know what is coming before the beep.
- Share a timer with a friend in one tap.
HEAR IT, DON'T WATCH IT
- Voice cues call out each interval by name and warn you before the next one starts.
- Beeps and bells are there too if you would rather not be talked at.
- Play your own music, per timer or per interval. Cues duck the music and it comes back up when they are done.
- The timer keeps going in the background while you use other apps or the screen sleeps.
ON THE GYM FLOOR
- A full-screen, color-coded display you can read from across the room, in portrait or landscape. On iPad it uses the whole screen.
- A lock button stops a stray tap from pausing your set.
APPLE WATCH
- Seconds Pro runs on the watch by itself, so the phone can stay in the locker. Timers you build on the phone sync to the wrist, and Quick Intervals builds a basic circuit on the watch itself.
MORE TIMERS
- A stopwatch that marks your best and worst laps.
- A countdown timer with five preset durations (three on Apple Watch).
APPLE HEALTH
- Save workouts and mindful sessions to Health. With a heart rate monitor connected, Seconds Pro reads your body measurements and year of birth from Health to estimate calories burned.
PAID ONCE, NOTHING TO UNLOCK
- Seconds Pro is paid for up front. Every feature is included and every timer you make can be run as many times as you like.
SECONDS AND SECONDS PRO
- Seconds is the free version of this app. It has the same features, but each timer locks after one run until a single in-app purchase unlocks it. The two are separate products and a purchase in one does not carry over to the other. If you bought Seconds Pro, download Seconds Pro. If you bought the unlock in Seconds, download Seconds and use Restore Purchases.

apple-macos:6760197595.name: PawLife: Pet Health Tracker
apple-macos:6760197595.description:
PawLife works out how much your dog or cat should eat, gram by gram, and keeps the health record around it: the diary, stool, urine, weight, medications, vaccines, labs and vet visits. The assistant reads that record before it answers. Tell it what happened and it writes it down.
THE ASSISTANT DOES THE WORK
• Say "she left half of dinner, stool was soft, gave the pill with breakfast" and the whole evening is logged, to the right meal, yesterday included
• Say "the vet asked for 50 g less" and every bowl in the plan is recalculated
• Say "bought two 12 kg bags" and the stock updates. You hear about it before the food runs out
• Photograph the discharge summary after a vet visit. The medications, doses and recheck land in the calendar
• Send a lab sheet, as a photo or a PDF, and it is filed under Labs with the values read out. Send the passport and it goes to Documents, every page
• Say "she's been spayed", "we changed clinics" or "I want him to drink more" and the profile, the clinic and the goal are updated. It asks before it changes anything
• Every conversation is kept. Start a new chat or go back to an old one
FEEDING AND PORTIONS
• A feeding plan built from breed, weight, age and activity
• Exact grams per meal. Skip a meal or change a portion and the rest of the day adjusts
• Dry and wet food in one plan, in the ratio you choose
• A 7-day schedule for switching foods, gram by gram
• Food stock that warns you before it runs out
• Possible FDA recalls flagged on the foods you keep
• Is this human food safe? 500+ foods with toxicity levels for dogs and cats
• 300+ commercial foods with ingredient analysis
IT ALREADY KNOWS YOUR PET
You don't describe your dog to a stranger every time you ask. The assistant sees the weight curve, meals, stool, medications, allergies, breed, age and every vet visit, and it tells you plainly when it's time to call the vet.
• Send a photo of a rash, a limp, an ear or the stool and it is read with the same record in view
• A puppy, a senior, a pet on a diet and a pet losing weight for no clear reason get different answers
• Say "she's allergic to chicken" and it goes on her allergy list. Food checks warn about it and the vet report includes it
HEALTH DIARY
• Symptoms, mood, energy and behavior on one timeline
• Stool tracker with Bristol type, color and trends
• Urine tracker: colour, clarity, amount and warning signs. Urinalysis and home test strips in Labs, with trends
• Weight log with charts, a goal and an estimated finish date
• An evening round fills in the diary in one pass. You choose what it asks: stool, urine, water, walk, mood, weight
• Medals for the habits you keep, each with the day it was earned engraved on the back
MEDICATIONS, VACCINES AND VET VISITS
• Doses on a schedule, with a history of what was given
• Vaccines as a series, with lot numbers and renewal dates
• A report to hand the vet before a visit
• Routine care on repeat: deworming, flea and tick, grooming. A pill that goes with food is ticked off together with the meal
DOCUMENTS AND THE LOST-PET TAG
• Passport, discharge summaries, prescriptions and insurance in one vault, PDF import included
• A QR tag for the collar. Whoever finds your pet opens your contact page in a browser and does not need the app
FAMILY AND PET SITTER
• Invite your family to look after the same pet
• Everyone sees the same meals, doses and diary entries, so nobody has to ask "did you already feed her?"
• Going away? Send the sitter a link with the meals and doses for those days. They don't need an account
iPhone, iPad with a proper two-column layout, and Apple Watch showing the next meal.
PawLife is not a substitute for professional veterinary care. Always consult a licensed veterinarian for serious health concerns.

apple-macos:578574002.description:
Some adventures begin with a map. Others begin with a little pig waiting for a bath. Welcome to 123 Kids Fun Animal Games, an educational app for toddlers and preschoolers where every animal has a story and every small act of kindness becomes a new discovery.
Join Tishi, Tashi and Ubaki as they explore a colorful world filled with pets, farm animals, forest creatures, tiny insects and exciting vehicles. Feed a hungry kitten, wash a muddy pig, help busy bees, watch clever spiders weave their webs, care for an aquarium and discover why every living creature matters. And when your animal friends are happy, hop into a car, train, airplane, ship or even a rocket and keep exploring. With 25 interactive educational mini-games, children build preschool skills while following their curiosity and imagination.
A World Waiting to Be Discovered
Every place feels different. Every activity tells a new story. Children care for pets, help farm animals, explore forests and discover fascinating insects. Along the way they learn that kindness isn’t only for kittens and puppies. Even bees, ants and spiders have an important place in our world. Without even realizing it, children begin to see nature with new eyes.
Learning That Feels Like Play
While exploring, children develop language, observation, memory, logical thinking and fine motor skills through playful challenges designed for toddlers and preschoolers. Every animation, sound and interaction encourages curiosity and discovery.
What Children Can Explore
Inside the app, little explorers can:
- feed, wash and care for pets,
- help farm animals every day,
- discover fascinating insects and their amazing jobs,
- explore forest adventures and help woodland friends,
- travel by car, train, airplane, ship and rocket,
- enjoy 25 interactive educational mini-games.
Every activity is simple, rewarding and designed for young children.
Why Families Love 123 Kids Fun Animal Games
Designed for ages 3+, this preschool learning app combines animal games, educational activities, virtual pet care, nature exploration and imaginative adventures in one safe, colorful experience. Beautiful animations, cheerful sounds and intuitive controls make every visit another exciting journey.
Because Curiosity Changes Everything
The greatest discoveries often begin with one simple question. “What happens if I help?” That question leads children to care for animals, explore nature, discover new places and build confidence through play. Because learning isn’t about memorizing the world. It’s about falling in love with it.

apple-itunes:1467398796.name: Nerva: Gut-Brain Program
apple-itunes:1467398796.description:
Address the miscommunication between your gut and brain. Designed for people living with IBS, functional dyspepsia (FD), GERD, bloating symptoms, and other gut–brain disorders - as well as those seeking additional support alongside IBD care - Nerva is a personalized gut–brain program that supports symptom management through daily sessions, practical tools, and structured guidance.
Target the root cause
Many people spend years cutting out foods in an effort to calm their gut - a difficult path that can miss what’s really driving symptoms. In disorders of gut–brain interaction (DGBIs), the root cause is gut–brain hypersensitivity.
After a trigger like illness, antibiotics, or prolonged stress, the nerves in the gut can become over-reactive. Even once the gut tissue heals, the nervous system may keep the alarm turned up. Normal digestion, gas, or movement are then misread as danger - leading to pain, bloating, reflux, urgency, constipation, or diarrhea.
Diets and medications can reduce symptoms temporarily, but they don’t retrain this signaling system. That’s why symptoms often return or shift over time.
Lasting relief means calming the nervous system and restoring healthy gut–brain communication - where the symptoms actually start.
How Nerva helps
Nerva is a structured gut–brain program that helps you practice brain-gut techniques shown to support a calmer response to gut sensations. Over the program you'll learn to:
- Respond differently to uncomfortable gut signals
- Practice calming the gut–brain stress response
- Build daily habits that support digestive comfort
Tailored to you
No two guts are the same. Nerva adapts your program to your symptoms, triggers, and progress - using AI to adjust the coaching and guidance as you go. The sessions, the tools you receive, and the coaching you follow are all shaped around your experience.
Evidence-based
Unlike most apps, Nerva is built on clinical research. In a randomized controlled trial at Monash University, Nerva helped 81% of people significantly manage their gastrointestinal symptoms. Since then, more than 300,000 people have used Nerva, and over 11,000 healthcare providers recommend it.
Features of Nerva
- Daily 15-minute sessions designed to retrain gut-brain miscommunication
- Flare-up tools for pain, bloating, constipation, reflux and diarrhea
- Long-term maintenance plan to keep symptoms under control after the program
- AI personalization to tailor the program to your selected triggers and progress
Who is the team behind Nerva?
Nerva was built by Dr. Simone Peters, GI psychophysiologist, together with clinicians, dietitians, and researchers. Many of us live with gut conditions ourselves. 
Member stories
“Nerva has really worked for me. I’ve been using the app for several months now, and I’ve noticed that I’m experiencing less negative instances with my stomach. I would highly recommend to anyone - absolutely worth the subscription”
Disclaimer: Nerva is a self-guided program that may help people self-manage and live well with a diagnosed disorder of the gut-brain interaction. It is not a substitute for professional medical care, diagnosis, or treatment, and has not been evaluated by the FDA, TGA, MHRA, or equivalent bodies. Do not change prescribed medication or treatment without professional advice. Some content is personalized or generated by AI for educational and wellness purposes only. It is not therapy or mental health care, is not from a licensed professional, and is not monitored in real time.
